title: 75th anniversary of the founding of the Vatican City State
description_en: The inner part shows a schematic representation of the perimeter walls of the Vatican City with St Peter's Basilica in the foreground. Also in the inner part are the inscriptions '75 o ANNO DELLO STATO' and '1929-2004' as well as, in smaller letters, the name of the designer 'VEROI' and the initials of the engraver 'L.D.S. INC.'. The outer part of the coin features the twelve stars of the European Union and the inscription 'CITTA' DEL VATICANO'.
description_zh: 硬币内圈描绘了梵蒂冈城的城墙示意图，前景是圣彼得大教堂。内圈还刻有“75 o ANNO DELLO STATO”（梵蒂冈建国75周年）和“1929-2004”（1929-2004）字样，以及较小的设计师姓名“VEROI”和雕刻师姓名缩写“L.D.S. INC.”（L.D.S. INC.）。硬币外圈图案为欧盟的十二颗星和“CITTA' DEL VATICANO”（梵蒂冈城）字样。

title: 5th decade of the World Food Programme
description_en: In the centre is the globe, tilted to the right and bearing the inscription 'WORLD FOOD PROGRAMME'. An ear of wheat, an ear of maize and an ear of rice, the three grains representing the world's basic sources of nourishment, emerge from behind the globe. To the right of the globe is an 'I' superimposed on an 'R', denoting 'Repubblica Italiana', below which there appears a smaller combination of the letters U and P, the initials of the engraver, Uliana Pernazza. To the upper left of the globe is the mint mark 'R' and under the globe is the year – '2004'. The 12 stars of the European Union are positioned around the outer circle.
description_zh: 中心是一个向右倾斜的地球仪，上面刻有“世界粮食计划署”（WORLD FOOD PROGRAMME）字样。一穗小麦、一穗玉米和一穗稻米——代表世界基本粮食来源的三种谷物——从地球仪后方伸出。地球仪右侧是字母“I”叠加在字母“R”上，代表“意大利共和国”（Repubblica Italiana）。下方是较小的字母组合“U”和“P”，是雕刻师乌利亚娜·佩尔纳扎（Uliana Pernazza）的姓名首字母。地球仪左上方是造币厂标记“R”，下方是年份“2004”。欧盟的12颗星环绕在外圈。

title: Bartolomeo Borghesi (historian, numismatist)
description_en: the twelve stars of the European Union positioned around the outer circle of the coin and the issuing year '2004', positioned bottom centre, surround the bust of Bartolomeo Borghesi. To the left of the bust is the inscription 'Bartolomeo Borghesi', and one above the other are the letter 'R' and the engraver's initials 'E.L.F.'. To the right of the bust is the word 'San Marino'.
description_zh: 硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的十二颗星，底部中央是发行年份“2004”，中间是巴托洛梅奥·博尔盖西的半身像。半身像左侧刻有“Bartolomeo Borghesi”字样，下方依次是字母“R”和雕刻师的姓名首字母“E.L.F.”，半身像右侧刻有“San Marino”（圣马力诺）字样。

title: Enlargement of the European Union by ten new Member States
description_en: the design describes a stylised pillar from which the sprouts grow upwards. The sprouts represent the enlargement of the European Union. The pillar represents the foundation for growth. Near the pillar there are the letters 'EU'. In the upper part of the coin there is the year '2004'. Twelve stars, together with the year, surround the design.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了一根程式化的柱子，柱子上向上生长出嫩芽。这些嫩芽象征着欧盟的扩张。柱子则代表增长的基础。柱子附近是“EU”字样。硬币上方是年份“2004”。十二颗星与年份一起环绕着整个设计。

title: Effigy and monogram of Grand-Duke Henri
description_en: the coin depicts on the left hand of the inner part the effigy of His Royal Highness, the Grand-Duke Henri, looking to the right, and on the right hand the monogram of the Grand-Duke Henri (special letter 'H' topped with a crown). The 12 stars appear in semi-circular form at the right of the monogram. The year 2004, surrounded by the mint mark as well as the engraver's initials, and the word LËTZEBUERG are written in circular form at the top of the ring. The words 'HENRI — Grand-Duc de Luxembourg' appear at the bottom of the ring.
description_zh: 这枚硬币内侧左侧刻有亨利大公殿下的肖像，他面向右侧；右侧是亨利大公的姓名缩写（特殊的字母“H”，上方饰以皇冠）。12颗星呈半圆形排列在姓名缩写的右侧。硬币顶部以圆形刻有年份“2004”，周围环绕着造币厂标记、雕刻师姓名首字母以及“LËTZEBUERG”（卢森堡）字样。硬币底部刻有“HENRI — Grand-Duc de Luxembourg”（亨利——卢森堡大公）字样。

title: Olympic Games in Athens 2004
description_en: the twelve stars of the European Union positioned around the outer circle surround the design of an ancient statue depicting a discobolus in his attempt to throw the discus. The base of the statue covers a small part of the coin's external ring (outer part). To the left is the logo of the Olympic Games 'ATHENS 2004' and the five Olympic circles, and to the right, one above the other, are the figure '2' and the word 'ΕΥΡΩ'. The yearmark is written in split form around the star positioned bottom centre, as follows: 20*04 and the mintmark is above the athlete's head to the left.
description_zh: 欧盟的十二颗星环绕着外圈，中间是一尊古代雕像，描绘的是一位掷铁饼者试图掷出铁饼的场景。雕像的底座覆盖了硬币外圈的一小部分。左侧是2004年雅典奥运会的标志和五个奥运五环，右侧上下排列着数字“2”和“ΕΥΡΩ”（希腊语，意为“希腊语”）。年份以分割的形式刻在底部中央的五角星周围，格式为“20*04”，造币厂标记位于运动员头部上方左侧。

title: 20th World Youth Day
description_en: Depicted in the centre of the coin is the Cathedral of Cologne with a comet passing by above. The words ‘XX GIORNATA MONDIALE DELLA GIOVENTÙ’ are inscribed along the upper edge of the central part, separated by the tail of the comet and two of the cathedral’s spires, one of which extends into the coin’s outer ring. Twelve stars are depicted in a semicircle along the upper part of the outer ring, separated at the top by the year of issue (2005) and the mintmark ‘R’. Below the central image of the cathedral, the words ‘CITTÀ DEL VATICANO’ form a semicircle in the outer ring.
description_zh: 硬币中央图案为科隆大教堂，一颗彗星从其上方掠过。“XX GIORNATA MONDIALE DELLA GIOVENTÙ”（世界青年日二十周年）字样沿中央图案上缘排列，彗星尾部与大教堂的两座尖塔分隔开来，其中一座尖塔延伸至硬币外环。外环上部呈半圆形排列着十二颗星，星与星之间以发行年份（2005）和造币厂标记“R”分隔。大教堂图案下方，外环上呈半圆形排列着“CITTÀ DEL VATICANO”（梵蒂冈城）字样。

title: World Year of Physics 2005
description_en: The centre of the coin features a free interpretation of the allegorical painting of Galileo Galilei that is known as ‘la fisica antica’ or the study of the planets. The year of issue appears beneath a globe standing on a desk. To the left of the image is the mintmark ‘R’, and the engraver’s initials ‘LDS’ appear on the right. The words ‘SAN MARINO’ form a semicircle above the image, while the words ‘ANNO MONDIALE DELLA FISICA’ run along the lower edge of the inner part below. The outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union, separated by the outer edges of the image of a stylised atom inscribed in the background of the entire coin.
description_zh: 硬币中心图案是对伽利略·伽利莱寓言画作《古代物理学》（la fisica antica，意为“行星研究”）的自由诠释。发行年份位于一个置于桌上的地球仪下方。图案左侧是造币厂标记“R”，右侧是雕刻师的姓名首字母“LDS”。图案上方呈半圆形排列着“SAN MARINO”（圣马力诺）字样，下方内圈边缘则刻有“ANNO MONDIALE DELLA FISICA”（世界物理学年）字样。外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星，星与背景中镌刻的程式化原子图案的外缘相隔。

title: 1st anniversary of the signing of the European Constitution
description_en: The centre of the coin features Europa and the bull, with Europa holding a pen and the text of the European Constitution. To the upper left of the image is the mintmark ‘R’. The initials of engraver Maria Carmela Colaneri, ‘MCC’, appear on the lower left edge of the coin’s central part. The year of mintage is shown in the top right of the image above the head of the bull. Positioned just off-centre at the bottom of the image is the monogram of the Italian Republic, ‘RI’. The words ‘COSTITUZIONE EUROPEA’ form a semicircle along the outer ring of the coin beneath the central image, while twelve stars are depicted on the remainder of the outer ring.
description_zh: 硬币中心图案为欧罗巴女神和公牛，欧罗巴女神手持钢笔，笔旁刻有《欧洲宪法》文本。图案左上方为铸币厂标记“R”。雕刻师玛丽亚·卡梅拉·科拉内里（Maria Carmela Colaneri）的姓名首字母“MCC”位于硬币中心图案的左下角。铸造年份位于图案右上角，公牛头部上方。图案底部略偏中心位置是意大利共和国的缩写“RI”。“COSTITUZIONE EUROPEA”（欧洲宪法）字样沿硬币外环呈半圆形排列在中心图案下方，外环其余部分则绘有十二颗星。

title: 60th anniversary of the establishment of the United Nations and 50th anniversary of Finland’s membership therein
description_en: Depicted in the centre of the coin are parts of a jigsaw puzzle showing a dove of peace. Below the image of the dove, inscribed along the edge of the bottom half of the central part of the coin, the inscription ‘FINLAND — UN’ appears on the left and the year of issue on the right. Above the last figure of the year of issue, set close to the edge of a piece of the jigsaw puzzle, is the letter ‘K’, the engraver's initial. The mintmark ‘M’ is inscribed immediately below the image of the dove of peace. The outer ring features the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币中央图案为一幅拼图碎片，拼成一只和平鸽。和平鸽图案下方，沿着硬币中央部分下半部分的边缘，左侧刻有“芬兰—联合国”字样，右侧刻有发行年份。在发行年份最后一个数字上方，靠近拼图碎片边缘处，刻有字母“K”，这是雕刻师的姓名首字母。造币厂标记“M”紧邻和平鸽图案下方。外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 50th anniversary of the Austrian State Treaty
description_en: The centre of the coin shows a reproduction of the signatures and seals in the Austrian State Treaty, which was signed by the foreign ministers and ambassadors of the Soviet Union, the United Kingdom, the United States and France, and by Leopold Figl, Foreign Minister of Austria, in May 1955. The inscription ‘50 JAHRE STAATSVERTRAG' appears above the seals and the year of issue, 2005, below them. The vertical stripes in the background represent Austria's national colours (red-white-red). The outer ring of the coin features the 12 stars of the EU.
description_zh: 硬币中心图案为奥地利国家条约的签名和印章复制品，该条约由苏联、英国、美国和法国的外交部长和大使以及奥地利外交部长利奥波德·菲格尔于1955年5月签署。印章上方刻有“50 JAHRE STAATSVERTRAG”（奥地利国家条约签署50周年）字样，下方为发行年份2005年。背景中的竖条纹代表奥地利国旗颜色（红-白-红）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 4th centenary of the first edition of Miguel de Cervantes’ 'The ingenious gentleman Don Quixote of La Mancha'
description_en: The centre of the coin features an image of Don Quixote holding a lance, with windmills in the background. To the left, impressed into the surface of the coin, is the word 'ESPAÑA', under which the mintmark 'M' appears. The 12 stars of the European Union are shown in the outer ring of the coin, with four of them impressed into the surface. The year of issue is indicated at the bottom.
description_zh: 硬币中央是唐吉诃德手持长矛的图案，背景是风车。左侧，硬币表面压印着“ESPAÑA”字样，下方是造币厂标记“M”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星，其中四颗压印在表面。发行年份标示在底部。

title: Belgium-Luxembourg Economic Union
description_en: The effigies of Grand Duke Henri of Luxembourg and King Albert II of Belgium are depicted in profile (from left to right) in the centre of the coin, above the year of issue, 2005. The engraver's initials, ‘LL', appear to the lower right. The two effigies and the date are surrounded by the outer ring bearing the 12 stars of the EU and the monograms of Grand Duke Henri on the left and of King Albert II on the right. The mintmarks appear between two stars near the bottom of the coin.
description_zh: 卢森堡大公亨利和比利时国王阿尔贝二世的侧面像（从左至右）位于硬币中央，上方是发行年份2005。雕刻师的姓名首字母“LL”位于右下角。两位肖像和年份被一圈外环环绕，外环上饰有欧盟的12颗星，左侧是卢森堡大公亨利的姓名缩写，右侧是比利时国王阿尔贝二世的姓名缩写。造币厂标记位于硬币底部附近的两颗星之间。

title: 50th birthday of Grand Duke Henri, 5th anniversary of his accession to the throne and 100th anniversary of the death of Grand Duke Adolphe
description_en: Depicted in the centre of the coin is the effigy of Grand Duke Henri, looking to the right and superimposed on the effigy of Grand Duke Adolphe. Above the effigies appears the legend ‘GRANDS-DUCS DE LUXEMBOURG’. The names ‘HENRI’, set above ‘*1955’, and ‘ADOLPHE’, set above ‘†1905’, are inscribed below the respective effigies. On the outer ring of the coin, the 12 stars of the EU surrounding the design are placed between the letters of the word ‘LËTZEBUERG’ and the year of issue, 2005, with the latter centred below the effigies and flanked by the letter ‘S’ on the left and the logo of the mint on the right.
description_zh: 硬币中央是亨利大公的肖像，他面向右侧，肖像叠加在阿道夫大公的肖像之上。肖像上方刻有“卢森堡大公”（GRANDS-DUCS DE LUXEMBOURG）字样。肖像下方分别镌刻着“亨利”（HENRI）和“阿道夫”（ADOLPHE）的姓名，下方为“1955年*”和“1905年†”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星，这些星位于“卢森堡”（LËTZEBUERG）字样和发行年份“2005”之间。年份“2005”位于肖像下方中央，左侧为字母“S”，右侧为造币厂标志。

title: 5th Centenary of the Swiss Pontifical Guard
description_en: The coin features a Swiss guard taking an oath of loyalty to the Pope. The inscription ‘GUARDIA SVIZZERA PONTIFICIA’ forms a semi-circle around the guard, while under the flag appears the name of the issuing state, ‘CITTÀ DEL VATICANO’. ‘1506’ appears on the left side, above the signature of the engraver ‘O. ROSSI’ along the flagpole. ‘2006’ appears on the right side, above the mint mark ‘R’. The 12 stars of the European Union are depicted on the outer ring.
description_zh: 这枚硬币正面图案为一名瑞士卫兵向教皇宣誓效忠。卫兵周围环绕着半圆形的“GUARDIA SVIZZERA PONTIFICIA”（瑞士教皇卫队）字样，旗帜下方是发行国名称“CITTÀ DEL VATICANO”（梵蒂冈城）。左侧旗杆上方刻有“1506”字样，下方是雕刻师“O. ROSSI”的签名。右侧铸币厂标记“R”上方刻有“2006”字样。外环上绘有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 500th anniversary of Christopher Columbus' death
description_en: The coin shows Christopher Columbus and three caravels. The inscription ‘SAN MARINO’ appears above his portrait, and a wind rose and the mint mark ‘R’ to the right. The dates ‘1506 — 2006’ are shown on a scroll below his portrait. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币正面是克里斯托弗·哥伦布和三艘卡拉维尔帆船的图案。哥伦布肖像上方刻有“圣马力诺”字样，右侧是风向玫瑰图和造币厂标记“R”。肖像下方的卷轴上刻有“1506—2006”字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 100th anniversary of universal and equal suffrage
description_en: The inner part of the coin shows male and female faces separated by a line. To their left is ‘1.10.1906’ and to their right is ‘20 FI 06’, the year of issue with the abbreviation for Finland, FI. The mint mark ‘M’ appears next to each of the two faces. The 12 stars of the European Union are depicted on the outer ring of the coin.
description_zh: 硬币内圈图案为一男一女两张人像，中间以一条线隔开。人像左侧刻有“1.10.1906”，右侧刻有“20 FI 06”，即发行年份及芬兰缩写“FI”。每张人像旁均有造币厂标记“M”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Atomium
description_en: An image of Atomium is shown in the centre of the coin and the engraver’s initials ‘LL’ to its right. Two mintmarks appear near its base. The outer ring of the coin features the 12 stars of the European Union, the letter ‘B’ and the year of mintage ‘2006’.
description_zh: 硬币中央是原子球塔的图案，右侧是雕刻师的姓名首字母“LL”。硬币底部附近有两个造币厂标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星、字母“B”和铸造年份“2006”。

title: Schleswig-Holstein
description_en: The Holstentor, the gate symbolising of the town of Lübeck, is shown in the centre of the coin and below it the word ‘Schleswig-Holstein’, the first of Germany’s 16 federal states to be commemorated in a euro coin. The engraver’s initials ‘HH’ appear to the right of the image and the mintmark ‘A’, ‘D’, ‘F’, ‘G’ or ‘J’, depending on the mint, to the left. The year of mintage, 2006, the 12 stars of the European Union and the words ‘Bundesrepublik Deutschland’ are shown in the outer ring.
description_zh: 硬币中央是象征吕贝克城的霍尔斯滕门，门下方是“石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因”字样，这是德国16个联邦州中第一个被印在欧元硬币上的州。雕刻师的姓名首字母“HH”位于图案右侧，左侧则是造币厂的标记“A”、“D”、“F”、“G”或“J”（取决于造币厂）。硬币外圈刻有铸造年份2006年、欧盟12颗星以及“德国联邦共和国”（Bundesrepublik Deutschland）字样。

title: XX Olympic Winter Games - Turin 2006
description_en: An image of a skier, a dynamic, curvilinear figure, is in the centre of the coin. Above him are the words ‘GIOCHI INVERNALI’ and to his left the location of the Winter Games is marked by the word ‘TORINO’ and an image of Turin’s landmark Mole Antonelliana building. The monogram of the Italian Republic ‘RI’ and the mintmark ‘R’ are also to the skier’s left. The year of issue, 2006, and the initials of the designer ‘MCC’ (Maria Carmela Colaneri) are shown to his right. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币中央是一位滑雪者的形象，他身姿矫健，线条流畅。滑雪者上方是“GIOCHI INVERNALI”（冬季运动会）字样，左侧是冬奥会举办地“TORINO”（都灵）字样以及都灵地标性建筑安托内利尖塔的图案。意大利共和国的缩写“RI”和造币厂标记“R”也位于滑雪者的左侧。发行年份“2006”和设计师姓名首字母“MCC”（Maria Carmela Colaneri）则位于滑雪者的右侧。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 25th birthday of Grand-Duke Guillaume, heir to the throne
description_en: The effigy of Grand-Duke Henri is superimposed on that of Grand-Duke Guillaume in the centre of the coin. The year of issue, 2006, appears below the effigies, flanked by the letter ‘S’ and the mintmark. The word ‘LËTZEBUERG’ appears above the effigies. The 12 stars of the European Union are shown in the outer ring of the coin.
description_zh: 硬币中央，亨利大公的肖像叠加在纪尧姆大公的肖像之上。发行年份2006位于肖像下方，两侧分别是字母“S”和造币厂标记。肖像上方是“LËTZEBUERG”（莱特岛）字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 90th anniversary of Finland’s independence
description_en: The coin shows a nine-oar boat with rowers, symbolising collaboration. The year of issue, 2007, and the year of independence, 1917, appear above and below the image, respectively. The mint mark appears to the left of the oars and ‘FI’ for Finland to the right. The outer ring of the coin features the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币正面图案为一艘九桨船，象征着合作。发行年份2007年和芬兰独立年份1917年分别位于图案上方和下方。造币厂标记位于船桨左侧，芬兰的“FI”字样位于右侧。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Bicentenary of the birth of Giuseppe Garibaldi
description_en: The inner part of the coin features the engraving of a portrait of Giuseppe Garibaldi. The words ‘SAN MARINO’ and the year of issue (2007) are inscribed along the outer edge of the inner part on the left and right of the portrait respectively. The mint mark (R) is inscribed to the left of the portrait, while the initials of the artist Ettore Lorenzo Frapiccini (E.L.F.) appear on the lower left-hand edge of the inner part. The 12 stars of the European Union are depicted on the outer ring.
description_zh: 硬币内圈镌刻着朱塞佩·加里波第的肖像。肖像左侧和右侧分别沿内圈外缘刻有“SAN MARINO”（圣马力诺）字样和发行年份（2007）。造币厂标记（R）位于肖像左侧，而艺术家埃托雷·洛伦佐·弗拉皮奇尼（E.L.F.）的姓名首字母缩写则位于内圈左下角。外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 80th birthday of His Holiness Pope Benedict XVI
description_en: The inner part of the coin features the profile of His Holiness Benedict XVI facing the left. The legend ‘BENEDICTI XVI P.M. AETATIS ANNO LXXX CITTA' DEL VATICANO’ is engraved along the outer edge of the inner part of the coin. To the left of the effigy are the mintmark, ‘R’, the year of issue, ‘2007’, and the initials of the engraver, ‘M.C.C. INC.’, while the artist’s name, ‘LONGO’, is inscribed on the right. The outer ring of the coin bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈为教宗本笃十六世的侧面像，面向左侧。内圈外缘镌刻有“BENEDICTI XVI P.M. AETATIS ANNO LXXX CITTA' DEL VATICANO”（梵蒂冈城本笃十六世，教宗在位80年）字样。人像左侧为造币厂标记“R”、发行年份“2007”和雕刻师姓名缩写“M.C.C. INC.”，右侧则镌刻有艺术家姓名“LONGO”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 25th anniversary of the death of Princess Grace
description_en: The coin features an effigy of Princess Grace, to the right of which appear the word ‘MONACO’, the mint mark, the year ‘2007’ and the engraver’s mark. The name of the artist, ‘R.B.BARON’, is shown under the Princess’s hair. The 12 stars of the European Union are depicted on the outer ring of the coin.
description_zh: 这枚硬币正面是格蕾丝王妃的肖像，肖像右侧是“摩纳哥”字样、造币厂标记、年份“2007”以及雕刻师标记。艺术家“R.B.BARON”的名字位于王妃的头发下方。硬币外圈刻有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Portuguese Presidency of the European Union
description_en: The inner part of the coin features a cork oak (quercus suber). The Coat of Arms of Portugal is depicted beneath the lower branches to the left of the trunk, while the word “PORTUGAL”, written over three lines, appears on the right. Inscribed in the form of an arc along the edge of the inner part of the coin below the tree are the artist’s signature (I. Vilar), the year of issue (2007), the mintmark (INCM) and the legend “PRESIDÊNCIA DO CONSELHO DA UE”. The outer ring of the coin bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈图案为一棵栓皮栎（Quercus suber）。葡萄牙国徽位于树干左侧下方的树枝下方，右侧则以三行文字书写着“PORTUGAL”（葡萄牙）字样。在硬币内圈边缘，树下呈弧形排列着艺术家签名（I. Vilar）、发行年份（2007）、造币厂标记（INCM）以及“PRESIDÊNCIA DO CONSELHO DA UE”（欧盟理事会主席）字样。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 50th anniversary of the Treaty of Rome
description_en: The coin shows the Treaty document signed by the six founding countries on a background evoking the paving (designed by Michelangelo) of the Piazza del Campidoglio in Rome, where the signing took place on 25 March 1957. ‘Treaty of Rome 50 years’, ‘EUROPE’ and the name of the issuing country appear in the respective languages of the euro area or in Latin. Thus, the legend differs from country to country, but the image is the same. The Treaty of Rome established the European Economic Community and ultimately led to the introduction of the euro in 1999 and the euro banknotes and coins in 2002. The anniversary was celebrated on 25 March 2007. The euro area countries have marked the occasion by jointly issuing this commemorative coin. Its design was selected following a competition organised by the European mints. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚纪念币以罗马卡比托利欧广场（米开朗基罗设计）的铺路石为背景，展现了六个创始国签署的《罗马条约》文件。1957年3月25日，条约正是在此签署的。“罗马条约50周年”、“欧洲”以及发行国的名称分别以欧元区各国的官方语言或拉丁文呈现。因此，各国的铭文有所不同，但图案相同。《罗马条约》建立了欧洲经济共同体，并最终促成了1999年欧元的发行以及2002年欧元纸币和硬币的发行。2007年3月25日是该条约签署50周年纪念日。欧元区各国联合发行了这枚纪念币以示纪念。该纪念币的设计方案是通过欧洲各造币厂组织的竞赛选出的。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern
description_en: The coin shows Schwerin Castle and bears the inscription ‘Mecklenburg-Vorpommern’ - the federal state of Mecklenburg-West Pomerania where the castle is located. The mintmark, ‘A’, ‘D’, ‘F’, ‘G’ or ‘J’, appears above the image, and the engraver’s initials ‘HH’ below it. The year of mintage, 2007, the 12 stars of the European Union and the words ‘Bundesrepublik Deutschland’ appear in the outer ring.
description_zh: 这枚硬币正面图案为什未林城堡，并刻有“梅克伦堡-前波莫瑞”字样——即城堡所在的梅克伦堡-前波莫瑞州。造币厂标记“A”、“D”、“F”、“G”或“J”位于图案上方，下方是雕刻师的姓名首字母“HH”。外圈刻有铸造年份2007、欧盟十二星以及“德国联邦共和国”（Bundesrepublik Deutschland）字样。

title: Grand Ducal Palace
description_en: The coin features an effigy of Grand-Duke Henri superimposed on an image of the Grand Ducal Palace. The year of issue, 2007, appears to the left, with the engraver's mark above and the mint mark below. The word ‘LËTZEBUERG’ appears at the base of the design. The 12 stars of the European Union are shown on the outer ring of the coin.
description_zh: 这枚硬币正面是亨利大公的肖像，叠加在大公宫的图案上。发行年份2007位于左侧，上方是雕刻师标记，下方是造币厂标记。图案底部刻有“LËTZEBUERG”（莱特岛）字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The Year of St. Paul – the 2000th anniversary of his birth
description_en: The coin depicts the conversion of Paul on the road to Damascus, which is visible in the background. Dazzled by a light from the sky, he falls from his rearing horse. To the left of the image is an inscription denoting the issuing country ‘CITTÀ DEL VATICANO’, and to the right the legend ‘ANNO SANCTO PAULO DICATO’, as well as the year ‘2008’, the mint mark ‘R’ and the artist’s name ‘VEROI’. The initials of the engraver ‘L.D.S. INC.’, Luciana De Simoni, appear beneath the image. The outer ring of the coin shows the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币描绘了保罗在前往大马士革的路上皈依基督教的场景，大马士革的景色在背景中清晰可见。他被一道天光刺得睁不开眼，从跃起的马上跌落。图像左侧刻有发行国“梵蒂冈城”（CITTÀ DEL VATICANO），右侧刻有“圣保罗纪念年”（ANNO SANCTO PAULO DICATO）、年份“2008”、造币厂标记“R”以及艺术家姓名“VEROI”。雕刻师“L.D.S. INC.”和卢西亚娜·德·西蒙尼（Luciana De Simoni）的姓名缩写位于图像下方。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 60th anniversary of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights
description_en: Designed by sculptor Tapio Kettunen, the coin depicts a human being inside a heart and, underneath it, the inscription ‘HUMAN RIGHTS’. ‘FI’ for Finland, ‘K’ for the sculptor as well as the mint mark appear at the bottom of the inner part of the coin, and the year of issue, 2008, at the top. The 12 stars of the European Union are shown on the outer ring.
description_zh: 这枚硬币由雕塑家塔皮奥·凯图宁设计，图案为一颗心形内嵌一个人像，下方镌刻着“人权”字样。硬币内侧底部刻有芬兰国徽“FI”、雕塑家姓名缩写“K”以及造币厂标记，顶部则为发行年份2008。外圈饰有欧盟十二星标志。

title: 60th anniversary of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights
description_en: The coin shows the Portuguese coat of arms at the top, with the name of the issuing country (‘PORTUGAL’) and the year ‘2008’ just below. The lower half of the coin features a geometric design and the legend ‘60 ANOS DA DECLARAÇÃO UNIVERSAL DOS DIREITOS HUMANOS’, followed by the inscription ‘Esc. J. Duarte INCM’ in very small characters. The outer ring of the coin shows the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币顶部是葡萄牙国徽，下方是发行国名称“PORTUGAL”（葡萄牙）和年份“2008”。硬币下半部分为几何图案，并刻有“60 ANOS DA DECLARAÇÃO UNIVERSAL DOS DIREITOS HUMANOS”（人类权利宣言60周年）字样，其后以极小的字体镌刻着“Esc. J. Duarte INCM”（J. Duarte 先生，INCM 造币厂）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: French Presidency of the Council of the European Union in the second half of 2008
description_en: The coin is inscribed as follows: ‘2008 PRÉSIDENCE FRANÇAISE UNION EUROPÉENNE RF’. The mint mark and the mintmaster's mark are located below, to the left and the right respectively. The 12 stars of the European Union are shown on the outer ring.
description_zh: 硬币上刻有“2008 PRESIDENCE FRANÇAISE UNION EUROPÉENNE RF”字样。造币厂标记和造币厂厂长标记分别位于下方左侧和右侧。欧盟的12颗星位于外环上。

title: 500th anniversary of Primož Trubar's birth
description_en: The coin shows an effigy of Primož Trubar in profile. The inscriptions ‘PRIMOŽ TRUBAR’ and ‘1508 • 1586’ appear on the left, and ‘SLOVENIJA 2008’ at bottom right. The 12 stars of the European Union are depicted on the outer ring.
description_zh: 这枚硬币正面是普里莫兹·特鲁巴尔的侧面肖像。左侧刻有“PRIMOŽ TRUBAR”和“1508 • 1586”字样，右下角刻有“SLOVENIJA 2008”字样。外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 60th anniversary of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights
description_en: The coin shows curved lines around a rectangle marked with the figure 60. The year ‘2008’ is inscribed above the rectangle and the words ‘UNIVERSAL DECLARATION OF HUMAN RIGHTS’ underneath it. The name of the country appears below the design in its three official languages: ‘BELGIE – BELGIQUE – BELGIEN’. The mintmark and the signature mark of the Master of the Mint are shown to the left and right of the design respectively. The outer ring of the coin features the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币图案为一个矩形，矩形上标有数字“60”，周围环绕着弧线。矩形上方刻有年份“2008”，下方刻有“世界人权宣言”。国名“BELGIE – BELGIQUE – BELGIEN”以比利时的三种官方语言呈现在图案下方。造币厂标记和造币厂厂长的签名分别位于图案的左侧和右侧。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: European Year of Intercultural Dialogue
description_en: The coin shows five human silhouettes symbolising the cultures of the five regions in Europe, together with the sacred texts of the different communities. The inscription ‘ANNO EUROPEO DEL DIALOGO INTERCULTURALE’ appears below the motif, while ‘SAN MARINO’, and the year of issue ‘2008’ appear above it. The initials of the artist ‘E.L.F.’, Ettore Lorenzo Frapiccini, are shown to the right of the motif, and the mint mark ‘R’ to the left. The coin’s outer ring contains the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币正面图案为五个象征欧洲五大区域文化的剪影，下方是各社群的圣典。图案下方刻有“ANNO EUROPEO DEL DIALOGO INTERCULTURALE”（欧洲跨文化对话年）字样，上方则为“SAN MARINO”（圣马力诺）字样和发行年份“2008”。图案右侧是艺术家埃托雷·洛伦佐·弗拉皮奇尼（Ettore Lorenzo Frapiccini）的姓名首字母“E.L.F.”，左侧是造币厂标记“R”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 60th anniversary of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights
description_en: The coin depicts a man and a woman with an olive branch, an ear of corn, a cogwheel and some barbed wire – symbols of the right to peace, food, work and freedom respectively. The monogram of the Italian Republic ‘RI’ is placed between the two figures, as is the year of issue ‘2008’. At the bottom of the image are the links of a chain forming the number ‘60’ and the inscription ‘DIRITTI UMANI’ (human rights). The initials ‘MCC’ of the artist Maria Carmela Colaneri and the mint mark ‘R’ are shown on the right. The outer ring of the coin depicts the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币描绘了一男一女，他们手持橄榄枝、玉米穗、齿轮和铁丝网——分别象征着和平、食物、工作和自由的权利。意大利共和国的缩写“RI”位于两人之间，发行年份“2008”也位于此处。图案底部是组成数字“60”的链条，以及“DIRITTI UMANI”（人权）的铭文。右侧是艺术家玛丽亚·卡梅拉·科拉内里（Maria Carmela Colaneri）的姓名首字母“MCC”和造币厂标记“R”。硬币外圈是欧盟的12颗星。

title: Grand-Duke Henri and the ‘Château de Berg’
description_en: The coin shows Grand-Duke Henri and the ‘Château de Berg’, the official residence. The year of issue, 2008, flanked by the mint mark and the mark of the engraving workshop, is inscribed at the top. The word ‘LËTZEBUERG’ appears at the bottom of the design. The outer ring of the coin depicts the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币正面是亨利大公和他的官邸“贝格城堡”（Château de Berg）的图案。发行年份2008年，两侧分别是造币厂标记和雕刻工坊标记，位于硬币顶部。底部是“莱茨堡”（LËTZEBUERG）字样。硬币外圈是欧盟的12颗星。

title: Federal state of Hamburg
description_en: The coin depicts the baroque church of St. Michaelis, or “Michel” as it is popularly known. It is a symbol of the city and federal state of Hamburg, as the inscription below the image indicates. The year of issue, 2008, the 12 stars of the European Union and the words ‘BUNDESREPUBLIK DEUTSCHLAND’ appear on the outer ring. The mintmark is shown in the upper right part of the coin.
description_zh: 这枚硬币描绘了巴洛克风格的圣米迦勒教堂，俗称“米歇尔教堂”。正如图案下方的铭文所示，它是汉堡市和汉堡联邦州的象征。外圈刻有发行年份2008年、欧盟12颗星以及“德国联邦共和国”（BUNDESREPUBLIK DEUTSCHLAND）字样。造币厂标记位于硬币右上角。

title: 20th anniversary of 17 November 1989 (Day of the fight for freedom and democracy)
description_en: The coin shows a stylised bell with keys serving as clappers. It recalls the demonstration on 17 November 1989 when protesters jangled their keys to symbolise the unlocking of doors, an event which marked the beginning of the ‘Velvet Revolution’ in Czechoslovakia, as it then was. Under the bell are the artist’s mark and the mint mark of Mincovňa Kremnica (the Slovak mint). Encircling the bell are the legend ‘17. NOVEMBER SLOBODA DEMOKRACIA’, the dates ‘1989-2009’ and the name of the issuing country, ‘SLOVENSKO’. The coin’s outer ring depicts the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币正面是一口风格化的铃铛，铃舌由钥匙构成。它纪念1989年11月17日的示威游行，当时抗议者摇晃钥匙象征着打开大门，这一事件标志着当时捷克斯洛伐克“天鹅绒革命”的开始。铃铛下方是艺术家签名和斯洛伐克造币厂（Mincovňa Kremnica）的造币厂标记。环绕铃铛的是“17. NOVEMBER SLOBODA DEMOKRACIA”（17. NOVEMBER SLOBODA DEMOKRACIA，自由民主的17日）字样、年份“1989-2009”以及发行国“斯洛伐克”（SLOVENSKO）。硬币外圈是欧盟的12颗星。

title: 200th anniversary of Finnish autonomy and Porvoo Diet
description_en: The first Diet of Finland met in 1809 in Porvoo, so the coin shows a profile of Porvoo cathedral, where the opening ceremony took place, and ‘1809’ written in stylised numbering above. To its left is the country code, ‘FI’, and to its right is the year of issue, ‘2009’. The 12 stars of the European Union appear on the outer ring.
description_zh: 芬兰第一届议会于1809年在波尔沃召开，因此硬币正面图案为波尔沃大教堂的侧面像，议会开幕式就在这里举行，上方以程式化的数字“1809”标注。左侧是国家代码“FI”，右侧是发行年份“2009”。欧盟的12颗星位于硬币外圈。

title: International Year of Astronomy
description_en: This coin was issued on the occasion of the International Year of Astronomy. The inner part of the coin depicts an allegory of the birth of the stars and planets together with several astronomical instruments. The design is inspired by Michelangelo's frescoes in the Sistine Chapel. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币是为纪念国际天文年而发行的。硬币内圈描绘了恒星和行星诞生的寓言故事，并配以多种天文仪器。其设计灵感源自米开朗基罗在西斯廷教堂的壁画。硬币外圈则饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 200th anniversary of Louis Braille’s birth
description_en: The coin depicts a hand reading an open book by touch. The index finger points at a vertical inscription ‘LOUIS BRAILLE 1809-2009’ and two birds in flight above the hand symbolise freedom of knowledge. The monogram of the Italian Republic, ‘RI’, is at the top right, while the mint mark ‘R’ is at the bottom right. Braille’s name is written under the book in the alphabet that he invented. At the very bottom are the initials ‘MCC’ of the artist Maria Carmela Colaneri. The 12 stars of the European Union are shown on the outer ring.
description_zh: 这枚硬币描绘了一只手正在用手指触摸阅读一本打开的书。食指指向垂直铭文“路易·布莱叶 1809-2009”，手上方两只飞鸟象征着知识的自由。意大利共和国的缩写“RI”位于右上角，造币厂标记“R”位于右下角。布莱叶的名字以他发明的字母书写在书的下方。最底部是艺术家玛丽亚·卡梅拉·科拉内里（Maria Carmela Colaneri）的姓名首字母“MCC”。外环上饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 200th anniversary of Louis Braille’s birth
description_en: The coin features a portrait of Louis Braille with his initials, L and B, in the alphabet that he designed. His name appears above the portrait and, below it, the code of the issuing country, ‘BE’ and the dates ‘1809’ and ‘2009’. To the left and right respectively are the mint mark and the signature mark of the Master of the Mint. The coin’s outer ring shows the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币正面是路易·布莱叶的肖像，以及他设计的字母表的首字母 L 和 B。他的名字位于肖像上方，下方是发行国代码“BE”以及年份“1809”和“2009”。左侧和右侧分别是造币厂标记和造币厂厂长的签名标记。硬币外圈是欧盟的12颗星。

title: 2nd Lusophone Games
description_en: The coin was issued to mark the games held for Portuguese-speaking countries. It depicts a gymnast swirling a long ribbon. The Portuguese coat of arms appears at the top together with the name of the issuing country ‘PORTUGAL’. At the bottom, the legend ‘2.os JOGOS DA LUSOFONIA LISBOA’ is inscribed between the initials ‘INCM’ on the left and the artist's name ‘J. AURÉLIO’ on the right. The year ‘2009’ appears above the gymnast. The coin's outer ring shows the 12 stars of the European Union on a background of concentric circular lines.
description_zh: 这枚纪念币是为了纪念为葡语国家举办的运动会而发行的。币面图案是一位挥舞长彩带的体操运动员。葡萄牙国徽位于币面顶部，国名“PORTUGAL”（葡萄牙）也位于顶部。底部左侧是“INCM”（国际运动会联合会）的缩写，右侧是艺术家“J. AURÉLIO”（J.奥雷利奥）的名字，中间刻有“2.os JOGOS DA LUSOFONIA LISBOA”（里斯本葡语运动会2届）字样。体操运动员上方是年份“2009”。硬币外圈是欧盟的12颗星，背景为同心圆纹。

title: European Year of Creativity and Innovation
description_en: The coin shows some symbols of scientific research: a book, a compass, a test tube and a flask. On the left are the three emblematic feathers of the Republic of San Marino. On the right are the year ‘2009’ and the mint mark ‘R’. Above is the legend ‘CREATIVITÀ INNOVAZIONE’. Below are the name of the issuing country ‘SAN MARINO’ and the artist’s initials ‘A.M.’. The coin’s outer ring depicts the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币上展现了一些科学研究的象征符号：书籍、指南针、试管和烧瓶。左侧是圣马力诺共和国的三根象征性羽毛。右侧是年份“2009”和造币厂标记“R”。上方是铭文“CREATIVITÀ INNOVAZIONE”（创新精神）。下方是发行国“SAN MARINO”（圣马力诺）和艺术家姓名缩写“A.M.”。硬币外圈描绘了欧盟的12颗星。

title: Federal state of Saarland
description_en: The coin features the Ludwigskirche, a symbol of Saarbrücken, the capital of the Saarland. It shows the distinctive east facade and bell tower of the church, with the word ‘SAARLAND’ and ‘G’, a mint mark, underneath. It was designed by Friedrich Brenner, whose initials appear to the right of the image. The year of mintage, 2009, the 12 stars of the European Union and the words ‘BUNDESREPUBLIK DEUTSCHLAND’ are depicted on the outer ring.
description_zh: 这枚硬币以萨尔州首府萨尔布吕肯的标志性建筑——路德维希教堂为主题。硬币展现了教堂独特的东立面和钟楼，下方刻有“SAARLAND”（萨尔州）字样和造币厂标记“G”。硬币由弗里德里希·布伦纳设计，其姓名首字母位于图案右侧。外圈刻有铸造年份2009、欧盟十二星以及“BUNDESREPUBLIK DEUTSCHLAND”（德意志联邦共和国）字样。

title: 10th anniversary of Economic and Monetary Union
description_en: The coin shows a stick figure which merges into the € symbol. It seeks to convey the idea of the single currency and, by extension, Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) being the latest step in Europe’s long history of trade and economic integration. The coin is issued by each euro area country and shows the name of the country as well as the legend ‘EMU 1999-2009’ in the respective language(s). The design was chosen out of a shortlist of five by members of the public across the European Union voting online. It was created by George Stamatopoulos, a sculptor from the Minting department at the Bank of Greece. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币的图案是一个简笔画小人，最终融入欧元符号€。它旨在传达单一货币的概念，并由此延伸出经济与货币联盟（EMU）是欧洲漫长贸易和经济一体化历史中的最新一步。该硬币由欧元区各成员国发行，上面印有该国名称以及相应语言的“EMU 1999-2009”字样。该设计由欧盟公众通过网络投票从五个候选方案中选出，由希腊银行造币部门的雕塑家乔治·斯塔马托普洛斯（George Stamatopoulos）创作。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Grand-Duke Henri and Grand-Duchess Charlotte
description_en: The coin features Grand-Duke Henri and Grand-Duchess Charlotte. To the right of the image, placed vertically, are the word ‘LËTZEBUERG’ and the year ‘2009’, flanked by the mintmaster’s mark and the mint mark. The outer ring of the coin shows the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币正面是亨利大公和夏洛特大公夫人的肖像。肖像右侧竖排刻有“LËTZEBUERG”（莱茨堡）字样和年份“2009”，两侧分别是造币厂厂长标记和造币厂标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 2.500th anniversary of the Battle of Marathon
description_en: The coin commemorates the 2.500th anniversary of the Battle of Marathon. The centre of the coin shows a synthesis of a shield and a runner/warrior representing the struggle for freedom and the noble ideals that the Battle of Marathon stands for. The bird on the shield symbolises the birth of Western civilisation in its present form. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币是为了纪念马拉松战役2500周年而发行的。硬币中心图案融合了盾牌和奔跑者/战士的形象，象征着为自由而战的精神以及马拉松战役所代表的崇高理想。盾牌上的鸟象征着西方文明以现代形式诞生。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Year for Priests
description_en: The coin commemorates the Year for Priests, proclaimed by Pope Benedict XVI to run from of 19 June 2009 to 19 June 2010, that was concluded with an international gathering of priests attended by the pope. The coin features a shepherd pulling a lamb from a lion’s mouth. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币是为了纪念教宗本笃十六世宣布的“神父年”（2009年6月19日至2010年6月19日），该年以教宗出席的国际神父大会落下帷幕。硬币图案是一位牧羊人从狮子口中救出一只羔羊。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Currency Decree of 1860 granting Finland the right to issue banknotes and coins
description_en: The design of the inner part of the coin comprises a stylised figure of a lion, taken from Finland’s coat of arms, and the year of issue, i.e. ‘2010’, on the left, with the mintmark and a set of numbers symbolising coin values to the right thereof. Centred at the bottom edge is a reference to the issuing country, namely the letters ‘FI’. The coin’s outer ring depicts the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈的设计包括一尊风格化的狮子图案（取自芬兰国徽）和发行年份（即“2010”），位于左侧；右侧是造币厂标记和代表硬币面值的数字。底部中央边缘是发行国“FI”的标识。硬币外圈描绘了欧盟的12颗星。

title: 500th anniversary of the death of Sandro Botticelli
description_en: The coin commemorates the 500th anniversary of the death of Alessandro di Mariano di Vanni Filipepi (1445 – 1510), the Italian painter of the Florentine school who is better known as Sandro Botticelli or Il Botticello ("The Little Barrel"). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币是为了纪念亚历山德罗·迪·马里亚诺·迪·瓦尼·菲利佩皮（1445-1510）逝世500周年而发行的。他是佛罗伦萨画派的意大利画家，更为人熟知的名字是桑德罗·波提切利或“小木桶”（Il Botticello）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 100th anniversary of the Portuguese Republic
description_en: The coin commemorates the 100th anniversary of the end of the constitutional monarchy of King Manuel II and the establishment of the Portuguese Republic following the revolution of 5 October 1910. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币是为了纪念曼努埃尔二世国王的君主立宪制结束100周年以及1910年10月5日革命后葡萄牙共和国的建立而发行的。硬币的外环上印有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 70th anniversary of the Appeal of June 18
description_en: The coin commemorates the 70th anniversary of the appeal (“Appel du 18 juin”) made by General de Gaulle – the leader of the Free French Forces – on the BBC in London on 18 June 1940, after the fall of France. Addressing the French people, de Gaulle declared that the war was not yet over. The speech is considered to mark the birth of the French Resistance and the beginning of its fight against the occupation of France during World War II. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币是为了纪念戴高乐将军于1940年6月18日在伦敦通过BBC发表的“六月十八日呼吁”（Appel du 18 juin）70周年而发行的。当时，法国刚刚沦陷。戴高乐将军在讲话中向法国人民宣布，战争尚未结束。这次讲话被认为是法国抵抗运动的开端，标志着法国抵抗运动开始反抗二战期间法国的占领。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Belgian Presidency of the Council of the European Union in 2010
description_en: The inner part of the coin features the commemorative logo, i.e. the stylised letters “EU” and “trio.be”. The central design is encircled by the words “BELGIAN PRESIDENCY OF THE COUNCIL OF THE EU 2010” and the trilingual country designation ‘BELGIE BELGIQUE BELGIEN’. Beneath the logo and above the country’s name, the year of issue, i.e. “2010”, is centred between the mint mark on the left and the mint master’s mark on the right. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈为纪念标志，即风格化的“EU”和“trio.be”字样。中心图案周围环绕着“比利时担任欧盟理事会轮值主席国 2010”字样以及比利时三语国名“BELGIE BELGIQUE BELGIEN”。标志下方、国名上方为发行年份“2010”，位于左侧造币厂标记和右侧造币厂厂长标记之间。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 200th anniversary of the Botanical Garden in Ljubljana
description_en: The inner part of the coin depicts the Rebrinčevolistna Hladnikija plant. On the left beneath the plant is its name, “HLADNIKIA PASTINACIFOLIA”, written in an arc. The image is encircled by the words “200 LET”, “BOTANIČNI VRT”, “LJUBLJANA” and “SLOVENIJA 2010”. The outer ring of the coin depicts the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈图案为雷布林切沃利斯特纳·赫拉德尼基亚（Rebrinčevol​​istna Hladnikija）植物。植物左下方以弧形字体书写着其名称“HLADNIKIA PASTINACIFOLIA”。图案周围环绕着“200 LET”、“BOTANIČNI VRT”、“LJUBLJANA”和“SLOVENIJA 2010”字样。硬币外圈图案为欧盟的12颗星。

title: Córdoba’s historic centre – UNESCO World Heritage series
description_en: The coin commemorates the historic centre of Cordoba, the first Spanish site to be included in UNESCO’s World Heritage List in 1984. It portrays the “forest of pillars” of the Great Mosque of Córdoba, one of the most significant and oldest examples of Islamic art in Europe. Built between the 8th and 10th centuries, the Mosque was later consecrated as a Christian cathedral and underwent a series of transformations. The coin is the first in a new series dedicated to the Spanish sites on the UNESCO’s World Heritage List. One such commemorative coin will be issued every year as from 2010. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚纪念币旨在纪念科尔多瓦历史中心，它是西班牙首个于1984年被列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录的遗址。硬币上描绘了科尔多瓦大清真寺的“柱林”，它是欧洲最重要、最古老的伊斯兰艺术典范之一。这座清真寺建于公元8至10世纪，后被改建为基督教大教堂，并经历了多次改造。这枚硬币是为纪念西班牙联合国教科文组织世界遗产而发行的全新系列纪念币的首枚。自2010年起，该系列纪念币每年发行一枚。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 200th anniversary of the Count of Cavour’s birth
description_en: The coin commemorates the 200th anniversary of the birth of Camillo Benso, Count of Cavour (1810-1861), a key figure in Italian unification and early Italian liberalism, and the founder of the political newspaper "Il Risorgimento". It features a portrait of Cavour based on a painting by Francesco Hayez from 1864. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币是为了纪念卡米洛·本索，卡沃尔伯爵（1810-1861）诞辰200周年而铸造的。卡沃尔伯爵是意大利统一运动和早期意大利自由主义运动的关键人物，也是政治报纸《复兴报》（Il Risorgimento）的创办人。硬币正面是卡沃尔的肖像，其原型是弗朗切斯科·海耶兹于1864年创作的一幅画作。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Coat of arms of the Grand Duke
description_en: The inner part of the coin depicts, on the left, a portrait of Grand Duke Henri facing towards the right and, immediately adjacent, the Grand Duke’s coat of arms, above which the year of issue, 2010, is featured between mint marks, overlapping slightly into the outer ring. Below the portrait, the name of the issuing country, “LËTZEBUERG”, overlaps slightly into the outer ring. The coin’s outer ring depicts the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈左侧是亨利大公面向右侧的肖像，紧邻的是大公的纹章，纹章上方是发行年份2010，年份两侧是造币厂标记，略微延伸至外圈。肖像下方是发行国“莱茨堡”（LËTZEBUERG）的名称，也略微延伸至外圈。硬币外圈是欧盟的12颗星。

title: Federal state of Bremen
description_en: The inner part of the coin features the Town Hall of Bremen, with the Roland statue in the foreground. The word “BREMEN” is inscribed beneath the Town Hall to the right of the statue. The mint mark, represented by the letter “A”, “D”, “F”, “G” or “J”, appears at the left above the Town Hall. The initials of the artist, Bodo Broschat, are given at the very bottom, immediately below the statue. The name of the issuing country, “D”, and the year, “2010”, are inserted at the top and bottom of the outer ring of the coin respectively, interspersed between the twelve stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈图案为不来梅市政厅，前景是罗兰雕像。“BREMEN”字样刻于市政厅下方、雕像右侧。造币厂标记位于市政厅左上方，字母为“A”、“D”、“F”、“G”或“J”。艺术家博多·布罗沙特（Bodo Broschat）的姓名首字母缩写位于最下方，紧邻雕像下方。发行国名称“D”和年份“2010”分别位于硬币外圈的顶部和底部，穿插在欧盟十二颗星之间。

title: Constitutional history – first election of representatives in 1849
description_en: The inner part of this coin, the first of a series of five coins to be issued over a period of five years to mark major milestones in Malta’s constitutional history, features a hand inserting a ballot paper into the ballot box to commemorate the election in 1849 of the first Maltese representatives to the Council of Government advising the British Governor of Malta, which had been a British colony since the Treaty of Paris of 1814. The upper right outer edge of the inner part of the coin bears the words “MALTA – First elected representatives 1849”. The 12 stars of the European Union are depicted on the outer ring of the coin.
description_zh: 这枚硬币是为纪念马耳他宪政史上的重要里程碑而将在五年内发行的五枚系列硬币中的第一枚。硬币内页图案为一只手将选票投入投票箱，以纪念1849年马耳他首次当选为政府委员会成员。该委员会负责向马耳他英国总督提供建议，马耳他自1814年《巴黎条约》签订以来一直是英国的殖民地。硬币内页右上角外缘刻有“马耳他——1849年首届民选代表”字样。硬币外圈则饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 26th World Youth Day
description_en: The inner part of the coin features a number of young people and flags, together with the mintmark “R” and the year “2011”, surrounded, along the upper edge, by the Roman numerals “XXVI” and the letters “G.M.G.”, the abbreviation of Giornata Mondiale della Gioventù (World Youth Day), and by the name of the issuing country “CITTA’ DEL VATICANO” along the lower edge. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈图案为一群年轻人和旗帜，以及造币厂标记“R”和年份“2011”。上边缘环绕着罗马数字“XXVI”和字母“G.M.G.”，即世界青年日（Giornata Mondiale della Gioventù）的缩写；下边缘则印有发行国名称“CITTA’ DEL VATICANO”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 200th anniversary of the Bank of Finland
description_en: The commemorative coin to mark the Bank of Finland’s 200th anniversary, which was designed by the artist Hannu Veijalainen, depicts Finland’s national bird, the swan. In addition, the inner part of the coin bears the dates “2011”, the year of issue, and “1811”, the year in which Emperor Alexander I of Russia decreed that an “Exchange, Lending and Deposit Office” was to be established in Turku, Finland. It was Finland’s first bank and eventually became the Bank of Finland, which moved to Helsinki in 1819. The Bank began to operate as a central bank in the latter part of the 19th century, after Finland obtained its own monetary unit and commercial banks had been established in the country. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 为纪念芬兰银行成立200周年而发行的纪念币由艺术家汉努·维亚莱宁设计，币面图案为芬兰国鸟——天鹅。此外，硬币内圈刻有发行年份“2011”和年份“1811”。1811年，俄国沙皇亚历山大一世下令在芬兰图尔库设立“外汇、贷款和存款机构”。该机构是芬兰的第一家银行，最终发展成为芬兰银行，并于1819年迁至赫尔辛基。19世纪后期，芬兰获得自己的货币单位，商业银行也相继建立，芬兰银行开始作为中央银行运作。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 500th anniversary of Fernão Mendes Pinto’s birth
description_en: The inner part of the coin commemorating the 500th anniversary of the birth of Fernão Mendes Pinto, a Portuguese explorer whose book on his discoveries and adventures in the seas and countries of Asia was published posthumously under title “Peregrinação” (Pilgrimage), depicts a sailing ship floating on a sea formed by a series of wave-shaped references to Portugal, Lisbon, his book and some of the destinations of his travels, With the country designation “Portugal” centred beneath them. His name flanked by the dates “1511” and “2011” form a semicircle around the upper edge of the inner part. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚纪念币是为了纪念葡萄牙探险家费尔南·门德斯·平托诞辰500周年而铸造的。平托生前著有《朝圣之旅》（Peregrinação），记录了他探索亚洲海洋和国家的冒险经历，该书在他去世后出版。纪念币内圈图案为一艘帆船漂浮在由一系列波浪形图案构成的海面上，这些波浪形图案象征着葡萄牙、里斯本、平托的著作以及他旅途中的一些目的地，下方中央是“葡萄牙”字样。平托的名字两侧分别刻有“1511”和“2011”的年份，构成一个环绕内圈上缘的半圆形。纪念币外圈则饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The wedding of Prince Albert and Charlene Wittstock
description_en: The inner part of the coin shows, at the centre, the effigies of Prince Albert and Princess Charlene. At the bottom, the name of the issuing country ‘MONACO’ and the year of issuance ‘2011’. The mint mark and the mint engravers mark appear before and after ‘MONACO 2011’, respectively. The 12 stars of the European Union are depicted on the coin’s outer ring.
description_zh: 硬币内圈中央是阿尔贝亲王和夏琳王妃的肖像。底部是发行国“摩纳哥”和发行年份“2011”。造币厂标记和造币厂雕刻师标记分别位于“摩纳哥 2011”的前后。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 30th anniversary of the Day of Music
description_en: The inner part of the coin shows a cheerful crowd, with a stylised image of a musical instrument and notes floating in the air, denoting the atmosphere of celebration on the Day of Music, which has been celebrated every summer solstice in France since 1981. The words "Fête de la MUSIQUE" and the date "21 JUIN 2011" appear at the centre of the drawing. Along the upper edge, towards the right, are the words "30 e ANNIVERSAIRE", while the letters "RF" designate the country of issue at the bottom. The 12 stars of the European Union are depicted on the coin’s outer ring.
description_zh: 硬币内圈描绘了一群欢庆的人群，乐器和音符的图案在空中飘荡，象征着音乐节的喜庆氛围。自1981年以来，法国每年夏至都会庆祝音乐节。图案中心印有“Fête de la MUSIQUE”（音乐节）字样和日期“21 JUIN 2011”（2011年6月21日）。硬币上边缘右侧印有“30 e ANNIVERSAIRE”（30周年纪念）字样，底部则印有“RF”（法国）字样，表明发行国为法国。硬币外圈则饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The Special Olympics World Summer Games — Athens 2011
description_en: The inner part of the coin shows the emblem of the Games, a radiant sun, the source of life that underlines the excellence and power of the athletes who take part in the Games, with excellence represented by the olive branch and power by the spiral starting from the centre of the sun. Inscribed around the outer right-hand edge of the inner part are the caption “XIII SPECIAL OLYMPICS W.S.G. ATHENS 2011” and the name of the issuing country “ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΗ ΔΗΜΟΚΡΑΤΙΑ”, separated from one another by the mintmark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈图案为本届运动会会徽——一轮光芒四射的太阳，象征着生命的源泉，凸显了参赛运动员的卓越与力量。橄榄枝代表卓越，从太阳中心延伸出的螺旋线则代表力量。内圈右外缘刻有“第十三届雅典世界特殊奥林匹克运动会 2011”字样和发行国名称“希腊”（ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΗ ΔΗΜΟΚΡΑΤΙΑ），两者之间以造币厂标记隔开。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 500th anniversary of the birth of Giorgio Vasari
description_en: The inner part of the coin commemorating the 500th anniversary of the birth of Giorgio Vasari (30 July 1511 – 27 June 1574), a painter, writer, and architect famous for his biographies of Italian artists and now considered the ideological founder of art-historical writing, shows a detail of his painting “Giuditta decapitates Oloferne”. Centred at the bottom are the dates “1511-2011”, with the name “G. VASARI” and the designation of the issuing country “SAN MARINO” to the left and right respectively along the inner edge. The mintmark “R” is located to the left of the central motif and the letters “CM”, the initials of the designer Claudia Momoni, immediately to the right. The 12 stars of the European Union are depicted on the coin’s outer ring.
description_zh: 这枚纪念乔尔乔·瓦萨里（1511年7月30日—1574年6月27日）诞辰500周年的硬币，内圈图案为瓦萨里画作《朱迪塔斩首奥洛弗内》的局部。瓦萨里是一位画家、作家和建筑师，以其意大利艺术家传记而闻名，如今被认为是艺术史写作的思想奠基人。硬币底部中央刻有“1511-2011”字样，内圈边缘左右两侧分别刻有瓦萨里的名字“G. VASARI”和发行国“SAN MARINO”（圣马力诺）。造币厂标记“R”位于中心图案左侧，紧邻右侧的是设计师克劳迪娅·莫莫尼的姓名首字母“CM”。硬币外圈则饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 150th anniversary of the unification of Italy
description_en: The inner part of the coin shows, in the centre, three Italian flags fluttering in the wind, to mark three past periods of 50 years each – the periods ending in 1911, 1961 and 2011 respectively – in illustration of a perfect link between generations: this is the logo of the 150th anniversary of the unification of Italy. Written in a semi-circle along the upper outer edge around the three flags is the inscription “150° DELL’ UNITÁ D’ITALIA” (150th anniversary of the unification of Italy), with the letters “RI” superimposed on one another off-centre to the right in indication of the issuing country, the Republic of Italy. Beneath the three flags stand the dates “1861 › 2011 › ›”. Centred below the dates is the mintmark “R”, with the letters “ELF INC.”, the initials of the artist Ettore Lorenzo Frapiccini and the first three letters of the Italian name of his profession (incisore) along the bottom edge to the right. The 12 stars of the European Union are depicted on the coin’s outer ring.
description_zh: 硬币内圈中央是三面迎风飘扬的意大利国旗，分别代表三个不同的50年历史时期——分别结束于1911年、1961年和2011年——象征着世代之间的完美传承。这是意大利统一150周年纪念的标志。三面国旗周围上边缘呈半圆形排列着“150° DELL’ UNITÁ D’ITALIA”（意大利统一150周年）字样，右侧偏心处上下重叠的字母“RI”代表发行国——意大利共和国。三面国旗下方是“1861 › 2011 › ›”的日期。日期下方中央是造币厂标记“R”，右侧底部边缘刻有“ELF INC.”字样、艺术家埃托雷·洛伦佐·弗拉皮奇尼（Ettore Lorenzo Frapiccini）的姓名首字母以及他职业（雕刻师）的意大利语名称的前三个字母（incisore）。硬币外圈绘有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Court of the Lions, Granada – UNESCO World Heritage series
description_en: The inner part of the coin depicts the Court of the Lions in the Alhambra, the fortified castle in the city of Granada, which was declared a UNESCO World Heritage site in 1984. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈描绘了格拉纳达市阿尔罕布拉宫的狮子庭院，这座设防城堡于 1984 年被联合国教科文组织列为世界遗产。硬币外圈印有欧盟的 12 颗星。

title: 100th anniversary of the birth of Franc Rozman-Stane
description_en: The inner part of the coin bears a stylised image of Franc Rozman-Stane, general in the High Command of the Slovene partisan army and a national hero of Slovenia. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈是斯洛文尼亚游击队高级指挥官、斯洛文尼亚民族英雄弗朗茨·罗兹曼-斯坦的程式化肖像。硬币外圈是欧盟的12颗星。

title: 100th anniversary of International Women’s Day
description_en: The inner part of the coin commemorating the 100th anniversary of International Women’s Day, which is celebrated on 8 March, features effigies of Isala Van Diest, the first female Belgian medical doctor, and Marie Popelin, the first female Belgian lawyer above a semicircle formed by their names and the symbols of their professions on either side of the year 2011. Centred above the effigies are the letters “BE” in reference of their nationality, flanked by the Mint master’s mark on the left and the mintmark on the right. The coin’s outer ring shows the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 为纪念3月8日国际妇女节一百周年，这枚纪念币的内圈图案为比利时首位女医生伊萨拉·范·迪斯特和首位女律师玛丽·波佩林的肖像，肖像下方是一个由她们的名字和职业标志组成的半圆，半圆两侧是年份2011。肖像上方中央是代表她们国籍的字母“BE”，左侧是造币厂厂长标记，右侧是造币厂标记。纪念币外圈是欧盟的12颗星。

title: 20th anniversary of the formation of the Visegrad Group
description_en: The design of the inner part of the coin consists of the outlines of four central European states – the Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland and Slovakia – with a superimposed composite “V” to designate the Visegrad Group, a regional alliance also known as the “Visegrad Four” or “V4” that was set up after a summit meeting of the Heads of State or Government of Czechoslovakia, Hungary and Poland in the castle town of Visegrád, Hungary, on 15 February 1991, mainly for purposes of cooperating in areas of common interest within the process of European integration. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈图案由四个中欧国家——捷克、匈牙利、波兰和斯洛伐克——的轮廓构成，并叠加了一个复合的“V”字形，代表维谢格拉德集团。该集团是一个区域联盟，也被称为“维谢格拉德四国”或“V4”。1991年2月15日，捷克斯洛伐克、匈牙利和波兰三国国家元首或政府首脑在匈牙利维谢格拉德城堡举行峰会后成立了该联盟，其主要目的是在欧洲一体化进程中开展共同利益领域的合作。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 50th anniversary of the appointment by the Grand-Duchess Charlotte of her son Jean as "lieutenant-représentant"
description_en: The coin depicts on the right hand of its inner part the effigy of His Royal Highness, the Grand-Duke Henri, looking to the left, and superimposed on the effigies of the Grand-Duke Jean and the Grand-Duchess Charlotte. The text "LËTZEBUERG" is depicted above the three effigies. The year-date "2011", flanked by the mintmark and the Mintmaster mark, appears above. The name of the Royal Highness is depicted below the respective effigy. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币内侧右侧刻有亨利大公殿下面向左侧的肖像，其下方叠加有让大公和夏洛特大公夫人的肖像。“莱茨堡”字样位于三尊肖像上方。年份“2011”位于上方，两侧分别是造币厂标记和造币厂厂长标记。殿下的名字刻在各自肖像下方。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 500th anniversary of the publication of the world-famous book "Laus Stultitiae" by the Dutch philosopher, humanist and theologian Desiderius Erasmus
description_en: The inner part of the coin shows Erasmus writing his book on the right and the effigy of Queen Beatrix to the left. The two images are separated by the vertical inscription "Beatrix Koningin der Nederlanden". The year "2011", the Mint master’s mark and the mintmark are positioned horizontally near the centre of the coin. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈右侧是伊拉斯谟正在写作的人物，左侧是贝娅特丽克丝女王的肖像。两幅图像之间以竖排铭文“Beatrix Koningin der Nederlanden”（荷兰女王贝娅特丽克丝）隔开。年份“2011”、造币厂厂长标记和造币厂标记水平排列在硬币中心附近。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Federal state of North Rhine-Westphalia
description_en: The inner part of the coin features the Cologne Cathedral above the words “Nordrhein-Westfalen” to designate the German federal state of North Rhine-Westphalia in which it stands. The 12 stars of the European Union are depicted on the outer ring, together with the year of issue, 2011, at the bottom.
description_zh: 硬币内圈图案为科隆大教堂，上方是“北莱茵-威斯特法伦”字样，代表科隆大教堂所在的德国北莱茵-威斯特法伦州。外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星，底部是发行年份2011年。

title: Wedding of Prince Guillaume, Hereditary Grand-Duke, with Countess Stéphanie de Lannoy
description_en: The coin depicts, to the left of its inner part, the effigy of His Royal Highness the Grand Duke Henri, with the effigy of Prince Guillaume, Hereditary Grand Duke, superimposed on that of Countess Stéphanie to the right. The words “PRËNZENHOCHZAÏT” and “LËTZEBUERG” appear above the year “2012” at the bottom of the inner part of the coin, flanked by the mint mark and the mint master’s initials. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币内圈左侧是亨利大公殿下的肖像，右侧是世袭大公纪尧姆王子的肖像，与斯蒂芬妮伯爵夫人的肖像重叠。硬币内圈底部“2012”字样上方刻有“PRËNZENHOCHZAÏT”（拉丁语，意为“王子”）和“LËTZEBUERG”（拉丁语，意为“莱茵河畔”）字样，两侧分别是造币厂标记和造币厂厂长的姓名首字母。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Seventh World Meeting of Families
description_en: The inner part of the coin features a family, with the Cathedral of Milan, the host city of the Seventh World Meeting of Families, in the background. The event is held every three years to highlight the family as a common human heritage, reflecting the fact that the family is universal and that it contributes to the human element of life everywhere in the world. Inscribed around the family scene are the names of the event and of the Vatican City in Italian and the year “2012”. The mintmark “R” appears between the boy and his mother. The coin’s outer ring depicts the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈描绘了一个家庭，背景是米兰大教堂，第七届世界家庭大会的举办城市。该大会每三年举办一次，旨在强调家庭作为人类共同遗产的重要性，体现家庭的普世性及其对世界各地人类生活的重要贡献。家庭场景周围环绕着以意大利语书写的大会名称、梵蒂冈城名称以及年份“2012”。铸币厂标记“R”位于男孩和母亲之间。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 150th anniversary of the birth of the artist Helene Schjerfbeck
description_en: The inner part of the coin shows a stylised self-portrait of the artist, with her name, “HELENE SCHJERFBECK”, and the years of birth and death, “1862-1946”, inscribed vertically to the left and right, respectively. At the bottom to the left of the portrait are the letters “FI” to denote the issuing country and “2012”, the year of issue. The mintmark is located on the edge of the coin’s inner part immediately below the dates of birth and death. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈是艺术家的程式化自画像，其左下方垂直刻有她的名字“HELENE SCHJERFBECK”以及出生年份“1862-1946”，右下方垂直刻有逝世年份“1862-1946”。画像左下方刻有字母“FI”，代表发行国，以及发行年份“2012”。造币厂标记位于硬币内圈边缘，紧邻出生和逝世年份下方。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Majority representation 1887
description_en: The design of the inner part of the coin, which was created by the Maltese artist Gianni Bonnici, shows a jubilant crowd against the background of the Governor’s Palace in Valletta. The words “MALTA – Majority representation 1887” are inscribed along the upper edge of the coin’s inner part, while the year of issue, “2012”, is given at the bottom. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币的内圈图案由马耳他艺术家詹尼·博尼奇（Gianni Bonnici）设计，描绘了瓦莱塔总督府前欢庆的人群。硬币内圈上边缘刻有“马耳他 – 多数代表制 1887”字样，下边缘则标明发行年份“2012”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 500th anniversary of the establishment of Monaco’s sovereignty by Lucien I Grimaldi
description_en: The inner part of the coin shows a portrait of Lucien I Grimaldi, in profile, facing to the left. The inscription “1512 SOUVERAINETE DE MONACO 2012” forms an arch around the portrait along the outer edge of the inner part of the coin, flanked by two ornamental diamonds, as well as by the horn of plenty (mintmark of Monnaie de Paris) and the “fleurette” (hallmark of the engraving workshop) to the left and right, respectively, at the bottom of the portrait. The founder’s name, “Lucien Ier”, is given above the mintmark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈正面是吕西安一世·格里马尔迪的侧面肖像，面向左侧。“1512 SOUVERAINETE DE MONACO 2012”字样环绕肖像呈弧形排列，位于硬币内圈外缘，两侧各饰以一颗装饰性菱形。肖像下方左右两侧分别是丰饶角（巴黎造币厂的造币标记）和小花饰（雕刻工坊的标志）。铸币标记上方刻有创始人的名字“吕西安一世”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 100th anniversary of the birth of Abbé Pierre, famous in France as protector of the poor
description_en: The inner part of the coin shows a portrait of Abbé Pierre wearing his well-known beret, positioned slightly off-centre to the left, and the logo of the foundation that bears his name to the right, including micro-lettering with the question “Et les autres?”, his favourite words to remind us that we should never forget to help others. The inscription “Centenaire de la naissance de l’abbé Pierre” forms an arch around the portrait along the edge of the coin’s inner part, flanked by the horn of plenty (mintmark of Monnaie de Paris) and the letters “RF” to denote the issuing country on the left and the “fleurette” (hallmark of the engraving workshop) on the right. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈正面是皮埃尔神父的肖像，他头戴标志性的贝雷帽，略偏左侧，右侧是他名字命名的基金会的标志，标志上还印有他最常说的一句话：“Et les autres?”（还有其他人吗？），提醒我们永远不要忘记帮助他人。“Centenaire de la naissance de l’abbé Pierre”（皮埃尔神父诞辰百年纪念）的铭文环绕着肖像，位于硬币内圈边缘，呈弧形排列。左侧是丰饶之角（巴黎造币厂的造币标记）和代表发行国的“RF”字样，右侧是小花饰（雕刻工坊的标志）。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: European Capital of Culture 2012, the city of Guimarães in northern Portugal
description_en: : The inner part of the coin depicts a stylised image of Afonso Henriques, the first King of Portugal, together with his sword and the Castle of Guimarães, which is regarded as the birthplace of Portugal as an independent nation in the 12th century. To the left of the image is the Portuguese shield above the word “PORTUGAL”. To the lower right is the inscription “GUIMARÃES 2012” with the logo of Guimarães 2012 European Capital of Culture. Along the lower edge of the inner part are the mintmark “INCM” and the name of the designer, “JOSÉ DE GUIMARÃES”. The outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈描绘了葡萄牙首任国王阿方索·恩里克斯的程式化肖像，以及他的宝剑和吉马良斯城堡。吉马良斯城堡被认为是葡萄牙在12世纪成为独立国家的诞生地。肖像左侧是葡萄牙国徽，国徽下方是“PORTUGAL”（葡萄牙）字样。右下方是“GUIMARÃES 2012”（吉马良斯2012）字样，以及吉马良斯2012年欧洲文化之都的标志。内圈下边缘刻有造币厂标记“INCM”和设计师“JOSÉ DE GUIMARÃES”（若泽·德·吉马良斯）的名字。外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 75th anniversary of the Queen Elisabeth Competition
description_en: The inner part of the coin shows the logo of the Queen Elisabeth Competition superimposed on a left profile of Queen Elisabeth, who founded the music competition in 1937. On the left is the mintmaster mark (a quill) and on the right the mintmark (the head of the Archangel Michael). In a semi-circle along the bottom edge of the inner part is the inscription “QUEEN ELISABETH COMPETITION”, while the years “1937 – 2012”, marking the 75th anniversary of the competition, are inscribed along the top edge. The letters “BE” to the right of the image refer to the country of issue. The outer ring depicts the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈图案为伊丽莎白女王国际音乐比赛的标志，叠加在伊丽莎白女王的左侧头像上。伊丽莎白女王于1937年创立了这项音乐比赛。左侧是造币厂标记（羽毛笔），右侧是造币厂标记（大天使米迦勒的头像）。内圈底部边缘呈半圆形，刻有“QUEEN ELISABETH COMPETITION”（伊丽莎白女王国际音乐比赛）字样；顶部边缘刻有“1937 – 2012”字样，以纪念比赛举办75周年。图像右侧的字母“BE”代表发行国。外圈图案为欧盟的12颗星。

title: 100th anniversary of the death of Giovanni Pascoli
description_en: The inner part of the coin features a portrait of Giovanni Pascoli, a poet from the Romagna region who is a prominent representative of late 19th century Italian literature. The portrait is flanked by the poet’s year of death “1912”, the mintmark “R” and the letters “M.C.C.”, the initials of the designer Maria Carmela Colaneri, on the left and by the year of issue “2012”’ immediately above the monogram of the Italian Republic “RI” on the right. The inscription “G. PASCOLI” forms an arch along the bottom edge of the coin’s inner part below the portrait. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈是罗马涅地区诗人乔瓦尼·帕斯科利的肖像，他是19世纪末意大利文学的杰出代表。肖像左侧是诗人逝世年份“1912”、造币厂标记“R”以及设计师玛丽亚·卡梅拉·科拉内里（Maria Carmela Colaneri）的姓名首字母“M.C.C.”；右侧是发行年份“2012”，其上方是意大利共和国的标志“RI”。肖像下方，硬币内圈底部边缘呈弧形刻有“G. PASCOLI”字样。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Burgos Cathedral – UNESCO World Heritage series
description_en: The inner part of the coin depicts the Cathedral of Our Lady of Burgos, which is dedicated to the Virgin Mary and is famous for its vast size and unique architecture. Construction of the cathedral began in 1221 and it was already in use as a place of worship nine years later, although work continued off and on until 1567. It was primarily built in the French Gothic style, but Renaissance features were added in the 15th and 16th centuries. The name of the country of issue, “ESPAÑA”, and the year “2012” appear to the left and right above the image. The mintmark (M with a crown) appears to the right. The outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈描绘了布尔戈斯圣母大教堂，这座教堂供奉圣母玛利亚，以其宏伟的规模和独特的建筑风格而闻名。教堂始建于1221年，九年后便投入使用，但工程断断续续地持续到1567年。教堂主要采用法国哥特式风格，并在15和16世纪融入了文艺复兴时期的元素。发行国名称“ESPAÑA”（西班牙）和年份“2012”分别位于图案上方左右两侧。造币厂标记（带皇冠的字母“M”）位于右侧。外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Ten years of the euro
description_en: The inner part of the coin, designed by Helmut Andexlinger of the Austrian Mint and chosen by citizens and residents of the euro area to be the common commemorative coin for 2012, features the world in the form of a euro symbol in the centre, showing how the euro has become a true global player over the last ten years. The surrounding elements symbolise the importance of the euro to ordinary people (represented by a family group), to the financial world (the Eurotower), to trade (a ship), to industry (a factory), and to the energy sector and research and development (two wind turbines). The designer’s initials, “A.H.”, can be found (if you look very carefully) between the ship and the Eurotower. Along the upper and lower edges of the inner part of the coin are, respectively, the country of issue and the years “2002 – 2012”. The coin will be issued by all euro area countries. The coin’s outer ring depicts the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚由奥地利造币厂的赫尔穆特·安德克斯林格设计的硬币内圈，由欧元区公民和居民投票选为2012年通用纪念币。硬币中心以欧元符号的形式展现了世界地图，象征着欧元在过去十年中如何成为真正的全球货币。周围的元素分别代表欧元对普通民众（以家庭为代表）、金融界（欧元塔）、贸易（以轮船为代表）、工业（以工厂为代表）以及能源和研发领域（以两台风力涡轮机为代表）的重要性。仔细观察，可以在轮船和欧元塔之间找到设计师的姓名首字母“A.H.”。硬币内圈的上下边缘分别印有发行国和年份“2002-2012”。所有欧元区国家都将发行这枚硬币。硬币的外圈则描绘了欧盟的12颗星。
issue_date_raw: January 2012 for all euro area countries except San Marino (May 2012)

title: Grand Duke Henri and Grand Duke Guillaume IV – “grand-ducal dynasty” series
description_en: The coin depicts, to the left of its inner part, the head of His Royal Highness the Grand Duke Henri in front of that of his great-grandfather, the Grand Duke Guillaume IV, both looking to the right, with their names “HENRI” and “GUILLAUME IV † 1912” below. Above are the year “2012”, flanked to the left and right by the mintmark (Mercury’s wand) and the mint master mark (a sailing boat), and the words “GRANDS-DUCS DE LUXEMBOURG”. The city of Luxembourg appears in the background. The 12 stars of the European Union are depicted on the coin’s outer ring.
description_zh: 硬币内侧左侧是亨利大公殿下的头像，其前是他的曾祖父纪尧姆四世大公的头像，两人均面向右侧，下方分别刻有“HENRI”和“GUILLAUME IV † 1912”字样。上方为年份“2012”，左右两侧分别是造币厂标记（墨丘利魔杖）和造币厂厂长标记（帆船），下方刻有“GRANDS-DUCS DE LUXEMBOURG”（卢森堡大公）字样。卢森堡市位于背景中。硬币外圈刻有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Federal state of Bavaria
description_en: The inner part of the coin, designed by Erich Ott, depicts one of Bavaria’s most famous landmarks, Neuschwanstein Castle, viewed from the east, with the gatehouse in the foreground, the romantic towers and turrets of the castle itself, and the majestic mountains behind. Beneath is the name of the federal state “BAYERN”. To the right is the mintmark of the respective mint (A, D, F, G or J) and to the left are the initials of the designer. The outer ring features the 12 stars of the European Union with a “D” at the top and “2012” at the bottom, denoting the country and year of issue respectively.
description_zh: 这枚由埃里希·奥特设计的硬币内圈描绘了巴伐利亚最著名的地标之一——新天鹅堡，视角为东面，前景是城堡的门楼，随后是城堡本身浪漫的塔楼和角楼，以及远处雄伟的群山。下方是联邦州名“巴伐利亚”（BAYERN）。右侧是相应造币厂的标记（A、D、F、G 或 J），左侧是设计师的姓名首字母。外圈是欧盟的12颗星，顶部是“D”，底部是“2012”，分别代表发行国家和年份。

title: 200 years Kingdom of the Netherlands
description_en: The inner part of the design shows a continuing ribbon that starts from the outside depicting the effigy of King Willem-Alexander and continues to depict the effigies of his six predecessors: Queen Beatrix, Queen Juliana, Queen Wilhelmina, King Willem III, King Willem II and King Willem I. The effigies are surrounded by the inscription ‘Willem-Alexander Koning der Nederlanden’ followed by the Royal Dutch mintmark, the mint master mark, the year 2013, the initials of the designer and at the left side of the effigies the inscription ‘200 jaar Koninkrijk der Nederlanden’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 设计内圈呈现一条连续的缎带，从外圈开始，依次描绘了威廉-亚历山大国王的肖像，并延伸至他的六位前任国王——贝娅特丽克丝女王、朱莉安娜女王、威廉明娜女王、威廉三世国王、威廉二世国王和威廉一世国王的肖像。肖像周围环绕着“Willem-Alexander Koning der Nederlanden”（荷兰国王威廉-亚历山大）字样，其后依次是荷兰皇家造币厂标记、造币厂厂长标记、年份2013、设计师姓名首字母缩写，以及位于肖像左侧的“200 jaar Koninkrijk der Nederlanden”（荷兰王国200周年）字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 125th anniversary of the birth of Nobel Prize winning author F. E. SILLANPÄÄ
description_en: The inner part of the coin depicts Sillanpää's portrait. At the top, in semi-circle, the words ‘F. E. SILLANPÄÄ’. At the left, the year ‘1888’ and the mint mark. At the right, the year ‘1964’, the indication of the issuing country ‘FI’ and the year of issuance ‘2013’. This is a special coin to commemorate the grandfather of a whole nation. F. E. SILLANPÄÄ was a master of style who brought deep insights about the relationship between people and nature into Finnish literature. He was awarded the Nobel prize in 1939 based in particular on the works Meek Heritage and The Maid Silja. This masterful author gained even more national renown with his popular radio appearances and memorable Christmas columns. After the war years, the master writer evolved into the long-bearded ‘Taata’, the unofficial grandfather to the country. From recollections of his childhood Christmases emerged a well-loved tradition: Grandpa gathered the whole nation devoutly around their radios with his easy-going Christmas ‘talks’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈刻有西兰帕的肖像。上方半圆形区域刻有“F. E. SILLANPÄÄ”字样。左侧为年份“1888”和造币厂标记。右侧为年份“1964”、发行国“FI”和发行年份“2013”​​。这是一枚特殊的纪念币，旨在纪念这位芬兰民族的“祖父”。F. E. 西兰帕是一位文风大师，他将对人与自然关系的深刻洞察融入芬兰文学。他凭借《温顺的遗产》和《少女西莉亚》等作品荣获1939年诺贝尔文学奖。这位杰出的作家凭借其广受欢迎的广播节目和令人难忘的圣诞专栏文章，赢得了更高的全国声誉。战后，这位文学大师逐渐演变为留着长胡子的“塔塔”（芬兰语，意为“老爷爷”），成为芬兰非官方的“祖父”。从他对童年圣诞节的回忆中，诞生了一个深受喜爱的传统：爷爷用他轻松愉快的圣诞“讲话”，让全国人民虔诚地围坐在收音机旁。硬币的外圈印有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The Self-Government Constitution of 1921
description_en: The design shows a map of the Maltese islands and a representation of the population. At the bottom of the design, the year ‘2013’. At the top, in semi-circle, the words ‘MALTA — Self-government 1921’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计图案包含马耳他群岛地图和人口分布图。图案底部标有年份“2013”​​。顶部半圆形区域内刻有“马耳他——自治 1921”字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 28th World Youth Day
description_en: The design features the most known monument of Rio de Janeiro, the ‘Christ of Corcovado’, and some young people around the statue. At the top, in semi-circle, the inscription ‘XXVIII G.M.G. CITTÀ DEL VATICANO RIO 2013’. At the right, the mintmark ‘R’ and the name of the artist ‘P DANIELE’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以里约热内卢最著名的地标“科尔科瓦多基督像”为中心，周围环绕着一些年轻人。顶部呈半圆形，镌刻着“XXVIII G.M.G. CITTÀ DEL VATICANO RIO 2013”​​字样。右侧是造币厂标记“R”和艺术家姓名“P DANIELE”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 100th anniversary of the union of Crete with Greece
description_en: The inner part of the coin depicts Cretan rebels raising the Greek flag, a symbolic representation of Crete’s struggle for Union with Greece. On the upper side, in circular sense and with capital letters the name of the issuing country ‘Hellenic Republic’ in Greek. Underneath the words: ‘100 years of the union of Crete with Greece’ in Greek. On the right: ‘1913-2013’ and the monogram of the Greek Mint. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈描绘了克里特岛起义者升起希腊国旗的场景，象征着克里特岛争取与希腊合并的斗争。硬币上方，以圆形图案和大写字母呈现发行国名称“希腊共和国”（Hellenic Republic）。下方是希腊语“克里特岛与希腊合并一百周年”（100 years of the union of Crete with Greece）。右侧是“1913-2013”​​字样以及希腊造币厂的标志。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 2 400th Anniversary of the founding of Plato’s Academy
description_en: Portrait of Plato (in profile). On the left: the words ‘2 400 years since the founding of Plato’s Academy’ and ‘Hellenic Republic’ in ancient Greek lettering. On the right: ‘2013’ and the monogram of the Greek Mint. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 柏拉图侧面肖像。左侧以古希腊字母书写“柏拉图学院创立2400周年”和“希腊共和国”。右侧为“2013”​​和希腊造币厂的标志。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 500th anniversary of the death of the Italian painter Pinturicchio
description_en: In the foreground, the fresco ‘Christ among the doctors’; in the lower part, the inscription ‘SAN MARINO’ in semi-circle; to the left, the letter ‘R’, which is the Italian mint mark; below the fresco, the name of the author ‘MOMONI’; above the fresco, the inscription ‘PINTURICCHIO’ in semi-circle with the years ‘1513’ and ‘2013’ below it. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 前景为壁画《基督与博士们》；下方为半圆形铭文“SAN MARINO”；左侧为字母“R”，即意大利造币厂标记；壁画下方为作者“MOMONI”；壁画上方为半圆形铭文“PINTURICCHIO”，下方分别为年份“1513”和“2013”​​。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 100th anniversary of the creation of the Royal Meteorological Institute (Koninklijk Meteorologisch Instituut/Institut Royal Météorologique)
description_en: The obverse of the coin displays in its centre the number 100 with the first zero encircling the abbreviations ‘KMI’ and ‘IRM’ and the second zero representing a sun. Isobars, raindrops and snowflakes are depicted to the left of the sun. The year ‘2013’ is displayed in the upper rays of the sun and the nationality ‘BE’ is indicated in the lower rays. The mark of the mint master and the mark of the Brussels mint, a helmeted profile of the Archangel Michael, are displayed under the ‘1’ of the number ‘100’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币正面中央为数字100，第一个零环绕着“KMI”和“IRM”的缩写，第二个零则代表太阳。太阳左侧绘有等压线、雨滴和雪花。“2013”​​年份位于太阳上方的光芒中，而“BE”国籍则位于下方的光芒中。数字“100”中的“1”下方是造币厂厂长标记和布鲁塞尔造币厂标记——戴着头盔的大天使米迦勒的侧面像。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 150th anniversary of the Parliament of 1863 when regular Parliament sessions started in Finland
description_en: The 2-euro commemorative coin is depicted with the year 1863 and a shoot growing out of it symbolising the start of democracy and Finland’s development. In semicircle, at the bottom, the name of the issuing country ‘SUOMI FINLAND’ with the two words separated by the mint mark, and the year ‘2013’. The Diet of 1863 is the start of period of illumination. In Finland, the year 1863 marked a start for genuine democracy, transparent press operations and the right to use the Finnish language. With the beginning of regular meetings of the Diet, the opportunities of Finns to influence affairs in their own country improved in an unprecedented way. The year marked the beginning of a period of illumination for Finnish democracy. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚2欧元纪念币正面图案为1863年，并饰有一株从中生长出来的嫩芽，象征着芬兰民主的开端和发展。半圆形底部刻有发行国名称“SUOMI FINLAND”（芬兰），两个词之间以造币厂标记隔开，下方为年份“2013”​​。1863年的议会标志着芬兰民主的启蒙时期。在芬兰，1863年标志着真正民主、透明的新闻运作以及芬兰语使用权的开端。随着议会定期召开，芬兰人对本国事务的影响力以前所未有的方式得到提升。这一年标志着芬兰民主开启了启蒙时期。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The National Anthem of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg
description_en: The coin depicts on the right hand of its inner part the effigy of His Royal Highness, the Grand Duke Henri, looking to the left, and on the left hand of its inner part the musical notation as well as the text of the national anthem. The text ‘Ons Heemecht’ appears at the top of the inner part and the name of the issuing country ‘LËTZEBUERG’ as well as the year-date ‘2013’, flanked by the mint mark and the initials of the mint master, appear at the bottom of the inner part of the coin. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币内圈右侧是亨利大公殿下的肖像，他面向左侧；内圈左侧是乐谱和国歌歌词。内圈顶部刻有“Ons Heemecht”（拉丁语，意为“我们的祖国”）字样，底部刻有发行国“莱茨堡”（LËTZEBUERG）和年份“2013”​​，两侧分别是造币厂标记和造币厂厂长的姓名首字母。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 1150th anniversary of the advent of the mission of Constantine and Methodius to Great Moravia
description_en: The inner part of the coin features the Thessalonian brothers Constantine and Methodius on either side of the symbolic double cross standing on three hills. The cross is moreover held like a Bishop’s crozier, thereby bringing together the symbols of statehood and Christianity, and emphasising the significance of the brothers’ mission, which helped ensure the full sovereignty and legitimacy of Great Moravia — the first Slav state in central Europe. The figure of Constantine is holding a book that represents education and faith, while Methodius is shown with a church to symbolise faith and institutional Christianity. Inscribed along the bottom edge of the inner part of the coin is the name of the issuing country, “SLOVENSKO”, as well as the years “863” and “2013”, all separated by a dash. Along the upper edge of the inner part are the names “KONŠTANTÍN” and “METOD”. Inscribed immediately to the left of the brothers are the stylised letters “mh” (the initials of the designer, Miroslav Hric), while the mint mark of Kremnica Mint (composed of the letters “MK” between two dies) is shown immediately to their right. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈图案为帖撒罗尼迦兄弟君士坦丁和梅托迪乌斯，他们分别位于象征性的双十字架两侧，十字架矗立于三座山丘之上。十字架的握法如同主教的权杖，将国家和基督教的象征融为一体，强调了兄弟二人使命的重要性——他们的使命帮助确保了大摩拉维亚（中欧第一个斯拉夫国家）的完全主权和合法性。君士坦丁手中拿着一本象征教育和信仰的书籍，而梅托迪乌斯则手持一座教堂，象征着信仰和基督教的制度化。硬币内圈底部边缘刻有发行国名称“斯洛文尼亚”（SLOVENSKO）以及年份“863”和“2013”​​，两者之间以短横线分隔。内圈顶部边缘刻有“KONŠTANTÍN”和“METOD”两个名字。兄弟俩左侧刻有风格化的字母“mh”（设计师米罗斯拉夫·赫里奇的姓名首字母），右侧则是克雷姆尼察造币厂的标记（由两个模具之间的字母“MK”组成）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 20th anniversary of the ONU joining
description_en: The coin depicts a dove with an olive branch, with in the middle of the arc, on the left side the cornucopia, and on the right side the punch, as the workshop Paris Mint mark. At the top, in semi-circle, the indication of the issuing country ‘MONACO’ and at the bottom, in semi-circle, the inscription ‘1993 ADMISSION À L'ONU 2013’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币正面图案为一只衔着橄榄枝的鸽子，弧线中央左侧是丰饶角，右侧是冲压标记，即巴黎造币厂的标记。硬币顶部半圆形区域内刻有发行国“摩纳哥”字样，底部半圆形区域内刻有“1993 ADMISSION À L'ONU 2013”​​字样。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 700th Anniversary of the birth of Giovanni BOCCACCIO
description_en: The design shows the head of Giovanni BOCCACCIO in three quarter view facing right, drawn from the fresco by Andrea del Castagno, around 1450 ca. (Florence, Galleria degli Uffizi); around, on the bottom, BOCCACCIO 1313 2013; on the right, superimposed letters R (monogram of the Mint of Rome)/RI (monogram of Italian Republic)/m (monogram of the author Roberto Mauri). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以乔瓦尼·薄伽丘面向右侧的四分之三侧面头像为特色，取材自安德烈亚·德尔·卡斯塔尼奥约于1450年创作的壁画（现藏于佛罗伦萨乌菲齐美术馆）；底部环绕刻有“BOCCACCIO 1313 2013”​​字样；右侧叠加刻有字母“R”（罗马造币厂的缩写）/“RI”（意大利共和国的缩写）/“m”（作者罗伯托·毛里的缩写）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 250th anniversary of the construction of ‘Torre dos Clérigos’
description_en: The tower is depicted as it can be seen by the people on the street when standing close to it, side by side with the typical Oporto skyline as seen from Douro River south bank. At the top, in semi-circle, the inscription ‘250 ANOS TORRE DOS CLÉRIGOS — 2013’. At the bottom right, the Portuguese coat of arms and underneath the indication of the issuing country ‘PORTUGAL’. At the left, the mint mark and the name of the artist ‘INCM — HUGO MACIEL’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币图案描绘了人们站在街上近距离看到的塔楼，与从杜罗河南岸眺望的波尔图典型天际线并肩而立。顶部呈半圆形，镌刻着“250 ANOS TORRE DOS CLÉRIGOS — 2013”​​（教士塔250周年纪念 — 2013）。右下角是葡萄牙国徽，下方标明发行国“PORTUGAL”（葡萄牙）。左侧是造币厂标记和艺术家姓名“INCM — HUGO MACIEL”（INCM — HUGO MACIEL）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟十二星。

title: 150th anniversary of the birth of Pierre de Coubertin, initiator of the revival of the Olympic Games and first president of the International Olympic Committee
description_en: The inner part of the coin shows a portrait of Pierre de Coubertin at a young age, set slightly off-centre to the right, with stylised Olympic rings in the background. They provide the framework for silhouettes symbolising the Olympic sports. To the left of the portrait, the letters “RF”, denoting the issuing country, are given above the year of issue “2013”.
