The name “PIERRE DE COUBERTIN” is inscribed along the top edge of the inner part of the coin. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈是皮埃尔·德·顾拜旦年轻时的肖像，略偏右，背景是风格化的奥运五环。五环内框出象征奥运项目的剪影。肖像左侧是发行国“RF”字样，上方是发行年份“2013”​​。硬币内圈顶部边缘刻有“PIERRE DE COUBERTIN”字样。硬币外圈是欧盟的12颗星。

title: Sede Vacante 2013
description_en: The design features the coat of arms of the Cardinal Camerlengo and above it the symbol of the Apostolic Camera, two small crosses, the words ‘CITTÀ DEL VATICANO’ at the left and ‘SEDE VACANTE MMXIII’ at the right. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以枢机主教的徽章为特色，徽章上方是宗座圣殿的标志，下方是两个小十字架，左侧是“CITTÀ DEL VATICANO”（梵蒂冈城），右侧是“SEDE VACANTE MMXIII”（2013年教廷空缺）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 200th Anniversary of the birth of Giuseppe VERDI
description_en: The design shows the bust of Giuseppe VERDI in three quarter view facing left; on the left, superimposed letters of the Italian Republic monogram ‘RI’/1813; on the right, R (monogram of the Mint of Rome)/2013; in exergue, MCC (monogram of the Author Maria Carmela COLANERI)/G. VERDI. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了朱塞佩·威尔第的四分之三侧面头像，面向左侧；左侧叠加有意大利共和国字母组合“RI”/1813；右侧为R（罗马造币厂字母组合）/2013；下方为MCC（作者玛丽亚·卡梅拉·科拉内里字母组合）/G. VERDI。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The announcement of the abdication of the throne by Her Majesty Queen Beatrix
description_en: The design depicts on the foreground the effigy of Queen Beatrix and on the background, partly covered by the effigy of the Queen, the effigy of the Prince of Orange. The circumscription around both effigies reads: WILLEM-ALEXANDER PRINS VAN ORANJE (crown symbol) BEATRIX KONINGIN DER NEDERLANDEN (mint mark) 28 januari 2013 (mint master mark). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该硬币正面图案为贝娅特丽克丝女王的肖像，背面图案为奥兰治亲王的肖像，部分被女王的肖像遮盖。两尊肖像周围的铭文分别为：WILLEM-ALEXANDER PRINS VAN ORANJE（皇冠图案）、BEATRIX KONINGIN DER NEDERLANDEN（造币厂标记）、28 januari 2013（造币厂主标记）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Baden-Württemberg from the ‘Länder’-series
description_en: The inner part of the coin depicts the Maulbronn Monastery which is home to the most perfectly preserved medieval monastery complex north of the Alps. Founded in 1147, this complex has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1993. On the top, the year of issuance ‘2013’. At the bottom, the inscription BADEN- WÜRTTEMBERG and underneath the indication of the issuing country ‘D’. The mint mark, represented by the letter A, D, F, G or J, is located at the right hand side. At the bottom left the initials of the artist. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈描绘了毛尔布龙修道院，它是阿尔卑斯山以北保存最完好的中世纪修道院建筑群所在地。该建筑群始建于1147年，自1993年起被联合国教科文组织列为世界遗产。硬币顶部为发行年份“2013”​​。底部刻有“巴登-符腾堡”字样，下方是发行国“D”的标识。造币厂标记位于右侧，以字母A、D、F、G或J表示。左下角是艺术家姓名的首字母缩写。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 800th anniversary of visits to Postojna Cave
description_en: The central image of the coin is a stylised spiral that starts, on the left-hand side of the inner part, with inscription “POSTOJNSKA JAMA • 1213 - 2013 • SLOVENIJA” and ends with two stylised speleothems. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币的中心图案是一个程式化的螺旋纹，从内圈左侧开始，刻有“POSTOJNSKA JAMA • 1213 - 2013 • SLOVENIJA”（波斯托伊恩斯卡·亚玛 • 1213 - 2013 • 斯洛文尼亚）字样，末端是两个程式化的洞穴沉积物。硬币的外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial – UNESCO World Heritage series
description_en: The inner part of the coin shows a view of the Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial. Along the upper edge, in upper case letters, runs the name of the issuing country “ESPAÑA”, with the year of issuance “2013” above the mint mark to the right. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈图案为埃斯科里亚尔圣洛伦索修道院。上边缘以大写字母刻有发行国名称“ESPAÑA”，发行年份“2013”​​位于右侧的造币厂标记上方。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 50th anniversary of the signing of the Élysée Treaty
description_en: The coin, which was designed by Yves Sampo (Monnaie de Paris), Stefanie Lindner (Berlin State Mint), Alina Hoyer (Berlin) and Sneschana Russewa-Hoyer (Berlin), depicts stylised portraits of the signatories to the Élysée Treaty (Konrad Adenauer, then Chancellor of the Federal Republic of Germany, and Charles de Gaulle, former President of the French Republic) above their respective signatures on either side of the words “50 ANS JAHRE” and the year “2013” in the centre. The words “TRAITÉ DE L’ÉLYSÉE” and “ÉLYSÉE-VERTRAG” are centred along the top and bottom edge, respectively, of the inner part of the coin. On the right-hand inner edge below the portrait of Adenauer, the inner part also features the “fleurette” (hallmark of the engraving workshop) and the letters “RF” to denote the issuing country, while the mint mark is located on the coin’s left-hand inner edge below the portrait of de Gaulle. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚由伊夫·桑波（巴黎造币厂）、斯蒂芬妮·林德纳（柏林国家造币厂）、阿丽娜·霍耶（柏林）和斯内沙娜·鲁塞瓦-霍耶（柏林）共同设计的硬币，正面图案为《爱丽舍条约》签署人（时任德意志联邦共和国总理康拉德·阿登纳和时任法兰西共和国总统夏尔·戴高乐）的风格化肖像，肖像上方是他们各自的签名，两侧分别是“50 ANS JAHRE”（50年）字样和“2013”​​年份。硬币内侧顶部和底部边缘分别中央刻有“TRAITÉ DE L’ÉLYSÉE”（爱丽舍条约）和“ÉLYSÉE-VERTRAG”（爱丽舍条约）字样。在阿登纳肖像下方右侧内缘，内侧刻有“小花饰”（雕刻工坊的标志）和代表发行国的“RF”字样；而造币厂标记则位于戴高乐肖像下方左侧内缘。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 50th anniversary of the signing of the Élysée Treaty
description_en: The coin, which was designed by Yves Sampo (Monnaie de Paris), Stefanie Lindner (Berlin State Mint), Alina Hoyer (Berlin) and Sneschana Russewa-Hoyer (Berlin), depicts stylised portraits of the signatories to the Élysée Treaty (Konrad Adenauer, then Chancellor of the Federal Republic of Germany, and Charles de Gaulle, former President of the French Republic) above their respective signatures on either side of the words “50 ANS JAHRE” and the year “2013” in the centre. The words “TRAITÉ DE L’ÉLYSÉE” and “ÉLYSÉE-VERTRAG” are centred along the top and bottom edge, respectively, of the inner part of the coin. On the right-hand inner edge below the portrait of Adenauer, the inner part also features the mint mark (“A”, “D”, “F”, “G” or “J”, depending on the mint concerned), as well as the letter “D” to denote the issuing country. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚由伊夫·桑波（巴黎造币厂）、斯蒂芬妮·林德纳（柏林国家造币厂）、阿丽娜·霍耶（柏林）和斯内沙娜·鲁塞瓦-霍耶（柏林）共同设计的硬币，正面图案为《爱丽舍条约》签署人（时任德意志联邦共和国总理康拉德·阿登纳和时任法兰西共和国总统夏尔·戴高乐）的风格化肖像，肖像上方是他们各自的签名，两侧分别是“50 ANS JAHRE”（50年）字样和“2013”​​年份。硬币内侧顶部和底部边缘分别中央刻有“TRAITÉ DE L’ÉLYSÉE”（爱丽舍条约）和“ÉLYSÉE-VERTRAG”（爱丽舍条约）字样。在阿登纳肖像下方右侧内缘，还刻有造币厂标记（根据造币厂的不同，可能是“A”、“D”、“F”、“G”或“J”），以及代表发行国的字母“D”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Change of the Head of State
description_en: The design depicts the overlapping portraits of Kings Felipe VI and Juan Carlos I. At the bottom the name of the issuing country and the year of issuance: ‘ESPAÑA — 2014’. At the right, the mint mark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计图案为费利佩六世国王和胡安·卡洛斯一世国王的重叠肖像。底部为发行国名称和发行年份“西班牙—2014”。右侧为造币厂标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The fight against AIDS by way of World AIDS Day
description_en: The red ribbon, symbolising the fight against AIDS, is featured in the coin’s central field. The ribbon was created by the Visual AIDS Artists Caucus and the US painter Frank Moore. It should be worn close to the heart to symbolise solidarity with AIDS sufferers and is in the shape of an upside-down V. The idea is for it to be worn as a V one day to signify victory over the disease. There are three ribbons in the central field. One is in the conventional position and will be coloured red for the brilliant uncirculated (BU) and proof (PRF) versions. The other two ribbons are inverted and associated with two Vs to strengthen the symbolism of the much-hoped-for victory over the disease. The date 1 December, Unesco World AIDS Day, appears at the top of the central field. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 象征着抗击艾滋病的红色丝带位于硬币中央。这条丝带由视觉艾滋病艺术家联盟和美国画家弗兰克·摩尔共同设计。佩戴时应将其贴近心脏，以示对艾滋病患者的声援，其形状为倒V字形。设计理念是，未来有一天，人们会将其佩戴成V字形，象征着战胜艾滋病。中央区域共有三条丝带。其中一条为传统位置，在精制未流通版（BU）和精制币（PRF）中将采用红色。另外两条丝带方向相反，分别与两个V字形相连，以强化人们期盼已久的战胜艾滋病的象征意义。12月1日，联合国教科文组织世界艾滋病日，位于中央区域的顶部。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 100th Anniversary of the birth of designer and interior designer Ilmari Tapiovaara
description_en: The left inner part of the design shows Ilmari Tapiovaara’s name and years. The right inner part of the design depicts a close-up from the furniture fitting characteristic for Ilmari Tapiovaara. At the right the indication of the issuing country ‘FI’, the mint mark and the year of issuance ‘2014’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币左侧内圈印有伊尔马里·塔皮奥瓦拉的名字和年份。右侧内圈描绘了伊尔马里·塔皮奥瓦拉标志性的家具配件特写。右侧标有发行国“FI”、造币厂标记和发行年份“2014”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 25th anniversary of the fall of the Berlin Wall
description_en: The design depicts some bricks of the partially collapsed Berlin Wall in the foreground, with the wording ‘XXV ANNIVERSARIO DEL CROLLO DEL MURO DI BERLINO 1989 2014’ (25th anniversary of the fall of the Berlin Wall 1989 2014) written within the bricks. An olive branch can be seen in the centre, in a gap between the bricks and a piece of barbed wire, and the Brandenburg Gate appears in the background. At the top, the words ‘CITTA’ DEL VATICANO’ are inscribed. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币设计前景描绘了部分倒塌的柏林墙砖块，砖块内刻有“XXV ANNIVERSARIO DEL CROLLO DEL MURO DI BERLINO 1989 2014”（柏林墙倒塌25周年 1989-2014）字样。画面中央，砖块与铁丝网之间的缝隙中，可以看到一根橄榄枝，背景则是勃兰登堡门。顶部刻有“CITTA” DEL VATICANO（梵蒂冈城）字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 600th anniversary of the crowning of Barbara Celjska
description_en: The central image of the coin shows, with lined pattern, the portrait of the Queen Barbara of Celje with her sceptre. On the image are placed three typical six-pointed stars of Celje counts. On the left side of the portrait is the inscription ‘SLOVENIJA’ and on the right side the inscription ‘BARBARA CELJSKA’ and the years ‘1414-2014’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币中央图案为切列女王芭芭拉手持权杖的肖像，以线条勾勒而成。肖像上饰有三颗切列伯爵典型的六角星。肖像左侧刻有“SLOVENIJA”（斯洛文尼亚）字样，右侧刻有“BARBARA CELJSKA”（芭芭拉·切列斯卡）字样以及年份“1414-2014”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的十二颗星。

title: 50th anniversary of the accession to the throne of the Grand-Duke Jean
description_en: The coin’s inner part depicts the effigies of Their Royal Highnesses, the Grand-Duke Henri and the Grand-Duke Jean, both looking to the left. It is surmounted by the year ‘1964’ above the effigy of the Grand-Duke Jean and by a crown. At the bottom, the names ‘Jean’ and ‘Henri’ appear below the respective effigy as well as the year ‘2014’. The inscription ‘50e ANNIVERSAIRE DE L’ACCESSION AU TRÔNE DU GRAND-DUC JEAN’ encloses in circular form the upper inner part of the coin. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈刻有亨利大公和让大公殿下的肖像，两人均面向左侧。让大公肖像上方刻有“1964”字样，下方为王冠。底部，在各自的肖像下方分别刻有“让”和“亨利”字样以及“2014”字样。硬币内圈上方环绕着“50e ANNIVERSAIRE DE L’ACCESSION AU TRÔNE DU GRAND-DUC JEAN”（让大公登基五十周年纪念）字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的十二颗星。

title: The International Year of Family Farming
description_en: On the central part of the design are represented tools typically used in the traditional agriculture, together with farming products: a chicken in the center, surrounded by pumpkins, a basket of potatoes, and other vegetables and flowers. On the left side, in semi-circle, the subject of the commemoration ‘AGRICULTURA FAMILIAR’ (Family Farming) and on the right side, in semi-circle, the name of the issuing country ‘PORTUGAL’ followed by the year of issuance ‘2014’. At the bottom left the mintmark ‘INCM’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 设计中心部分描绘了传统农业中常用的工具，以及农产品——中心是一只鸡，周围环绕着南瓜、一篮土豆和其他蔬菜和鲜花。左侧半圆形区域内刻有纪念主题“AGRICULTURA FAMILIAR”（家庭农业），右侧半圆形区域内刻有发行国“PORTUGAL”（葡萄牙）及其发行年份“2014”。左下角是造币厂标记“INCM”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Malta Independence 1964
description_en: The coin commemorating the Malta Independence constitution of 1964 is the fourth in the series of five coins that commemorate constitutional milestones in Maltese history. By means of the 1964 constitution Malta became an independent nation for the first time after hundreds of years of foreign domination. The national side of the coin shows a detail of the bronze monument commemorating Independence which was designed by the artist Gianni Bonnici in 1989. It shows a young woman, representing Malta, carrying the Maltese flag. At the right, in semi-circle, the inscription ‘MALTA — Independence 1964’ and at the bottom the year of issuance ‘2014’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 为纪念1964年马耳他独立宪法而发行的这枚硬币，是纪念马耳他历史上重要宪法里程碑的五枚系列硬币中的第四枚。1964年宪法的颁布，使马耳他在经历了数百年的外国统治后，首次成为一个独立的国家。硬币正面图案为艺术家詹尼·博尼奇（Gianni Bonnici）于1989年设计的独立纪念碑细节图。纪念碑上是一位代表马耳他的年轻女子，手持马耳他国旗。右侧半圆形铭文为“马耳他——1964年独立”，底部为发行年份“2014”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 90th anniversary of the death of Giacomo Puccini
description_en: The designs shows a portrait of the composer Giacomo Puccini. At the right the name of the issuing country, in semi-circle, ‘SAN MARINO’. At the left the inscription ‘G. PUCCINI’ and the mint mark. At the bottom the year ‘2014’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币正面图案为作曲家贾科莫·普契尼的肖像。右侧半圆形图案内为发行国名称“圣马力诺”。左侧刻有“G. PUCCINI”字样和造币厂标记。底部为年份“2014”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 150 years of the Belgian Red Cross
description_en: The inner part of the coin features a cross with the number ‘150’ in its centre. The vertical and horizontal bars of the cross bear the words ‘Rode Kruis’ and ‘Croix-Rouge’ respectively. The cross is surrounded by the mark of the Brussels mint (a helmeted profile of the archangel Michael), the signature mark of the Master of the Mint, the year 2014, and the country code ‘BE’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈中央为十字架，十字架中央刻有数字“150”。十字架的竖条和横条分别刻有“Rode Kruis”（红十字会）和“Croix-Rouge”（红十字会）字样。十字架周围环绕着布鲁塞尔造币厂的标志（戴头盔的大天使米迦勒侧面像）、造币厂厂长的签名、年份“2014”以及国家代码“BE”。硬币外圈则饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 150th anniversary of the union of the Ionian Islands with Greece (1864-2014)
description_en: The inner part of the coin depicts a seven-pointed star inscribed in Greek with the words: ‘150 YEARS SINCE THE UNION OF THE IONIAN ISLANDS (EPTÁNISA) WITH GREECE 1864-2014’, the name of the issuing country ‘HELLENIC REPUBLIC’ and the mint mark of the Greek State Mint. The spaces between the points of the star feature the symbols of the Ionian Islands. The entire design is encircled in a decorative stylised wave motif. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈图案为一颗七角星，星上以希腊文镌刻着“爱奥尼亚群岛（EPTÁNISA）与希腊合并150周年 1864-2014”字样、发行国名称“希腊共和国”以及希腊国家造币厂的标记。七角星的四个角之间饰有爱奥尼亚群岛的标志。整个图案外圈环绕着装饰性的波浪纹。硬币外圈则饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 400 years since the death of Domenikos Theotokopoulos (1614-2014)
description_en: The inner part of the coin shows a portrait of Domenikos Theotokopoulos. The background features a typical figure from his work, illustrative of his technique. On the left: the year 2014 and the characteristic signature of the artist (‘Domenikos Theotokopoulos Epoiei’). On the right: the mint mark of the Greek State Mint. The entire design is encircled in an inscription reading in Greek ‘DOMENIKOS THEOTOKOPOULOS 1541-1614’ and the name of the issuing country ‘HELLENIC REPUBLIC’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈为多米尼科斯·西奥托科波洛斯的肖像。背景图案为他作品中的典型人物，展现了他的绘画技法。左侧为2014年年份和艺术家签名（“Domenikos Theotokopoulos Epoiei”）。右侧为希腊国家造币厂的标记。整个图案周围环绕着希腊文铭文“DOMENIKOS THEOTOKOPOULOS 1541-1614”以及发行国名称“HELLENIC REPUBLIC”（希腊共和国）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Riga — European Capital of Culture 2014
description_en: The central image of the coin shows the skyline of Riga and the historic centre of the city that has been included in the list of the UNESCO World Heritage Sites. At the top of the image, the inscription ‘EIROPAS KULTURAS GALVASPILSETA’ (European capital of culture) and at the bottom the name of the celebrated city and the year of issuance ‘RIGA — 2014’, and underneath the indication of the issuing country ‘LV’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币中央图案展现了里加的城市天际线和被列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录的历史中心。图案上方刻有“EIROPAS KULTURAS GALVASPILSETA”（欧洲文化之都）字样，下方是里加这座城市的名称和发行年份“RIGA — 2014”，再下方是发行国“LV”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 200 years of Malta Police Force
description_en: The coin commemorates the 200th anniversary of the Malta Police Force which was set up by means of proclamation XXII of 1814. Thus the Malta Police Force is one of the oldest in Europe. The national side of the coin depicts the badge of the Malta Police Force with the legend ‘200 Years Malta Police Force’ and the dates 1814-2014. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币是为了纪念马耳他警察部队成立200周年而发行的。马耳他警察部队是根据1814年颁布的第XXII号公告成立的，因此它是欧洲历史最悠久的警察部队之一。硬币正面图案为马耳他警察部队的徽章，并刻有“马耳他警察部队成立200周年”字样以及1814-2014的年份。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 500th anniversary of the death of Bramante Lazzari delle Penne di San Marino
description_en: The coin depicts Bramante’s portrait, and part of Tempietto (Italian: ‘small temple’), which is a small commemorative tomb built by Donato Bramante, possibly as early as 1502, in the courtyard of San Pietro in Montorio and considered a masterpiece of the High Renaissance Italian architecture. The inscription ‘BRAMANTE LAZZARI DELLE PENNE DI SAN MARINO’ surrounds almost completely the design. At the left and right the years ‘1514’ and ‘2014’, respectively. At the bottom the initials of the artist ‘MCC’ (Maria Carmela Colaneri) and the mint mark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币上刻有布拉曼特的肖像，以及圣彼得教堂庭院内的小圣殿（意大利语：Tempietto，意为“小神庙”）的一部分。这座小圣殿是多纳托·布拉曼特建造的纪念墓，可能早在1502年就已建成，位于蒙托里奥的圣彼得教堂庭院内，被认为是意大利文艺复兴盛期建筑的杰作。“BRAMANTE LAZZARI DELLE PENNE DI SAN MARINO”（布拉曼特·拉扎里，圣马力诺笔杆）的铭文几乎环绕着整个图案。左侧和右侧分别标有年份“1514”和“2014”。底部是艺术家姓名首字母“MCC”（Maria Carmela Colaneri）和造币厂标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 100th Anniversary of the birth of author and artist Tove Jansson
description_en: The inner part of the coin depicts Tove Jansson’s portrait. Under the portrait the signature ‘Tove Jansson’ and the years ‘1914-2001’. At the left the indication of the issuing country ‘FI’. At the right the year of issuance ‘2014’ and the mint mark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈是托芙·扬松的肖像。肖像下方是签名“Tove Jansson”和年份“1914-2001”。左侧是发行国“FI”的标识。右侧是发行年份“2014”和造币厂标记。硬币外圈是欧盟的12颗星。

title: 200th Anniversary of the foundation of Arma dei Carabinieri
description_en: The design shows a reinterpretation of the sculpture ‘Pattuglia di Carabinieri nella tormenta’ made in 1973 by Antonio Berti; on the right, superimposed letters of the Italian Republic monogram ‘RI’/2014; on the left, 1814; up, superimposed letters R (monogram of the Mint of Rome); in exergue, LDS (monogram of the Author Luciana De Simoni)/CARABINIERI. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计是对安东尼奥·贝尔蒂 (Antonio Berti) 于 1973 年创作的雕塑作品《风暴中的宪兵队》(Pattuglia di Carabinieri nella tormenta) 的重新诠释；右侧为意大利共和国标志“RI”/2014 的叠加字母；左侧为 1814；上方为罗马造币厂标志“R”的叠加字母；下方为作者卢西亚娜·德·西蒙尼 (Luciana De Simoni) 的姓名缩写“LDS”/CARABINIERI。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的 12 颗星。

title: 450th Anniversary of the birth of Galileo Galilei (born in 1564)
description_en: The design shows the head of Galileo Galilei from the painting of Justus Sustermans, 1636 (Florence, Galleria degli Uffizi); around, upside, GALILEO GALILEI; on the right, superimposed letters R (monogram of the Mint of Rome)/astronomic telescope/C.M. (monogram of the Author Claudia Momoni); on the left, superimposed letters of the Italian Republic monogram ‘RI’; in exergue 1564-2014. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计图案为尤斯图斯·苏斯特曼斯 (Justus Sustermans) 于 1636 年创作的伽利略·伽利莱 (Galileo Galilei) 头像（现藏于佛罗伦萨乌菲齐美术馆）；上方环绕文字“GALILEO GALILEI”；右侧叠加字母“R”（罗马造币厂的缩写）/天文望远镜/C.M.（作者克劳迪娅·莫莫尼的缩写）；左侧叠加字母“RI”；下方铭文为“1564-2014”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的 12 颗星。

title: 70th anniversary of the Normandy landings of 6 June 1944
description_en: In the coin’s central field the word D-DAY is written in such a way as to depict a landing craft and a tank gun barrel. The years 1944-2014 appear above the tank gun, with the inscription ‘70e anniversaire du débarquement’ (70th anniversary of the landings) further down. The distinctive footprints left by the boots worn by American, British and Canadian troops are gradually disappearing in the sand, washed away by a wave. The words of a poem by Verlaine used as a code for the start of the landings are engraved on the wave: ‘Les sanglots longs des violons de l’automne blessent mon coeur d’une langueur monotone’ (the long sobs of the violins of autumn wound my heart with a monotonous languor). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币中央的图案巧妙地将“D-DAY”字样设计成登陆艇和坦克炮管的轮廓。坦克炮上方刻有1944-2014的年份，下方则铭刻着“70e anniversaire du débarquement”（登陆70周年）。美军、英军和加拿大军队留下的独特脚印正逐渐消失在沙滩上，被海浪冲刷殆尽。海浪上镌刻着魏尔伦的一首诗，这首诗曾被用作登陆开始的暗号：“Les sanglots longs des violons de l’automne blessent mon coeur d’une langueur monotone”（秋日小提琴悠长的呜咽声，令我心生单调的倦怠）。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: The official farewell to the former Queen Beatrix
description_en: The inner part of the coin depicts the effigies of both the King Willem-Alexander and the former Queen Beatrix. At the left, in semi-circle, the inscription ‘WILLEM-ALEXANDER KONING DER NEDERLANDEN’ and at the right, in semi-circle, the inscription ‘BEATRIX PRINSES DER NEDERLANDEN’. Between the two inscriptions, at the top, the crown symbol and at the bottom the mint master mark, the mint mark and in between the year of issuance ‘2014’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈刻有威廉-亚历山大国王和前王后贝娅特丽克丝的肖像。左侧半圆形铭文为“WILLEM-ALEXANDER KONING DER NEDERLANDEN”（荷兰国王威廉-亚历山大），右侧半圆形铭文为“BEATRIX PRINSES DER NEDERLANDEN”（荷兰公主贝娅特丽克丝）。两铭文之间，上方为皇冠图案，下方为造币厂标记和发行年份“2014”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 10th anniversary of the accession of the Slovak Republic to the European Union
description_en: At the centre of the national side are the stylised letters ‘EÚ’, as the abbreviation of the European Union, with the coat of arms of the Slovak Republic incorporated in the foreground. On the right-hand side of the inner part of the coin, in two lines, is the date of the Slovak Republic's accession to the European Union, ‘1.5.2004’, and immediately below it the year ‘2014’. Inscribed along the bottom edge of the inner part is the name of the issuing country, ‘SLOVENSKO’, while in a semi-circle along the upper edge is the inscription ‘10. VÝROČIE VSTUPU DO EURÓPSKEJ ÚNIE’. To the lower left is the mint mark of Kremnica Mint (composed of the letters ‘MK’ between two dies), and to the lower right are the stylised letters ‘MP’, the initials of the designer, Mária Poldaufová. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币正面中央是欧盟的缩写“EÚ”，斯洛伐克共和国国徽位于前景。硬币内侧右侧以两行文字分别标明斯洛伐克共和国加入欧盟的日期“1.5.2004”及其下方年份“2014”。内侧底部刻有发行国名称“SLOVENSKO”，而内侧顶部则以半圆形图案刻有“10. VÝROČIE VSTUPU DO EURÓPSKEJ ÚNIE”（斯洛伐克共和国加入欧盟十周年）。左下方是克雷姆尼察造币厂的造币厂标记（由两个模具之间的字母“MK”组成），右下方是风格化的字母“MP”，即设计师玛丽亚·波尔道福娃（Mária Poldaufová）的姓名首字母。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 40th Anniversary of the 25th April Revolution
description_en: The two curves represent the general shape of a carnation, the flower symbolizing the movement, which was also the origin of the revolution’s name. The name of the issuing country ‘PORTUGAL’ and the Coat of Arms are inscribed on the top of the flower. The center of the image shows the date of the event ‘25 DE ABRIL’ (25th April) and at the bottom is written the number of years past since the revolution ‘40 ANOS’ (40 years) and the year of issuance ‘2014’. The shape of the letters and numbers is inspired on those used in posters and other political information supports 40 years ago, as a symbol of the euphoric period lived right after the event. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这两条曲线勾勒出康乃馨的整体形状，康乃馨象征着这场运动，也是革命名称的由来。发行国“葡萄牙”的名称和国徽镌刻在花朵的上方。图案中心是事件发生的日期“25 DE ABRIL”（4月25日），下方则写着革命至今的年数“40 ANOS”（40年）和发行年份“2014”。字母和数字的形状灵感源自40年前的海报和其他政治宣传品，象征着革命后人们的狂热时期。硬币的外环饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Centenary of the start of the First World War
description_en: The coin’s central field depicts a poppy above the years 2014-18. Below these years appears the inscription ‘The Great War Centenary’, under which are the signature mark of the Master of the Mint and the mark of the Brussels mint, a helmeted profile of the archangel Michael. The top of the central field features the trilingual inscription ‘BELGIE — BELGIQUE — BELGIEN’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币中央图案为一朵罂粟花，下方是2014-2018年年份。年份下方是“第一次世界大战百年纪念”字样，再往下是造币厂厂长的签名和布鲁塞尔造币厂的标志——戴着头盔的大天使米迦勒的侧面像。中央图案顶部是比利时三语铭文“BELGIE — BELGIQUE — BELGIEN”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: UNESCO's World Cultural and Natural Heritage Sites — Park Güell
description_en: The coin depicts in the foreground a lizard sculpture which is the Park Güell emblem and was designed by the architect Antoni Gaudí. As background a detail of one of the pavilions situated at the Park Güell entrance. At the top, in circular sense and in capital letters the words ‘ESPAÑA’ and ‘PARK GÜELL — GAUDÍ’. At the left the year of issuance ‘2014’ and at the right the mintmark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币的前景描绘了一座蜥蜴雕塑，它是奎尔公园的标志，由建筑师安东尼·高迪设计。背景是奎尔公园入口处一座亭子的局部细节。顶部以圆形大写字母呈现“ESPAÑA”（西班牙）和“PARK GÜELL — GAUDÍ”（奎尔公园 — 高迪）。左侧是发行年份“2014”，右侧是造币厂标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 20 years in the Council of Europe
description_en: The design shows at the centre left the coat of arms of Andorra followed by the inscription "20" where the zero is stylised to represent the Council of Europe's flag. At the top are the inscriptions "ANDORRA" and underneath "AL CONSELL D'EUROPA". The year "2014" appears at the bottom left followed by an oblique line. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币图案中心左侧为安道尔国徽，国徽下方是数字“20”，其中数字“0”的样式设计成欧洲委员会旗帜的样式。顶部是“ANDORRA”（安道尔），下方是“AL CONSELL D'EUROPA”（欧洲委员会）。左下角是年份“2014”，下方是一条斜线。硬币外圈是欧盟的12颗星。

title: 175th anniversary of the independence of the Grand-Duchy of Luxembourg
description_en: The coin depicts on the right hand side of its inner part the effigy of His Royal Highness, the Grand-Duke Henri, looking to the right, and on the left hand side of its inner part, vertically positioned, the years ‘1839’ and ‘2014’ and the name of the issuing country ‘LËTZEBUERG’. The inscriptions ‘ONOFHÄNGEGKEET’ and ‘175 Joër’ appear at the bottom of the inner part of the coin. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币内侧右侧刻有亨利大公殿下的肖像，他面向右侧；内侧左侧垂直刻有年份“1839”和“2014”以及发行国“莱特岛”（LËTZEBUERG）。硬币内侧底部刻有“ONOFHÄNGEGKEET”（意为“无形”）和“175 Joër”（意为“175年”）字样。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Niedersachsen from the ‘Lander’ series
description_en: The desigh shows the Church of St. Michael in Hildesheim, Lower Saxony which has been on the Unesco World Cultural Heritage list since 1985. At the top the year of issuance ‘2014’ and at the left the mintmark (A, D, F, G, J). At the bottom, the inscription ‘NIEDERSACHSEN’ and underneath the indication of the issuing country ‘D’. At the top right, the initials of the engraver OE (Ott Erich). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 图案展现了位于下萨克森州希尔德斯海姆的圣米迦勒教堂，该教堂自1985年起被列入联合国教科文组织世界文化遗产名录。顶部为发行年份“2014”，左侧为造币厂标记（A、D、F、G、J）。底部刻有“NIEDERSACHSEN”（下萨克森州）字样，下方为发行国“D”。右上角为雕刻师OE（奥特·埃里希）的姓名首字母缩写。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The Lithuanian language
description_en: The design shows the word ‘AČIŪ’ (THANK YOU) — one of the most beautiful words in the Lithuanian language. An original Lithuanian font — created specially on the basis of the Latin font for the occasion of the centenary of the restoration of Lithuanian press — in order to match better the combinations of letters used most in the Lithuanian language, is used in the project. All the letters of the Lithuanian language are depicted on the background of the word ‘AČIŪ’, laid out in a tag cloud. At the bottom is the name of the issuing country ‘LIETUVA’ and underneath the name is the year ‘2015’. At the bottom right, under the word ‘AČIŪ’ is the mint mark of the Lithuanian Mint. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了“AČIŪ”（谢谢）一词——立陶宛语中最优美的词语之一。为了更好地匹配立陶宛语中最常用的字母组合，该设计采用了一种原创的立陶宛字体，该字体是在拉丁字体的基础上专门为纪念立陶宛新闻业复兴一百周年而创作的。所有立陶宛语字母都以标签云的形式排列在“AČIŪ”一词的背景上。底部是发行国“LIETUVA”的名称，其下方是年份“2015”。在“AČIŪ”一词的右下角是立陶宛造币厂的标记。硬币的外环饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 30th anniversary of the Coming of Age and Political Rights to the Men and Women turning 18 years old
description_en: The design shows a partial reproduction of a young person casting a vote. The ballot that the figure is holding reproduces the inscription ‘ANDORRA’. To the left of the figure there are the years that are being commemorated ‘1985’ and ‘2015’ (the latter is the year of issue of the coin as well). A shorter inscription of the commemoration surrounds the whole design ‘30è ANIVERSARI MAJORIA D’EDAT ALS 18 ANYS’ (30th anniversary Coming of Age at 18 years old). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了一位年轻人投票的局部图案。人物手中的选票上印有“安道尔”字样。人物左侧是纪念年份“1985”和“2015”（后者也是该硬币的发行年份）。环绕整个图案的是一段简短的纪念铭文：“30è ANIVERSARI MAJORIA D’EDAT ALS 18 ANYS”（18岁成年30周年）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 25th anniversary of the Signature of the Customs Agreement with the European Union
description_en: The design shows at the top the map of Andorra with the coat of arms of the Principality highlighted inside it. At the bottom of the design, two opposing arrows interlaced, symbolising the Customs Agreement between Andorra and the EU, show the years that are being commemorated ‘1990’ and ‘2015’ (the latter is also the year of issue of the coin) and the name of the issuing country ‘ANDORRA’. Surrounding the map of Andorra appears the inscription ‘25è aniversari de la Signatura de l’Acord Duaner amb la Unió Europea’ (25th anniversary of the Signature of the Customs Agreement with the European Union). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币顶部图案为安道尔地图，地图内突出显示了安道尔公国的国徽。底部图案为两条交错的箭头，象征着安道尔与欧盟之间的海关协定，箭头下方标明了纪念年份“1990”和“2015”（后者也是硬币的发行年份），以及发行国名称“安道尔”。安道尔地图周围环绕着铭文“25è aniversari de la Signatura de l’Acord Duaner amb la Unió Europea”（与欧盟签署海关协定25周年）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 800th anniversary of the construction of the first Castle on the rock
description_en: The design shows a tower on the top of the rock. At the top the name of the issuing country ‘MONACO’ flanked by the Paris mint mark and the mint master mark. At the bottom, the inscription ‘FONDATION DE LA FORTERESSE’ (Foundation of the fortress), flanked by the years ‘1215’ and ‘2015’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币图案描绘了一座耸立于岩石之巅的塔楼。顶部是发行国“摩纳哥”的名称，两侧分别是巴黎造币厂标记和造币厂厂长标记。底部是“FONDATION DE LA FORTERESSE”（堡垒奠基）字样，两侧分别是年份“1215”和“2015”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The VIII World Meeting of Families
description_en: The design depicts two families which ideally embrace the whole Earth. At the top, the year of issuance ‘2015’. At the left side, the name of the artist ‘C. Principe’. The mint mark R appears on the arm of one family member at the right. The design is surrounded by the inscription ‘VIII INCONTRO MONDIALE DELLE FAMIGLIE’ (The VIII World Meeting of Families), from the left to the right in semi-circle and ‘CITTA' DEL VATICANO’ at the bottom. The coin's outer ring depicts the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了两个象征着拥抱整个地球的家庭。顶部是发行年份“2015”。左侧是艺术家“C. Principe”的名字。造币厂标记“R”出现在右侧一位家庭成员的手臂上。图案周围环绕着半圆形铭文“VIII INCONTRO MONDIALE DELLE FAMIGLIE”（第八届世界家庭大会），从左至右排列，底部是“CITTA' DEL VATICANO”（梵蒂冈城）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: The 150th anniversary of the birth of artist Akseli Gallen-Kallela
description_en: On the top of the design there is a swimming swan of Tuonela. The water below the swan is waving from the descending spirit. The indication of the issuing country ‘FI’ is at the right end of the horizon line. At the bottom of the design there is the artist’s palette with Gallen-Kallela’s year of birth ‘1865’ and the year of issuance ‘2015’. Next to the pallet is the mint mark. The artist’s name ‘AKSELI GALLEN KALLELA’ is on the ring of the coin, below the horizon line. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 设计图案顶部是图奥内拉的一只游泳天鹅。天鹅下方的水面因下降的神灵而泛起涟漪。发行国“FI”的标识位于地平线的右侧。设计图案底部是艺术家的调色板，上面标有加伦-卡莱拉的出生年份“1865”和发行年份“2015”。调色板旁边是造币厂标记。艺术家的名字“AKSELI GALLEN KALLELA”位于硬币的外圈，地平线下方。硬币的外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Endangered nature – the Black Stork
description_en: The design shows a black stork (Ciconia nigra) which is considered to be one of the nature conservation flagship species in Europe. In 2005 the Black Stork Protection Plan was adopted in Latvia. At the bottom of the design is the name of the issuing country ‘LATVIJA’ and underneath the year of issuance ‘2015’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计图案为一只黑鹳（Ciconia nigra），它被认为是欧洲自然保护的旗舰物种之一。2005年，拉脱维亚通过了《黑鹳保护计划》。图案底部是发行国“拉脱维亚”（LATVIJA），下方是发行年份“2015”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 200th anniversary of the birth of Ľudovít Štúr
description_en: The design depicts a portrait of Ľudovít Štúr. Inscribed to the right of the portrait, parallel to the edge of the inner part of the coin, are the year of issuance ‘2015’ and, further right along the edge, the name of issuing country ‘SLOVENSKO’. Inscribed to the left of the portrait, parallel to the inner edge, are the dates of Štúr’s birth and death ‘1815–1856’ and, further left along the edge, the name ‘ĽUDOVÍT ŠTÚR’. In the upper right part of the design is the mint mark of the Kremnica Mint (Mincovňa Kremnica), consisting of the initials ‘MK’ placed between two dies. In the lower right part are the stylised letters ‘IŘ’, the initials of the designer, Ivan Řehák. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计图案为Ľudovít Štúr的肖像。肖像右侧，与硬币内圈边缘平行，刻有发行年份“2015”，再往右是发行国名称“斯洛伐克”。肖像左侧，与内圈边缘平行，刻有Štúr的生卒年份“1815–1856”，再往左是其姓名“ĽUDOVÍT ŠTÚR”。图案右上角是克雷姆尼察造币厂（Mincovňa Kremnica）的造币厂标记，由两个模具之间的字母“MK”组成。右下角是风格化的字母“IŘ”，即设计师Ivan Řehák的姓名首字母。硬币外圈印有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 30th anniversary of the EU flag
description_en: The designs show the EU flag as a symbol that unites people and cultures with shared visions and ideals for a better common future. Twelve stars that morph into human figures are embracing the birth of a new Europe. At the top right, in semi-circle, are the issuing country and the years ‘1985-2015’. At the bottom right are the initials of the artist (Georgios Stamatopoulos). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 设计图案以欧盟旗帜为象征，将拥有共同愿景和理想的人民和文化团结起来，共同创造更美好的未来。十二颗星幻化成人形，象征着新欧洲的诞生。右上角半圆形区域内印有发行国名称和年份“1985-2015”。右下角是艺术家（Georgios Stamatopoulos）的姓名首字母缩写。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的十二颗星。

title: 75 years in memoriam of Spyros Louis
description_en: The design shows Spyros Louis and the cup that he was awarded, against the background with the Panathenaic Stadium. Inscribed along the inner edge is the country of issuance ‘HELLENIC REPUBLIC’ and ‘75 YEARS IN MEMORIAM OF SPYROS LOUIS’ (in Greek). Above the cup appears the year of issuance ‘2015’ and to the right a palmette (the mint mark of the Greek Mint). Visible at the bottom of the design is the monogram of the artist (George Stamatopoulos). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币图案展现了斯皮罗斯·路易斯和他所获奖杯，背景是帕纳辛奈科体育场。内缘刻有发行国“希腊共和国”和“纪念斯皮罗斯·路易斯75周年”（希腊语）。奖杯上方是发行年份“2015”，右侧是希腊造币厂的棕榈叶图案。图案底部可见艺术家（乔治·斯塔马托普洛斯）的姓名缩写。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Republic of Malta 1974
description_en: The coin is the last in a series of five commemorating Maltese constitutional milestones. Malta was declared a republic on 13 December 1974 following constitutional changes which were agreed upon by a great majority in Malta’s Parliament. The design reproduces a marble tablet affixed to the façade of the Presidential Palace in Valletta to mark Malta’s change from a monarchy to a republic. At the top right, in semi-circle, the inscription ‘MALTA — Republic 1974’. At the bottom, the year ‘2015’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币是为纪念马耳他宪政里程碑而发行的五枚系列硬币中的最后一枚。1974年12月13日，马耳他议会以压倒性多数通过宪法修正案，宣布成立共和国。硬币的设计复刻了瓦莱塔总统府外墙上的一块大理石匾额，该匾额标志着马耳他从君主制国家转变为共和国。硬币右上角以半圆形图案镌刻着“马耳他——共和国 1974”字样，底部为年份“2015”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 25th anniversary of the German reunification
description_en: The design shows the Brandenburg Gate which during the Cold War was located in East Berlin, in two representations which are intertwined like two hands, symbolizing the reunification of the two parts of Berlin. At the right the mint mark ‘R’ and at the left the initials of the artist ‘ES’ (Erik Spiekermann). In circle around the design are the inscription ‘25o ANNIVERSARIO DELLA RIUNIFICAZIONE DELLA GERMANIA 1990-2015’ (25th anniversary of the German reunification) and the country and year of issuance ‘San Marino MMXV’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了勃兰登堡门，冷战时期它位于东柏林。勃兰登堡门以两个交缠的手形图案呈现，象征着柏林东西两部分的统一。右侧是造币厂标记“R”，左侧是艺术家姓名首字母“ES”（埃里克·施皮克曼）。图案周围环绕着铭文“25o ANNIVERSARIO DELLA RIUNIFICAZIONE DELLA GERMANIA 1990-2015”（德国统一25周年纪念 1990-2015）以及发行国家和年份“San Marino MMXV”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 2015 – European Year for Development
description_en: The inner part of the coin depicts a hand holding a globe of the Earth with a plant in the foreground. The inscription ‘2015 EUROPEAN YEAR FOR DEVELOPMENT’ features in an arc above the globe. The country code ‘BE’ appears beneath the hand while the signature mark of the Master of the Mint and the mark of the Brussels mint, a helmeted profile of the archangel Michael, are to its left. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈图案为一只手托着地球仪，前景中有一株植物。地球仪上方呈弧形排列着“2015 欧洲发展年”字样。手下方是国家代码“BE”，左侧是布鲁塞尔造币厂厂长签名和布鲁塞尔造币厂标志——戴着头盔的大天使米迦勒的侧面像。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 125th anniversary of the House of Nassau-Weilburg
description_en: On the left of the coin is the effigy of His Royal Highness Grand Duke Henri, and on the right, in a circular arrangement, and in chronological order of their accession to the throne, the portraits of their Royal Highnesses Grand Dukes Adolphe and Guillaume IV, Grand Duchesses Marie-Adélaïde and Charlotte, and Grand Duke Jean. To the right, also in circular format, is the inscription ‘1890 - Dynastie Nassau-Weilbourg’. The name of the issuing country, ‘Luxembourg’, and the year, ‘2015’, run vertically in the centre of the design. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币左侧是亨利大公殿下的肖像，右侧呈圆形排列，并按登基时间先后顺序依次为阿道夫大公殿下、纪尧姆四世大公殿下、玛丽-阿德莱德大公夫人、夏洛特大公夫人以及让大公殿下的肖像。右侧同样呈圆形排列的是铭文“1890 - 拿骚-魏尔堡王朝”。发行国“卢森堡”和年份“2015”垂直排列在图案中央。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 225th anniversary of the Fête de la Fédération (Festival of the Federation)
description_en: The French national holiday brings the people of France together in celebration of the Republic. The design shows Marianne, the symbol of the Republic, depicted in profile in a graphic, contemporary style. She is wearing the Phrygian cap. On the right the tricolour cockade appears in outline above the letters RF. The year is written in the centre of the coin. The left side features a stanza from the poem ‘Liberté’ by the French poet Paul Eluard, an allusion to the motto of the French Republic. The mint marks appear alongside this extract.The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 法国国庆日将法国人民凝聚在一起，共同庆祝共和国的建立。硬币的设计以现代风格的侧面像展现了共和国的象征——玛丽安娜。她头戴弗里吉亚帽。右侧是三色帽徽的轮廓，帽徽下方是字母“RF”。硬币中央刻有年份。左侧是法国诗人保罗·艾吕雅的诗作《自由》中的一节，呼应了法兰西共和国的格言。铸币厂标记位于这节诗旁边。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 750th anniversary of the birth of Dante Alighieri 1265-2015
description_en: The design shows Dante with an open book in his left hand and the Purgatory mountain at the back: detail from the illustration of the Divine Comedy painted by Domenico di Michelino (1417-1491) in the Dome of S. Maria del Fiore in Florence; in the centre, the monogram of the Italian Republic ‘RI’; at the right the inscription ‘R’, identifying the Mint of Rome; below the inscription ‘SP’, initials of Silvia Petrassi and the dates ‘1265 2015’, i.e. the year of the anniversary and that of the coin’s issue respectively; arch shaped, the inscription ‘DANTE ALIGHIERI’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 图案展现了但丁左手拿着一本打开的书，背景是炼狱山，取材自多梅尼科·迪·米凯利诺（1417-1491）在佛罗伦萨圣母百花大教堂穹顶绘制的《神曲》插图；中央是意大利共和国的缩写“RI”；右侧是罗马造币厂的字样“R”；下方是西尔维娅·佩特拉西的姓名首字母“SP”以及年份“1265-2015”，分别代表纪念年份和硬币发行年份；弧形图案为“但丁·阿里吉耶里”（DANTE ALIGHIERI）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 500 years of the first contacts with Timor, nowadays an independent Portuguese speaking country (Timor Lorosae)
description_en: The design depicts a XVI Century ship, representing the arrival of the Portuguese navigators to the island, and a local house thatched roof top, including the typical wood sculptures, permanent memories of myths and legends. The one depicted on the coin represents the history of the first inhabitants, who arrived by boat from other parts of the Asian continent and the importance of the horse to travel around the steep mountains which cover most of the island. At the top right, the year ‘1515’ and the name of the issuing country ‘PORTUGAL’. At the bottom left, the inscription ‘TIMOR’ and the year ‘2015’. At the bottom, the signature of the artist Fernando Fonseca. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币图案描绘了一艘16世纪的船只，象征着葡萄牙航海家抵达该岛；画面中还有一座茅草屋顶的当地民居，以及典型的木雕，这些木雕承载着神话传说的永恒记忆。硬币上的图案展现了第一批居民的历史，他们乘船从亚洲大陆其他地区来到这里，也体现了马匹在岛上崎岖险峻的山峦间穿行的重要性。硬币右上角刻有年份“1515”和发行国“葡萄牙”（PORTUGAL）。左下角刻有“帝汶”（TIMOR）和年份“2015”。最下方是艺术家费尔南多·丰塞卡（Fernando Fonseca）的签名。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 150th Anniversary of the Portuguese Red Cross
description_en: The design depicts a visual composition based on the well-known cross, symbol of the organisation, replicated several times to represent the expansion of the humanitarian action both in Portugal and abroad. The contour of a hand in the background symbolises the different kinds of help given by the organisation to the people, mostly medical, but also and among others: cooperating, constructing and supporting. At the left side, in semicircle, the inscription ‘CRUZ VERMELHA PORTUGUESA’. At the top, the Coat of Arms and the name of the issuing country ‘PORTUGAL’ and at the bottom the years ‘1865’ and ‘2015’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以著名的十字架为视觉元素，十字架是该组织的标志，多次重复出现，象征着人道主义行动在葡萄牙国内外的不断扩展。背景中一只手的轮廓象征着该组织向民众提供的各种援助，主要包括医疗援助，但也包括合作、建设和支持等。左侧半圆形区域内刻有“葡萄牙红十字会”（CRUZ VERMELHA PORTUGUESA）字样。顶部是国徽和发行国名称“葡萄牙”（PORTUGAL），底部是年份“1865”和“2015”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 750th anniversary of the birth of Dante Alighieri
description_en: The design by Annalisa Masini shows a portrait of Dante, taken from a fresco by Botticelli. At the right of the portrait, the inscription ‘DANTE’ on a vertical axis. At the right of the inner centre, the name of the issuing country ‘SAN MARINO’ in semi-circle. Between these two inscriptions, the mint mark ‘R’, the years ‘1265’ and ‘2015’ and the initials of the artist ‘AM’. The lettering style used in identifying the nation and the coin's subject was inspired by lettering in the first copies of the Divina Commedia (Dante’s Divine Comedy). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 安娜丽莎·马西尼设计的这枚硬币正面是但丁的肖像，取材于波提切利的一幅壁画。肖像右侧是竖向铭文“DANTE”。内侧中心右侧是半圆形的发行国名称“SAN MARINO”。在这两个铭文之间是造币厂标记“R”、年份“1265”和“2015”以及艺术家姓名缩写“AM”。用于识别国家和硬币主题的字体风格灵感源自《神曲》（但丁的《神曲》）早期版本的字体。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: First flight from Malta
description_en: The coin commemorates an important milestone in Maltese aviation history — the 100 years since the first flight from Malta. It was on 13 February 1915 that Captain Kilmer took off from the Grand Harbour on a seaplane that was carried by HMS Ark Royal. The plane landed in the harbour after a 55-minute flight. The coin depicts Captain Kilmer’s seaplane with Senglea Point, a prominent feature in the Grand Harbour, in the background. At the top the inscription ‘FIRST FLIGHT FROM MALTA’ in semi-circle. At the right the years ‘1915-2015’. At the bottom left the inscription ‘100TH ANNIVERSARY’ and at the bottom the initials of the designer ‘NGB’ (Noel Galea Bason). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚纪念币旨在纪念马耳他航空史上的一个重要里程碑——马耳他首次飞行一百周年。1915年2月13日，基尔默上尉驾驶着由皇家方舟号航空母舰搭载的水上飞机，从大港起飞。飞机飞行55分钟后降落在港口。纪念币图案为基尔默上尉的水上飞机，背景是大港的标志性建筑森格莱阿角。顶部半圆形铭文为“马耳他首次飞行”。右侧为年份“1915-2015”。左下角铭文为“百年纪念”，最下方是设计师姓名首字母“NGB”（诺埃尔·加莱亚·巴松）。纪念币外圈饰有欧盟十二星标志。

title: 15th anniversary of the accession to the throne of H.R.H. the Grand Duke
description_en: The coin depicts their Royal Highnesses Grand Duke Henri and the Grand Duchess. The year of accession ‘2000’, the issuing country ‘Luxembourg’ and the year mark ‘2015’ appear above them. Below them appears the inscription ‘15e anniversaire de l’accession au trône de S.A.R. le Grand-Duc’ (15th anniversary of the accession to the throne of H.R.H. the Grand Duke). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币正面是亨利大公殿下和夫人的肖像。上方刻有登基年份“2000”、发行国“卢森堡”和年份标记“2015”。下方铭文为“15e anniversaire de l’accession au trône de S.A.R. le Grand-Duc”（大公殿下登基十五周年）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟十二星标志。

title: EXPO Milano 2015
description_en: The design depicts a composition symbolising the fertility of Earth: on a semicircle indicating the terrestrial sphere, a seed fed by the water waits to sprout; above the Earth, a vine, an olive twig and an ear grow from a tree trunk; around, the inscription ‘NUTRIRE IL PIANETA’; on the left the initials of the designer Maria Grazia Urbani, ‘MGU’; on the right, the monogram of Italian Republic ‘RI’ and ‘R’, identifying the Mint of Rome; in the middle, logo of the EXPO MILANO 2015. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了一幅象征地球肥沃的图案：半圆形代表地球，一颗种子在水的滋养下等待发芽；地球上方，一棵树干上生长着藤蔓、橄榄枝和耳朵；周围环绕着铭文“NUTRIRE IL PIANETA”（滋养地球）；左侧是设计师玛丽亚·格拉齐亚·乌尔巴尼（Maria Grazia Urbani）的姓名首字母“MGU”；右侧是意大利共和国的标志“RI”和“R”，代表罗马造币厂；中间是2015年米兰世博会的标志。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Unesco’s World Cultural and Natural Heritage Sites — Cave of Altamira
description_en: The design depicts in the foreground the bison painting from the Cave of Altamira located in Cantabria. In the upper side of the image, in circular sense and with capital letters, the word ‘ESPAÑA’, at the bottom the year of issuance ‘2015’ and at the right the mint mark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以坎塔布里亚阿尔塔米拉洞穴出土的野牛壁画为前景。图像上方以圆形大写字母呈现“ESPAÑA”字样，下方为发行年份“2015”，右侧为造币厂标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 25 years of German Unity
description_en: The people in the foreground, who embody a new beginning and the advance towards a better future, are standing in front of the Brandenburg Gate, symbol of German unity. The rendering of the statement Wir sind ein Volk (‘we are one people’) — a collective expression of will by German citizens – represents the path forwards towards German reunification. The inner part also features the mint mark of the respective mint (‘A’, ‘D’, ‘F’, ‘G’ or ‘J’) as well as the issuing country’s country code ‘D’ and the engraver’s mark (the initials ‘BW’ — Bernd Wendhut). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 前景中的人们象征着新的开始和迈向更美好未来的步伐，他们站在勃兰登堡门前，勃兰登堡门是德国统一的象征。“Wir sind ein Volk”（我们是一个民族）的字样——德国公民集体意志的表达——代表着德国走向统一的道路。硬币内圈还刻有各造币厂的标记（“A”、“D”、“F”、“G”或“J”），发行国的国家代码“D”以及雕刻师的标记（“BW”，即Bernd Wendhut的姓名首字母）。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Hessen from the 'Lander' series
description_en: The design depicts a classic perspective on St. Paul’s Church in Frankfurt (the ‘Paulskirche’ was the seat of Germany’s first freely elected legislative body in 1849 and is regarded as the cradle of German democracy) and is therefore the perspective possessing the greatest recognition value. The design incisively brings out the tension between the dominant tower and the elliptical structure of the church. The slightly exaggerated flight of steps has an inviting quality while simultaneously offering support to the subjacent inscription ‘HESSEN’ (the Federal State of Hessen in which St. Paul’s Church is situated).The inner part also features the year ‘2015’ and the mint mark of the respective mint (‘A’, ‘D’, ‘F’, ‘G’ or ‘J’) at the left side as well as the issuing country’s indication ‘D’ and the engraver’s mark (the initials ‘HH’ — Heinz Hoyer) at the right side. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了法兰克福圣保罗教堂的经典视角（“保罗教堂”是1849年德国首个自由选举产生的立法机构所在地，被誉为德国民主的摇篮），因此也是最具辨识度的视角。设计巧妙地突出了教堂高耸的塔楼与椭圆形建筑之间的张力。略显夸张的阶梯既引人入胜，又与下方铭文“HESSEN”（圣保罗教堂所在的黑森州）相得益彰。硬币内侧左侧刻有年份“2015”和相应的造币厂标记（“A”、“D”、“F”、“G”或“J”），右侧则刻有发行国“D”和雕刻师标记（“HH”——海因茨·霍耶的姓名首字母）。硬币外圈印有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Emona-Ljubljana
description_en: The central image of the coin is the composition of letters that form the word ‘EMONA’ or ‘AEMONA’ and a stylised design of Emona. At the bottom, in circular sense, the inscription ‘EMONA LJUBLJANA SLOVENIJA 2015’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币中央图案由字母组成，构成单词“EMONA”或“AEMONA”，以及埃莫纳女神的程式化设计。底部呈圆形铭文为“EMONA LJUBLJANA SLOVENIJA 2015”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Europe building peace and security since 1945
description_en: In the coin’s central field is a modern graphic representation of a dove. It is carrying an olive branch, the symbol of peace, whose branches have been replaced by the 12 stars of the European flag. The 28 countries of the European Union are represented by the ISO code for each country. The letters RF (République Française) are at the bottom of the coin. The mint marks are on the left-hand side and the year 2015 on the right. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币中央图案为一只现代风格的鸽子，它衔着象征和平的橄榄枝，枝条被替换为欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。欧盟28个成员国分别以各自的ISO代码表示。硬币底部印有“RF”（法兰西共和国）字样。左侧为造币厂标记，右侧为年份“2015”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 150th anniversary of the birth of composer Jean Sibelius
description_en: At the inner part of the coin is sky with stars, tree tops at the right. The text ‘JEAN SIBELIUS’ and the year of issuance ‘2015’ are placed at the left inner part of the coin. At the right is the indication of the issuing country ‘FI’ and the mint mark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈图案为繁星点点的天空，右侧为树梢。硬币左侧内圈刻有“JEAN SIBELIUS”字样和发行年份“2015”。右侧为发行国“FI”和造币厂标记。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Latvian Presidency of the Council of the European Union
description_en: The design shows the official logo of the Latvian Presidency of the Council of the European Union. The logo is complemented by the lettering ‘LATVIJAS PREZIDENTŪRA ES PADOMĒ’ (LATVIAN PRESIDENCY OF THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION) and the website of the Presidency ‘EU2015.LV’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展示了拉脱维亚担任欧盟理事会轮值主席国的官方标志。标志旁配有“LATVIJAS PREZIDENTŪRA ES PADOMĒ”（拉脱维亚担任欧盟理事会轮值主席国）字样以及轮值主席国网站“EU2015.LV”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 150 years from the Arkadi Monastery Torching
description_en: The design features the Arkadi Monastery. Inscribed, at centre, is the wording ‘ARKADI MONASTERY’ and along the inner edge at left ‘HELLENIC REPUBLIC’, in Greek. Visible at upper right is the year of issuance ‘2016’ and below the central inscription a palmette (the mintmark of the Greek Mint). Inscribed at lower right is the monogram of the artist (George Stamatopoulos). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该硬币的设计图案为阿尔卡迪修道院。中央刻有“ARKADI MONASTERY”（阿尔卡迪修道院）字样，左侧内缘刻有希腊语“HELLENIC REPUBLIC”（希腊共和国）字样。右上角可见发行年份“2016”，中央铭文下方为棕榈叶图案（希腊造币厂的造币标记）。右下角刻有艺术家（乔治·斯塔马托普洛斯）的姓名缩写。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 120 years from the birth of Dimitri Mitropoulos
description_en: The design features the portrait of Dimitri Mitropoulos against the background of music notes. Inscribed along the inner edge at left is the wording ‘120 YEARS OF THE BIRTH OF DIMITRI MITROPOULOS’ and ‘HELLENIC REPUBLIC’, in Greek. At upper left apears the year of issuance ‘2016’ and a palmette (the mintmark of the Greek Mint). Visible at lower right is the monogram of the artist (George Stamatopoulos). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以音符为背景，正面是迪米特里·米特罗普洛斯的肖像。左侧内缘刻有希腊文“迪米特里·米特罗普洛斯诞辰120周年”和“希腊共和国”字样。左上方是发行年份“2016”和希腊造币厂的棕榈叶纹章。右下方是艺术家（乔治·斯塔马托普洛斯）的姓名首字母缩写。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 25th anniversary of the Radio and Television of Andorra
description_en: The design shows a microphone and an antenna circled by several circular lines with the inscription ‘25è ANIVERSARI DE RÀDIO I TELEVISIÓ D’ANDORRA’, the year of issuance ‘2016’ and the name of the State of issuance ‘ANDORRA’. This commemorative coin celebrates the 25th anniversary of the establishment of the Andorran public media with the beginning of the broadcast of the Andorran public radio and public television. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该纪念币的设计图案为麦克风和天线，周围环绕着数条圆环，并刻有“25è ANIVERSARI DE RÀDIO I TELEVISIÓ D’ANDORRA”（安道尔广播电视成立25周年）字样、发行年份“2016”以及发行国“安道尔”的名称。这枚纪念币旨在庆祝安道尔公共媒体成立25周年，以及安道尔公共广播和公共电视台的开播。纪念币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 150 years of the New Reform 1866
description_en: The design shows the main room of ‘Casa de la Vall’ (premises of the Andorran Parliament) with the inscription ‘150 ANYS DE LA NOVA REFORMA DE 1866’, the year of issuance ‘2016’ and the name of the State of issuance ‘ANDORRA’. This commemorative coin celebrates the 150 years of the New Reform Decree, one of the biggest steps on the Andorran and on the Consell General (Andorran Parliament) history, which represented a social and political transformation in the Principality of Andorra. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该纪念币的设计展现了“卡萨德拉瓦尔”（安道尔议会大厦）的主厅，并镌刻有“150 ANYS DE LA NOVA REFORMA DE 1866”（新改革法令颁布150周年）、发行年份“2016”以及发行国“安道尔”的名称。这枚纪念币旨在庆祝新改革法令颁布150周年，该法令是安道尔及其议会历史上最重要的里程碑之一，标志着安道尔公国的社会和政治转型。纪念币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The role of the Malta Community Chest Fund in Society
description_en: This coin is envisaged to commemorate the role of the Malta Community Chest Fund in Society through a programme for secondary school students entitled ‘From Children in Solidarity’. This programme identifies the social role of children in five different areas with the first theme being ‘Solidarity through Love’. This design was created by Ms Sarah Cilia a secondary school student who has expressed this theme through two hands forming a heart shape which displays a representation of the Maltese flag. At the bottom of the design is the inscription ‘MALTA 2016’. Two stylised representations of human bodies are designed on the left wrist and two on the right one. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚纪念币旨在纪念马耳他社区基金会通过名为“团结儿童”的中学生项目在社会中发挥的作用。该项目从五个不同领域探讨了儿童的社会角色，第一个主题是“爱心团结”。这枚纪念币的设计者是中学生莎拉·西利亚女士，她用两只手组成心形来表达这一主题，心形图案中融入了马耳他国旗的元素。图案底部刻有“马耳他 2016”字样。左手腕和右手腕上分别设计了两个风格化的人体图案。纪念币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Vidzeme
description_en: The designs shows the coat of arms of the historical region of Latvia — Vidzeme or Livland. At the top there is the inscription of the issuing country ‘LATVIJA’ and at the bottom the inscription ‘VIDZEME’. At the right is the year of issuance ‘2016’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 图案展现了拉脱维亚历史地区——维泽梅（或称利夫兰）的徽章。上方是发行国“拉脱维亚”（LATVIJA）的字样，下方是“维泽梅”（VIDZEME）的字样。右侧是发行年份“2016”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: François Mitterrand
description_en: The design shows a profile of a pensive François Mitterrand. Adjacent is his personal emblem of a half oak/half olive tree. Above are the dates marking the centenary of his birth (‘1916’ and ‘2016’) and his name. At the bottom, the indication of the issuing country ‘RF’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币正面图案为沉思的弗朗索瓦·密特朗侧脸。旁边是他的个人徽章——半橡树半橄榄树。上方是纪念他诞辰一百周年的年份（“1916”和“2016”）以及他的名字。底部是发行国“RF”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Jubilee of Mercy
description_en: The national face features St Martin of Tours sharing his cloak with a poor man. The design is surrounded by the inscriptions ‘GIUBILEO DELLA MISERICORDIA’ at the left and ‘CITTÀ DEL VATICANO’ at the right, both in semi-circle. At the right there is as well the year of issuance ‘2016’ and at the bottom the mint mark ‘R’ and the name of the artist ‘M. CRISCIOTTI’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币正面图案为圣马丁将斗篷分享给一位穷人。图案左侧环绕着“GIUBILEO DELLA MISERICORDIA”（慈悲之心）字样，右侧环绕着“CITTÀ DEL VATICANO”（梵蒂冈城）字样，两者均呈半圆形排列。右侧还标有发行年份“2016”，底部是造币厂标记“R”和艺术家姓名“M. CRISCIOTTI”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 100th anniversary of the birth of philosopher Georg Henrik von Wright
description_en: At the inner part of the coin is an ancient Doric pillar, and an oak branch at the left. The inscription ‘GEORG HENRIK VON WRIGHT’ is placed in semi-circle from left to right and the year of issuance ‘2016’ is placed on the top at the right. On the top at the left is the indication of the issuing country ‘FI’ and the mint mark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内侧是一根古老的多立克柱，左侧是一根橡树枝。铭文“GEORG HENRIK VON WRIGHT”呈半圆形排列，从左至右，发行年份“2016”位于右上角。左上角标有发行国“FI”和造币厂标记。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 400th anniversary of the death of William Shakespeare
description_en: The design depicts a portrait of the poet. On the right, in a semi-circle, the dates ‘1616-2016’ and the name of the issuing country ‘San Marino’; on the bottom right, the initials of the artist ‘MB’. On the left, in a semi-circle, the inscription ‘William Shakespeare’; on the bottom left, the mintmark ‘R’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计图案为诗人莎士比亚的肖像。右侧半圆形区域内刻有“1616-2016”字样和发行国“圣马力诺”的名称；右下角为艺术家姓名首字母“MB”。左侧半圆形区域内刻有“威廉·莎士比亚”字样；左下角为造币厂标记“R”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Ġgantija Temples
description_en: The coin depicts the Ġgantija Temples situated on the Island of Gozo. Ġgantija is a megalithic temple complex dating to the Neolithic ages. It is one of the world's oldest free-standing structures, as well as one of the oldest religious structures. Built approximately in the 36th century BC, Ġgantija pre-dates Stonehenge and the Egyptian Pyramids. At the top right the inscription ‘ĠGANTIJA TEMPLES’ and underneath the years ‘3600-3200 BC’. At the bottom left the name of the country of issuance ‘MALTA’ and underneath the year of issuance ‘2016’, flanked by the mint master mark and the mint mark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币描绘了位于戈佐岛的巨石神庙群（Ġgantija Temples）。巨石神庙群是一座新石器时代的巨石建筑群，也是世界上最古老的独立式建筑之一，同时也是最古老的宗教建筑之一。巨石神庙群建于公元前36世纪左右，比巨石阵和埃及金字塔还要古老。硬币右上角刻有“ĠGANTIJA TEMPLES”（巨石神庙）字样，下方标注年份“3600-3200 BC”（公元前3600-3200年）。左下角刻有发行国“MALTA”（马耳他）字样，下方标注发行年份“2016”，两侧分别是造币厂主标记和造币厂标记。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 50 years of the first bridge uniting the two riverbanks of the Tejo River
description_en: The design depicts the image of the bridge. At the top right is the inscription ‘PORTUGAL’. At the bottom right are the inscriptions ‘PONTE’, ‘25 DE ABRIL’, ‘1966’ and ‘2016’, one below the other. At the bottom left is the mintmark ‘INCM’ and at the bottom centre is the name of the designer ‘JOSÉ AURÉLIO’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了一座桥梁的图案。右上角是“PORTUGAL”（葡萄牙）字样。右下角依次是“PONTE”（桥梁）、“25 DE ABRIL”（4月25日）、“1966”和“2016”字样。左下角是造币厂标记“INCM”，底部中央是设计师“JOSÉ AURÉLIO”（若泽·奥雷利奥）的名字。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The Baltic culture
description_en: The design shows an amber disc, one of the most characteristic symbols of the Baltic culture. The disc is decorated with a crosspiece of drilled dots — an ornament symbolising the world’s axis. At the top is the name of the issuing country ‘LIETUVA’, flanked by the mint mark and the year of issuance ‘2016’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以琥珀圆盘为中心，琥珀圆盘是波罗的海文化最具代表性的象征之一。圆盘上饰有穿孔圆点组成的十字形图案，象征着世界轴心。圆盘顶部是发行国“立陶宛”（LIETUVA）的名称，两侧分别是造币厂标记和发行年份“2016”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 200th anniversary of the Vatican Guard
description_en: The national face features a Vatican Guard in front of the Dome of St. Peter’s Basilica. At the top, in semi-circle is the inscription ‘CORPO DELLA GENDARMERIA 1816-2016’. At the bottom, in semi-circle is the name of the issuing country ‘CITTÀ DEL VATICANO’. The mint mark ‘R’ appears at the left of the design and the name of the designer ‘D. Longo’ appears at the right. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币正面图案为梵蒂冈卫兵站在圣彼得大教堂圆顶前。上方半圆形区域内刻有“CORPO DELLA GENDARMERIA 1816-2016”（梵蒂冈宪兵队 1816-2016）。下方半圆形区域内刻有发行国名称“CITTÀ DEL VATICANO”（梵蒂冈城）。造币厂标记“R”位于图案左侧，设计师“D. Longo”位于右侧。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Latvian agricultural industry
description_en: The designs shows a Latvian brown cow which is one of the symbols of Latvian dairy farming both in folklore and in life. Underneath the design, at the left side there is the inscription of the year of issuance ‘2016’ and at the bottom of the inner circle the name of the issuing country ‘LATVIJA’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币图案为一头拉脱维亚棕色奶牛，它是拉脱维亚奶牛养殖业的象征之一，在民间传说和日常生活中都占有重要地位。图案下方左侧刻有发行年份“2016”，内圈底部刻有发行国名称“拉脱维亚”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 150th anniversary of the foundation of Monte Carlo by Charles III
description_en: The design shows CHARLES III within the background MONTE CARLO. At the top is the name of the issuing country ‘MONACO’ flanked by the mint mark and the mint master mark. At the bottom, in semi-circle from left to right is the inscription ‘1866 CHARLES III FONDE MONTE CARLO 2016’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币设计以“蒙特卡洛”为背景，中央是查理三世的肖像。顶部是发行国“摩纳哥”的名称，两侧分别是造币厂标记和造币厂厂长标记。底部从左至右呈半圆形排列着“1866 CHARLES III FONDE MONTE CARLO 2016”字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 25th anniversary of independence of the Republic of Slovenia
description_en: Over the left part of the inner circle is obliquely positioned a line. At its right, in the upper part of the coin is the inscription ‘25 LET’ and below it the inscription ‘REPUBLIKA SLOVENIJA’. Underneath these inscriptions is the original Prešeren’s written record of the part of the Slovenian hymn Zdravljica ‘dočákat’ dan’. At the bottom of the inner circle is the year ‘2016’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 内圈左侧斜向饰有一条线。在其右上方，硬币上刻有“25 LET”字样，下方刻有“REPUBLIKA SLOVENIJA”（斯洛文尼亚共和国）字样。这些字样下方是普雷舍伦（Prešeren）手抄的斯洛文尼亚赞美诗《Zdravljica ‘dočákat’ dan’》的部分内容。内圈底部为年份“2016”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: International Missing Children’s Day
description_en: The inner part of the coin displays in its centre the face of a child surrounded by the words ‘MISSING-DISPARU-VERMIST’, ‘WWW.CHILDFOCUS.BE’ and the trilingual indication of nationality ‘BELGIQUE-BELGIE-BELGIEN’ followed by the year 2016. The mark of the Brussels mint, a helmeted profile of the archangel Michael and the signature mark of the Master of the Mint appear to the left and right respectively of the face. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈中央为一名儿童的头像，周围环绕着“MISSING-DISPARU-VERMIST”、“WWW.CHILDFOCUS.BE”字样以及比利时国籍的三语标识“BELGIQUE-BELGIE-BELGIEN”，下方为年份“2016”。头像左右两侧分别饰有布鲁塞尔造币厂的标志、戴头盔的大天使米迦勒的侧面像以及造币厂厂长的签名。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: The Finnish writer and lyricist Eino Leino
description_en: At the inner part of the coin is a flame, and a poker pointing upwards to the right. The inscription ‘EINO LEINO’, in semi-circle and the year of issuance ‘2016’ are placed at the right. At the bottom left is the indication of the issuing country ‘FI’ and the mint mark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内侧图案为火焰，以及一根指向右上方的拨火棍。右侧半圆形铭文“EINO LEINO”和发行年份“2016”位于其上。左下方为发行国“FI”和造币厂标记。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 550th anniversary of the death of Donatello
description_en: The design depicts, in the foreground on the left, a portrait of David, being a detail of the bronze sculpture by Donatello. At centre top, the mintmark ‘R’; on the right, the name of the issuing country ‘SAN MARINO’; at bottom right, the inscription ‘Donatello’, the dates ‘1466-2016’ and, in the centre, the initials of the artist ‘MB’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计左侧前景描绘了大卫的肖像，取材自多纳泰罗的青铜雕塑。顶部中央是造币厂标记“R”；右侧是发行国名称“圣马力诺”；右下角是铭文“多纳泰罗”、日期“1466-2016”以及艺术家姓名缩写“MB”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Portuguese team participating in the Rio 2016 Olympic Games
description_en: The design shows an image based on the well-known artwork ‘Heart of Viana’, signed by the author Joana Vasconcelos, which was inspired by traditional jewellery from the north of Portugal (the area around the city of Viana do Castelo). It symbolises the Portuguese people’s support for the national team on the occasion of the Olympics. At the left and the right, in semi-circle, are the inscriptions ‘JOANA VASCONCELOS’ and ‘EQUIPA OLÍMPICA DE PORTUGAL 2016’, respectively. At the bottom is the mint mark ‘INCM’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以著名艺术家若安娜·瓦斯康塞洛斯（Joana Vasconcelos）的画作《维亚纳之心》（Heart of Viana）为蓝本，其灵感源自葡萄牙北部（维亚纳堡周边地区）的传统珠宝。它象征着葡萄牙人民在奥运会之际对国家队的支持。硬币左右两侧呈半圆形，分别刻有“JOANA VASCONCELOS”和“EQUIPA OLÍMPICA DE PORTUGAL 2016”（葡萄牙奥运代表队 2016）字样。底部为造币厂标记“INCM”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟十二星标志。

title: 550th anniversary of the death of Donatello
description_en: Head of Donatello’s David (detail of the bronze sculpture on display in the National Museum of Bargello, Florence). On the left, ‘RI’, the monogram of the Italian Republic’; on two lines below, ‘1466’ and ‘2016’. On the right, ‘C.M.’, the initials of the author Claudia Momoni; below, ‘DONATELLO’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 多纳泰罗《大卫》的头部（佛罗伦萨巴杰罗国家博物馆展出的青铜雕塑局部）。左侧为“RI”，即意大利共和国的缩写；下方两行分别为“1466”和“2016”。右侧为“C.M.”，即作者克劳迪娅·莫莫尼的姓名首字母；下方为“DONATELLO”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 2200th anniversary of the death of Tito Maccio Plauto
description_en: Theatre masks representing two New Comedy characters, a young woman and a slave, from a mosaic of the second century AD (Capitoline Museums, Rome); around, the construction plan of a Roman theatre and ‘RI’, the monogram of the Italian Republic; on the left, ‘R’, and on the right, ‘LDS’, the initials of the author Luciana De Simoni; below, ‘184 A. C.’, ‘2016’ and ‘PLAUTO’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币正面图案为公元二世纪罗马卡比托利欧博物馆藏马赛克镶嵌画中的两个新喜剧人物面具，分别为一位年轻女子和一位奴隶；周围环绕着罗马剧院的建筑平面图和意大利共和国的缩写“RI”；左侧为“R”，右侧为“LDS”，分别是作家卢西亚娜·德·西蒙尼的姓名首字母；下方刻有“公元184年”、“2016年”和“PLAUTO”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Olympic Games
description_en: The inner part of the coin depicts, from top to bottom, a stylised figure, the five Olympic rings and the inscription ‘TEAM BELGIUM’. The year 2016 is written on the left-hand side of the coin. The country code ‘BE’ appears on the right-hand side of the coin, between the mark of the Brussels mint, a helmeted profile of the archangel Michael, and the signature mark of the Master of the Mint. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈自上而下依次为：一个程式化的人物图案、五环标志和“比利时队”（TEAM BELGIUM）字样。硬币左侧刻有年份“2016”。硬币右侧是国家代码“BE”，位于布鲁塞尔造币厂标志、戴头盔的大天使米迦勒侧面像和造币厂厂长签名之间。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: The first Slovak Presidency of the Council of the European Union
description_en: The design centres on the coat of arms of the Slovak Republic, shown against a background of dynamic centripetal lines representing the position and importance of the Slovak Republic during its presidency of the Council of the European Union. To the right of the coat of arms: the year ‘2016’. Around the edge of the inner circle: the country name ‘SLOVENSKO’ (Slovakia) and the inscription ‘PREDSEDNÍCTVO SR V RADE EÚ’ (Slovak Presidency of the EU Council), separated by graphical symbols. The mint mark of Kremnica Mint, composed of the letters ‘MK’ between two die, and the stylised initials of the designer of the national side, Vladimír Pavlica, ‘VP’, are in the lower part of the composition. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以斯洛伐克共和国国徽为中心，国徽背景是动感的向心线，象征着斯洛伐克共和国在担任欧盟理事会轮值主席国期间的地位和重要性。国徽右侧是年份“2016”。内圈边缘环绕着国名“SLOVENSKO”（斯洛伐克）和铭文“PREDSEDNÍCTVO SR V RADE EÚ”（斯洛伐克担任欧盟理事会轮值主席国），两者之间以图形符号分隔。克雷姆尼察造币厂的标记（由两个模具之间的字母“MK”组成）以及国徽设计者弗拉基米尔·帕夫利察（Vladimír Pavlica）的姓名首字母缩写“VP”位于图案下方。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 50th anniversary of the ‘Grand Duchess Charlotte Bridge’
description_en: The design shows the ‘Grand Duchess Charlotte Bridge’, which is the main infrastructure connecting the city centre of Luxembourg to the urban quarter of Kirchberg, the location of the city’s European Union institutions. The French name of the bridge, ‘Pont Grande-Duchesse Charlotte’, is inscribed on the image of the bridge, and the year ‘1966’ appears directly beneath this text. At the top of the design, an image of the Grand Duke Henri of Luxembourg; at its left, the year of issuance ‘2016’. At the bottom appears the name of the issuing country, ‘LUXEMBOURG’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了“夏洛特大公爵夫人桥”，它是连接卢森堡市中心和基尔希贝格城区（欧盟机构所在地）的主要基础设施。桥梁的法语名称“Pont Grande-Duchesse Charlotte”镌刻在桥梁图案上，其下方紧邻年份“1966”。设计顶部是卢森堡大公亨利的肖像；左侧是发行年份“2016”。底部是发行国名称“卢森堡”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Saxony (Federal States series)
description_en: The design shows a view of the world-famous Zwinger Palace in Dresden, namely of the inner yard giving way to the Crown Gate. It includes the name ‘SACHSEN’ (Saxony) and the country code ‘D’ at the bottom, the mint mark of the respective mint (‘A’, ‘D’, ‘F’, ‘G’ or ‘J’) as well as the engraver’s mark (the initials ‘JT’ for Jordi Truxa) at the top right and the year ‘2016’ at the top left. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了举世闻名的德累斯顿茨温格宫的景色，具体来说是通往皇冠门的内院。底部包含“SACHSEN”（萨克森）字样和国家代码“D”，右上角是相应造币厂的标记（“A”、“D”、“F”、“G”或“J”）以及雕刻师标记（Jordi Truxa 的姓名首字母“JT”），左上角是年份“2016”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Unesco’s World Cultural and and Natural Heritage Sites – Segovia
description_en: The design depicts in the foreground the aqueduct of Segovia. At the top of the inner circle, and following the circular shape of the coin, is the name of the issuing country ‘ESPAÑA’; underneath it, the year of issuance ‘2016’. At the top right is the mint mark. The coin's outer ring depicts the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该硬币正面图案描绘了塞戈维亚引水渠。内圈顶部，沿着硬币的圆形轮廓，是发行国“西班牙”（ESPAÑA）的名称；其下方是发行年份“2016”。右上角是造币厂标记。硬币外圈图案为欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: 200 years of Oesterreichische Nationalbank
description_en: The design depicts a carved relief with two gods from Roman mythology standing before the entrance to the main building of the Oesterreichische Nationalbank (OeNB): to the left, Mercury, the messenger of the gods and the god of merchants and commerce; to the right, Fortuna, the goddess of fate and prosperity, who is portrayed with a horn of plenty. The background detail, running from the left to the right edges of the core, shows the OeNB’s main premises. An ornamental band skirting the bottom of the coin centre evokes the red-white-red pattern of the Austrian national flag, with hatched vertical lines symbolising the colour red, as laid down in the rules of heraldic design. The years ‘1816’ and ‘2016’ to the left of Mercury refer to the OeNB’s founding year and its bicentennial. The inscriptions running along the edges of the gold-coloured centre read ‘Republik Österreich’ (Republic of Austria) and ‘200 Jahre Oesterreichische Nationalbank’ (200 years of Oesterreichische Nationalbank). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了一幅浮雕，两位罗马神话中的神祇伫立于奥地利国家银行（OeNB）主楼入口前：左侧是众神的信使、商人和商业之神墨丘利；右侧是命运与繁荣女神福尔图娜，她手持丰饶之角。从币面中心向右延伸的背景细节展现了奥地利国家银行的主楼。环绕币面中心底部的装饰带呼应了奥地利国旗的红白红三色图案，其中垂直的斜线象征着红色，符合纹章设计规则。墨丘利左侧的“1816”和“2016”分别代表奥地利国家银行的成立年份和二百周年纪念。金色中心边缘的铭文为“奥地利共和国”（Republik Österreich）和“奥地利国家银行200周年”（200 Jahre Oesterreichische Nationalbank）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 2016 UEFA European Championship
description_en: Held every four years since 1960, the UEFA European Championship – the sporting highlight commonly referred to as ‘the Euro’ – took place in France from 10 June to 10 July 2016. Euro 2016, the fifteenth edition of the competition, was organised by the Union of European Football Associations, and brought together the best men’s football teams in Europe. The winner of the competition received a small-scale version of the Henri Delaunay Cup, named after the man who invented it. The design of the coin features the Henri Delaunay Cup in the middle of an outline map of France, along with the two marks of the Paris Mint. The letters ‘RF’ for République Française (French Republic) are to the right of the map of France, and the name of the competition, ‘UEFA EURO 2016 France’, appears above it. Below the map, a football stands out in the foreground. All of this is set on a background that features graphical elements representing the competition. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 自1960年以来每四年举办一次的欧洲足球锦标赛（简称“欧洲杯”）——这项体育盛事通常被称为“欧洲杯”——于2016年6月10日至7月10日在法国举行。2016年欧洲杯是该赛事的第十五届，由欧洲足球协会联盟（UEFA）组织，汇聚了欧洲最优秀的男子足球队。比赛的冠军将获得一枚小型亨利·德劳内杯，该奖杯以其发明者亨利·德劳内的名字命名。纪念币的设计以法国地图为背景，中央是亨利·德劳内杯，旁边是巴黎造币厂的两个标记。法国地图右侧是“RF”（法兰西共和国）的缩写，上方是赛事名称“2016年欧洲杯法国站”。地图下方，一个足球图案醒目地位于前景。所有这些元素都置于代表该赛事的图形背景之上。硬币外圈印有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 100th anniversary of the birth of the famous Estonian chess grandmaster Paul Keres
description_en: The coin features a portrait of the great Estonian chess player Paul Keres with some chess pieces. At the top left, in semi-circle, is the inscription ‘PAUL KERES’; the name of the issuing country ‘EESTI’ appears directly below it, with the year of issuance ‘2016’ on the line underneath. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币正面是爱沙尼亚著名国际象棋棋手保罗·克雷斯的肖像，周围环绕着一些棋子。左上角半圆形区域内刻有“PAUL KERES”字样；发行国“EESTI”紧随其后，再下方一行是发行年份“2016”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 100 years since the 1916 Easter Rising in Ireland
description_en: The design shows the statue of Hibernia perched at the top of the General Post Office building – the seizure of which marked the beginning of the Easter rising back in 1916. She is a symbol of Ireland. Her name was taken from the ancient Greek reference for Ireland and her form was realised by the sculptor John Smyth. She is viewed as a witness to the events of 1916 and, in the 100 years since, she has seen the nation blossom before her based on the ideals set out in the Proclamation. She continues to look forward and is a symbol of the past, present and future of the country. At the top of the inner circle, the inscription ‘HIBERNIA’ appears in hand‑rendered lettering that takes influence from the historic Book of Kells. The sunrays reflect well the underlying concept of the Rising and the Proclamation, e.g. the dawning of the new nation/republic. The image of the statue is flanked by the years ‘1916’ and ‘2016’. At the bottom of the inner circle appears the name of the issuing country ‘éire’ and, underneath it, the year of issuance ‘2016’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 设计图展现了希伯尼亚女神的雕像矗立在总邮局大楼的顶端——1916年复活节起义爆发之际，这座大楼被占领，标志着起义的开始。她是爱尔兰的象征。她的名字源自古希腊语中“爱尔兰”一词，雕像由雕塑家约翰·史密斯创作。她被视为1916年事件的见证者，在之后的100年里，她见证了国家在《独立宣言》所阐述的理想基础上蓬勃发展。她始终展望未来，象征着国家的过去、现在和未来。在内圈顶部，手写体“HIBERNIA”的字样灵感源自历史悠久的《凯尔经》。阳光象征着起义和《独立宣言》的深层含义，即新国家/共和国的曙光。雕像两侧分别标有“1916”和“2016”的年份。内圈底部是发行国名称“éire”，其下方是发行年份“2016”。硬币外圈印有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Andorra – The Pyrenean country
description_en: The design reproduces on its upper part a triangle, consisting of three undulating strips representing a simplified version of the map of the country, with the inscriptions ‘Andorra’ and ‘EL PAÍS DELS PIRINEUS’ (the Pyrenean country). These three elements make up the brand owned by the Government of Andorra, which is used to provide a uniform, consistent and coordinated image to all graphic communication and, at the same time, achieve an unmistakable and instant identification. The lower part of the design depicts the year of issuance ‘2017’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计上半部分呈现一个三角形，由三条波浪形条纹组成，代表简化的安道尔地图，并刻有“Andorra”（安道尔）和“EL PAÍS DELS PIRINEUS”（比利牛斯山脉之国）字样。这三个元素构成安道尔政府的品牌标识，用于为所有图形传播提供统一、一致且协调的形象，同时实现清晰醒目的识别。设计下半部分标明发行年份“2017”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 100 years of the anthem of Andorra
description_en: The design depicts a partial reproduction of the anthem of Andorra published in 1914. The central part of the design reproduces the first notes of the anthem flanked by an ornamentation of floral style and the inscription ‘Himne Andorrà’ (Andorran anthem). The upper part of the design shows the year of issuance ‘2017’ and the inscription ‘100 anys de l’himne d’Andorra’ (100 years of the anthem of Andorra). This coin commemorates the 100th anniversary of its admission as the national anthem of Andorra by agreement of the Consell General (Andorran Parliament) of 2 April 1917. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计部分再现了1914年发布的安道尔国歌。设计中心部分再现了国歌的开头几个音符，两侧饰以花卉图案，并镌刻有“Himne Andorrà”（安道尔国歌）字样。设计上方标明发行年份“2017”和“100 anys de l’himne d’Andorra”（安道尔国歌百年纪念）。这枚硬币是为了纪念该国歌于1917年4月2日经安道尔议会决议正式成为安道尔国歌一百周年而发行的。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Solidarity and peace
description_en: The coin’s theme centres on the concept of solidarity and peace. The design was created by a school student and depicts two children holding the Maltese flag with the dove of peace flying over them. At the bottom is the name of the issuing country ‘Malta’ and at the right side is the year of issuance ‘2017’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币的主题围绕团结与和平展开。设计出自一位学生之手，图案描绘了两个孩子手持马耳他国旗，和平鸽在他们上方飞翔。底部是发行国“马耳他”的名称，右侧是发行年份“2017”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Carabiniers du Prince (‘Carabiniers’ of the Prince)
description_en: The design shows a CARABINIER and in the background the Palace of Monaco. At the top is the inscription ‘MONACO’ flanked by the mintmark and the mint master mark. At the bottom are the years ‘1817-2017’ and underneath the inscription ‘CARABINIERS DU PRINCE’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币图案为一名宪兵，背景是摩纳哥王宫。顶部刻有“MONACO”字样，两侧分别是造币厂标记和造币厂厂长标记。底部刻有年份“1817-2017”，下方刻有“CARABINIERS DU PRINCE”（王子宪兵）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 150 years of the birth of writer Raul Brandão
description_en: The design shows the face of Raul Brandão. At the left side is the inscription RAUL BRANDÃO and underneath the years ‘1867’ and ‘2017’. At the bottom right is the inscription of the country of issuance ‘PORTUGAL’ and at the top right is the name of the author ‘LUIS FILIPE DE ABREU’ followed by the mintmark ‘INCM’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该硬币正面图案为劳尔·布兰当（Raul Brandão）的头像。左侧刻有“RAUL BRANDÃO”字样，下方分别为年份“1867”和“2017”。右下角刻有发行国“PORTUGAL”（葡萄牙），右上角刻有设计者“LUIS FILIPE DE ABREU”的名字，其后是造币厂标记“INCM”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Latgale
description_en: The design shows the coat of arms of the region of Latgale. At the top, the name of the issuing country ‘LATVIJA’ and at the bottom the inscription ‘LATGALE’. At the right hand side, the year of issuance ‘2017’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了拉特加莱地区的徽章。上方是发行国“拉脱维亚”（LATVIJA）的名称，下方是“拉特加莱”（LATGALE）的字样。右侧是发行年份“2017”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 200th anniversary of the Grand Duke Guillaume III
description_en: The design shows on the left hand the effigy of His Royal Highness, the Grand-Duke Henri, looking to the left and on the right hand the effigy of HRH the Grand-Duke Guillaume III. At the top of the design is depicted the year-date ‘2017’. At the bottom appears the text ‘GRANDS-DUCS DE LUXEMBOURG’.
