The name ‘GUILLAUME III’ followed by the indication of the year of birth ‘*1817’ is depicted above the respective effigy. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计左侧为亨利大公殿下的肖像，面向左侧；右侧为纪尧姆三世大公殿下的肖像。设计顶部标有年份“2017”。底部文字为“卢森堡大公”。“纪尧姆三世”及其出生年份“*1817”分别位于相应肖像上方。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Centenary of the Fatima apparitions
description_en: The design features the three young shepherds to whom Mary appeared, on the background the Sanctuary of Fatima. At the top is the inscription ‘CITTÀ DEL VATICANO’ in semi-circle and right under is the year ‘1917’. Underneath the year, from left to right, is the inscription ‘FATIMA 2017’. At the left side is the mintmark ‘R’ and at the bottom the name of the designer ‘O.ROSSI’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以圣母玛利亚显灵的三位年轻牧羊人为主题，背景是法蒂玛圣殿。顶部半圆形铭文为“梵蒂冈城”（CITTÀ DEL VATICANO），其下方为年份“1917”。年份下方，从左至右依次为“FATIMA 2017”。左侧为造币厂标记“R”，底部为设计师姓名“O.ROSSI”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟十二星标志。

title: The Finnish nature
description_en: The inner part of the coin has a design forming a cartographic likeness of the moon seen from Harmaja, Finland. On the top of the moon there is a crow sitting on a branch. The year of issuance ‘2017’ is placed at the center bottom. At the center left is the indication of the issuing country ‘FI’. The mint mark is placed center right. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈图案为从芬兰哈尔马亚看到的月球地图。月球上方有一只乌鸦栖息在树枝上。发行年份“2017”位于底部中央。左侧中央是发行国“FI”的标识。造币厂标记位于右侧中央。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Paphos 2017 – European Capital of Culture
description_en: The design shows the ‘Paphos Ancient Odeon’, a small amphiteatre dating back to the 2nd century AD. Nowadays it is used in the summer for musical theatrical performances and it will be the venue of a number of events to be held within the program of ‘Paphos 2017 – European Capital of Culture’. The issuing country’s name ‘ΚΥΠΡΟΣ KIBRIS’ and the phrase ‘Πάφος 2017 – Πολιτιστική πρωτεύουσα Ευρώπης’ (i.e. Paphos 2017 – European capital of Culture) are inscribed on the inner part of the national side of the coin. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了“帕福斯古剧场”，这是一座可追溯至公元2世纪的小型圆形剧场。如今，它在夏季用于举办音乐剧演出，并将作为“帕福斯2017——欧洲文化之都”系列活动的举办地之一。发行国名称“ΚΥΠΡΟΣ KIBRIS”和“Πάφος 2017 – Πολιτιστική πρωτεύουσα Ευρώπης”（即“帕福斯2017——欧洲文化之都”）铭刻在硬币内侧。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 25th anniversary of the pink ribbon, symbol of the fight against breast cancer
description_en: Since the 1990s, the fight against breast cancer has been a major cause around the world. On the occasion of the 25th anniversary of the pink ribbon, iconic symbol of this fight, Monnaie de Paris has decided to support this cause. For nearly 15 years, a pink ribbon prize has been presented every year to support research efforts and innovation. The design represents a woman’s bust symbolically protected by a hand and the ribbon. It is surrounded, at the right side, by the inscription ‘25e ANNIVERSAIRE DU RUBAN ROSE’ (25th anniversary of the pink ribbon). The right side also features the years ‘1992 – 2017’, the indication of the issuing country ‘RF’ and the mintmarks. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 自上世纪90年代以来，对抗乳腺癌一直是全球关注的焦点。值此粉红丝带——这一对抗乳腺癌的标志性象征——诞生25周年之际，巴黎造币厂决定支持这项事业。近15年来，每年都会颁发粉红丝带奖，以支持乳腺癌研究和创新。

title: 200th anniversary of the Ghent University
description_en: The inner part of the piece represents the logo of the Ghent University, with the dates 1817 - 2017 below, surrounded by the inscription 200 JAAR UNIVERSITEIT GENT – 200 YEARS GHENT UNIVERSITY and the country indication BE. The mintmark of Brussels, a helmeted head of the Archangel Michael, and the mint directors’ mintmark, the coat of arms of the municipality Herzele, are located respectively on the right and left of the country indication. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈为根特大学的校徽，下方标有1817-2017的字样，周围环绕着“200 JAAR UNIVERSITEIT GENT – 200 YEARS GHENT UNIVERSITY”（根特大学建校200周年）字样以及比利时国家标识“BE”。布鲁塞尔造币厂的标记——戴头盔的大天使米迦勒头像，以及造币厂厂长标记——赫泽勒市的市徽，分别位于比利时国家标识的左右两侧。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: International Year of Sustainable Tourism for Development
description_en: The design shows in the center Planet Earth surrounded by waves; to the right a circle with the letter A, symbol of the designer Andrew Lewis. Arched, above the writing “TURISMO SOSTENIBILE”, below “SAN MARINO” and the year “2017”; to the right the initials of the engraver Uliana Pernazza “UP INC.”; to the left the letter “R” of the Italian Mint which took care of the mintage. The United Nations General Assembly approved the adoption of 2017 as the International Year of Sustainable Tourism for Development. The idea of sustainable Tourism indicates a kind of travelling that respects the planet, it doesn’t alter the natural, social and artistic environment and it doesn’t inhibit the growth of social and economic activities. It is a kind of tourism opposite to mass tourism and it tends to promote the weakest economies. The Republic of San Marino dedicated a 2 euro commemorative coin, designed by the Canadian artist Andrew Lewis to this theme, in order to promote a new mentality and to encourage tourists’ respect for environment. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 设计中心是地球，周围环绕着波浪；右侧是一个圆圈，圆圈内有字母A，这是设计师安德鲁·刘易斯的标志。拱形上方写着“TURISMO SOSTENIBILE”（可持续发展旅游），下方写着“SAN MARINO”（圣马力诺）和年份“2017”；右侧是雕刻师乌利亚娜·佩尔纳扎的姓名首字母“UP INC.”；左侧是负责铸造的意大利造币厂的字母“R”。

title: Kurzeme
description_en: The design shows the coat of arms of the region of Kurzeme. At the top, the name of the issuing country "LATVIJA" and at the bottom the inscription "KURZEME". At the right hand side, the year of issuance "2017". The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该硬币的设计图案为库尔泽梅地区的徽章。上方是发行国“拉脱维亚”（LATVIJA），下方是“库尔泽梅”（KURZEME）字样。右侧是发行年份“2017”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Vilnius
description_en: The design shows a fragment of the Vilnius city panorama. At the left side is the inscription ‘VILNIUS’ and the mark of the designer. At the top right is the name of the issuing country ‘LIETUVA’ and the year of issuance ‘2017’. At the centre is the mintmark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了维尔纽斯城市全景的一部分。左侧刻有“VILNIUS”（维尔纽斯）字样和设计师标记。右上角是发行国“LIETUVA”（立陶宛）和发行年份“2017”。中心是造币厂标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Estonia's Independence
description_en: The coin features the sinuous trunk of an oak tree where on one side there are depicted the branches and on the other side the leaves. The branches symbolize the time of revolutions and hardships from which the road to Estonia's Independence was paved. The leaves symbolize the strength, achievements and longevity of Estonia. At the bottom left side of the trunk there is the word ‘MAAPÄEV’ (Provisional Assembly of Estonia) and above that the year ‘1917’. At the bottom right side there is the name of the issuing country ‘EESTI’ and below that the year of issuance ‘2017’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币正面图案为一棵蜿蜒的橡树树干，一面是树枝，另一面是树叶。树枝象征着爱沙尼亚走向独立之路所经历的革命与艰辛，树叶则象征着爱沙尼亚的强大、成就和长寿。树干左下方刻有“MAAPÄEV”（爱沙尼亚临时议会）字样，上方是年份“1917”。右下方是发行国“EESTI”（爱沙尼亚），下方是发行年份“2017”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 60 years in memoriam of Nikos Kazantzakis
description_en: The design features a profile portrait of Nikos Kazantzakis, one of Greece’s greatest 20th century writers. Inscribed along the inner circle, at the left, is the wording ‘HELLENIC REPUBLIC’ and the name ‘NIKOS KAZANTZAKIS’ (in Greek). At the top is the year of issuance ‘2017’ and at centre left a palmette (the mint mark of the Greek Mint). Also visible at lower right is the monogram of the artist (George Stamatopoulos). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币的设计以希腊20世纪最伟大的作家之一尼科斯·卡赞扎基斯的侧面肖像为特色。内圈左侧刻有“希腊共和国”（HELLENIC REPUBLIC）字样和“尼科斯·卡赞扎基斯”（NIKOS KAZANTZAKIS）的名字（希腊语）。顶部是发行年份“2017”，左侧中央是棕榈叶图案（希腊造币厂的标志）。右下角还可以看到艺术家（乔治·斯塔马托普洛斯）的姓名缩写。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Archaeological site of Philippi
description_en: The design features part of Basilica B and linear motifs inspired by a border pattern from an ancient Greek mosaic discovered at the site. Inscribed along the inner circle is the wording ‘ARCHAEOLOGICAL SITE OF PHILIPPI’ and ‘HELLENIC REPUBLIC’ (in Greek). Also inscribed in the background is the year of issuance ‘2017’ and to the right a palmette (the mint mark of the Greek Mint). Visible at the lower left is the monogram of the artist (George Stamatopoulos). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以B座圣殿的部分图案为特色，并融入了源自该遗址发现的一幅古希腊马赛克镶边图案的线性纹样。内圈刻有“菲利皮考古遗址”和“希腊共和国”（希腊语）字样。背景中还刻有发行年份“2017”，右侧是一枚棕榈叶纹饰（希腊造币厂的标志）。左下角可见艺术家（乔治·斯塔马托普洛斯）的姓名首字母缩写。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 150 Years of Public Security
description_en: The design shows human figures and buildings, symbolic representations of citizens and cities, where the public security is mainly assured and the simplified police symbol. The legends include the year ‘1867’ and the year of issue ‘2017’, the country of issue ‘PORTUGAL’, the subject of commemoration (‘SEGURANÇA PÚBLICA’ – Public Security), the three main issues related to citizenship (‘DIREITOS’, ‘LIBERDADES’ e ‘GARANTIAS’ – Rights, Freedoms and Warranties), and the author’s name JOSÉ DE GUIMARÃES. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了人物和建筑，象征着公民和城市，主要体现了公共安全保障，并包含简化的警察标志。铭文包括年份“1867”和发行年份“2017”，发行国“葡萄牙”，纪念主题“SEGURANÇA PÚBLICA”（公共安全），与公民身份相关的三大要素（“DIREITOS”、“LIBERDADES”和“GARANTIAS”），以及设计者何塞·德·吉马良斯（JOSÉ DE GUIMARÃES）的名字。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 1950th anniversary of the martyrdom of Saint Peter and Saint Paul
description_en: The design features Saint Peter and Saint Paul and their symbols, respectively the keys and the sword. At the top is the inscription ‘CITTÀ DEL VATICANO’, in semi-circle. At the bottom, in semi-circle is the inscription ‘1950o DEL MARTIRIO DEI SANTI PIETRO E PAOLO’. At the bottom left is the year of issuance ‘2017’ and at the bottom right is the mint mark ‘R’. Between them is the name of the artist ‘G. TITOTTO’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以圣彼得和圣保罗及其象征物——钥匙和宝剑为特色。顶部半圆形铭文为“CITTÀ DEL VATICANO”（梵蒂冈城）。底部半圆形铭文为“1950o DEL MARTIRIO DEI SANTI PIETRO E PAOLO”（圣彼得和圣保罗殉难1950年）。左下角为发行年份“2017”，右下角为造币厂标记“R”。两者之间是艺术家“G. TITOTTO”的名字。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Unesco World Heritage Site: Maltese prehistoric temples of Hagar Qim
description_en: The coin depicts the prehistoric temples of Hagar Qim. At the top right the inscriptions ‘HAGAR QIM’, ‘TEMPLES’ and the years ‘3600-3200 BC’ one under the other. At the bottom left the name of the country of issuance ‘MALTA’ and underneath the year of issuance ‘2017’. At the bottom right the initials ‘NGB’ of the artist Noel Galea Bason. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币描绘了哈加尔基姆史前神庙的景象。右上角依次刻有“哈加尔基姆”、“神庙”以及公元前3600-3200年的年份。左下角是发行国“马耳他”的名称，下方是发行年份“2017”。右下角是艺术家诺埃尔·加利亚·巴松的姓名缩写“NGB”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Independent Finland 100 years
description_en: The inner part of the coin has a mosaic design, with the more sparsely set pieces on the right forming a cartographic likeness of Finland. The text ‘SUOMI FINLAND’, the year of independence ‘1917’ and the year of issuance ‘2017’ are placed vertically one below another at the left. In the middle right is the indication of the issuing country ‘FI’ and the mint mark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈采用马赛克图案，右侧较为稀疏的马赛克拼成芬兰的地图。左侧依次竖排刻有“SUOMI FINLAND”（芬兰）字样、独立年份“1917”和发行年份“2017”。右侧中间刻有发行国“FI”和造币厂标记。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Bimillenary of the death of Titus Livius
description_en: Bust of the Roman historian Titus Livius, taken from a work by Lorenzo Larese Moretti; on the left the logo of the Italian Republic ‘RI’, and ‘C.M.’ initials of the author Claudia Momoni; on the right ‘17’ and ‘2017’, respectively year of the death of Livius and year of the issue of the coin, and the mintmark of the Mint of Rome ‘R’; around circle of dots and the inscription ‘TITO • LIVIO’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 正面为罗马历史学家提图斯·李维的半身像，取材自洛伦佐·拉雷塞·莫雷蒂的作品；左侧为意大利共和国的标志“RI”和作者克劳迪娅·莫莫尼的姓名首字母“C.M.”；右侧分别为李维的逝世年份“17”和硬币发行年份“2017”，以及罗马造币厂的标记“R”；周围环绕着一圈圆点和铭文“TITO • LIVIO”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 200th anniversary of the University of Liège
description_en: The inner part of the piece represents the logo of the University of Liege, with the dates 1817 — 2017 below, surrounded by the inscription 200 ANS UNIVERSITE DE LIEGE — 200 YEARS UNIVERSITY OF LIEGE and the country indication BE. The mintmark of Brussels, a helmeted head of the Archangel Michael and the mint directors’ mintmark, the coat of arms of the municipality Herzele, are located respectively on the right and left of the country indication. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈为列日大学的校徽，下方标有1817—2017的年份，周围环绕着“200 ANS UNIVERSITE DE LIEGE — 列日大学200周年”字样以及国家标识“BE”。布鲁塞尔造币厂的标记——戴头盔的大天使米迦勒头像，以及造币厂厂长标记——赫泽勒市的市徽，分别位于国家标识的左右两侧。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 750th anniversary of the birth of Giotto
description_en: On the left a detail from the clock tower of Santa Maria del Fiore in Florence, one of Giotto’s architectural works; vertically, the words SAN MARINO, GIOTTO and the dates 1267-2017; on the right a detail from the portrait of Giotto and the abbreviation of the artist Luciana De Simoni (LDS); on the bottom, the letter R, indicating the ‘Zecca’ (mint) of Rome. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 左侧是佛罗伦萨圣母百花大教堂钟楼的局部图案，这是乔托的建筑作品之一；垂直方向刻有“SAN MARINO”、“GIOTTO”字样以及1267-2017年的日期；右侧是乔托肖像的局部图案以及艺术家卢西亚娜·德·西蒙尼（摩门教徒）的姓名缩写；底部字母“R”代表罗马的“Zecca”（造币厂）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Unesco’s World Cultural and Natural Heritage Sites – Churches of the Kingdom of Asturias
description_en: The design depicts in the foreground Santa Maria del Naranco Church. At the top of the inner circle and in circular sense is the name of the issuing country ‘ESPAÑA’ and underneath, to the right, the year of issuance ‘2017’. At the left side of the inner circle is the mint mark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币正面图案为圣玛利亚德尔纳兰科教堂。内圈顶部环绕着发行国“西班牙”（ESPAÑA）的名称，其右下方为发行年份“2017”。内圈左侧是造币厂标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Rhineland-Palatinate (‘Federal States’ (Bundesländer) series)
description_en: The design shows the Porta Nigra in Trier which is probably the best-preserved Roman city gate north of the Alps. The inner part also features the name ‘RHEINLAND-PFALZ’ and the issuing country’s code ‘D’ at the bottom. The mint mark of the respective mint (‘A’, ‘D’, ‘F’, ‘G’ or ‘J’) appears at the left and the year ‘2017’ appears at the top. At the right, the initials of the designer ‘CH’ (Chocola Frantisek). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了特里尔的黑门（Porta Nigra），它可能是阿尔卑斯山以北保存最完好的罗马城门。内侧刻有“莱茵兰-普法尔茨”（RHEINLAND-PFALZ）字样，底部为发行国代码“D”。左侧为各造币厂的标记（“A”、“D”、“F”、“G”或“J”），顶部为年份“2017”。右侧为设计师姓名首字母“CH”（Chocola Frantisek）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 550th anniversary of the University Istropolitana
description_en: The design shows the figure of a teacher and two students positioned before the facade of the building of the former Universitas Istropolitana in Bratislava. In the upper left of the design is a medallion of King Matthias Corvinus, the founder of the university. Above the medallion is the inscription ‘1467’, the year in which the university was opened. The country of issuance ‘SLOVENSKO’ appears at the base of the inner circle, above the year of issuance ‘2017’. Along the left edge of the inner circle is the inscription ‘UNIVERZITA’, and along the right edge ‘ISTROPOLITANA’. In the lower left of the design is the mint mark of the Kremnica Mint (Mincovňa Kremnica), consisting of the initials ‘MK’ placed between two dies. Below the mint mark are the stylised letters ‘MP’, the initials of the designer, Mária Poldaufová. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了一位教师和两位学生站在布拉迪斯拉发伊斯特罗波利塔纳大学（Universitas Istropolitana）旧址建筑立面前的场景。设计左上方是大学创始人马蒂亚斯·科尔维努斯国王的徽章。徽章上方刻有“1467”，即大学成立年份。发行国“斯洛伐克”（SLOVENSKO）位于内圈底部，发行年份“2017”上方。内圈左侧边缘刻有“UNIVERZITA”（大学），右侧边缘刻有“ISTROPOLITANA”（伊斯特罗波利塔纳）。设计左下方是克雷姆尼察造币厂（Mincovňa Kremnica）的造币厂标记，由两个模具之间的字母“MK”组成。造币厂标记下方是风格化的字母“MP”，即设计师玛丽亚·波尔道福娃（Mária Poldaufová）的姓名首字母。硬币外圈印有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 10th anniversary of the euro in Slovenia
description_en: The design shows 10 flying swallows which form a circle. At the lower half, in semi-circle, the inscription ‘10 LET SKUPNE EVROPSKE VALUTE’. At the top left the inscription ‘SLOVENIJA 2017’. Between the isncriptions is engraved a dot. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 图案为10只飞翔的燕子组成一个圆圈。下半部分呈半圆形，刻有“10 LET SKUPNE EVROPSKE VALUTE”（10 LET SKUPNE EVROPSKE VALUTE，10欧洲货币）字样。左上角刻有“SLOVENIJA 2017”（斯洛文尼亚 2017）。两行文字之间刻有一个圆点。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Centenary of Auguste Rodin
description_en: For the 100th anniversary of his passing away, Monnaie de Paris pays tribute to the illustrious French sculptor Auguste Rodin. Born in 1840, he is one of the major icons of the realistic style. His works such as The Thinker, The Kiss, The Hell’s Door or The Calais’ Bourgeois remain timeless masterpieces of the world sculpture. The design represents Auguste Rodin and The Thinker, his best known work, like forehead to forehead. The RF mention standing for République Française is drawn as sculpted on the top of the coin. The name of the artist ‘A. Rodin’ and the relevant dates ‘1917-2017’ are inscribed in his beard. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 为纪念法国著名雕塑家奥古斯特·罗丹逝世一百周年，巴黎造币厂发行纪念币，向这位杰出的法国雕塑家致敬。罗丹生于1840年，是现实主义雕塑的代表人物之一。他的作品，如《思想者》、《吻》、《地狱之门》和《加莱的资产阶级》，至今仍是世界雕塑史上的不朽杰作。这枚纪念币的设计展现了罗丹与他最著名的作品《思想者》的正面交锋。硬币顶部刻有“RF”（法兰西共和国）字样，与雕塑上的图案一致。艺术家“A. Rodin”的名字和相关年份“1917-2017”则镌刻在他的胡须上。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的十二颗星。

title: The 50th anniversary of the voluntariness of the Luxembourg army
description_en: The design shows on the right hand the effigy of His Royal Highness, the Grand-Duke Henri, looking to the right and on the left hand the text ‘50 Joer Fräiwëllegen-Arméi’ composed as logo. At the top of the design is depicted the year-date ‘2017’, flanked by the mintmark and the initials of the Mintmaster. At the bottom appears the name of the issuing country ‘LËTZEBUERG’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该硬币设计右侧为亨利大公殿下的肖像，他面向右侧；左侧为“50 Joer Fräiwëllegen-Arméi”（50 瑞士联邦军）字样，构成标志。硬币顶部为年份“2017”，两侧分别是造币厂标记和造币厂厂长的姓名首字母。底部为发行国“莱茨堡”（LËTZEBUERG）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 400th Anniversary of the completion of the Basilica of San Marco in Venice
description_en: Façade of the Basilica of San Marco in Venice; in the exergue the dates ‘1617’ and ‘2017’, respectively year of the completion of the Basilica and year of the issue of the coin, beside the logo of the Italian Republic ‘RI’; below the inscription ‘SAN MARCO’; on the right ‘LDS’, initials of the author Luciana De Simoni; on the top the inscription ‘VENEZIA’, and the mintmark of the Mint of Rome ‘R’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 威尼斯圣马可大教堂正面；底部刻有“1617”和“2017”字样，分别代表大教堂竣工年份和硬币发行年份，旁边是意大利共和国的标志“RI”；下方刻有“SAN MARCO”字样；右侧是“LDS”，即作者卢西亚娜·德·西蒙尼的姓名首字母；顶部刻有“VENEZIA”字样，以及罗马造币厂的标记“R”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 70 years of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights
description_en: The design of the coin depicts seven staircases (representing the seven parishes or administrative divisions of Andorra) in the shape of mountains that lead to the valley, where there is the name of the issuing country ‘ANDORRA’ and the year of issue ‘2018’. These staircases are, at the same time, the branches of a tree symbolizing humankind, of which Andorra is an integral part. 30 leaves come out of the branches of this tree representing the 30 articles of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. The Catalan inscription ‘70 ANYS DE LA DECLARACIÓ UNIVERSAL DELS DRETS HUMANS’ (70 years of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights) surrounds the design, strengthening this commemorative event. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币的设计描绘了七道形似山脉的阶梯（代表安道尔的七个教区或行政区划），通往山谷。山谷中镌刻着发行国“安道尔”的名称和发行年份“2018”。这些阶梯同时也是一棵树的枝干，象征着人类，而安道尔正是人类不可分割的一部分。树枝上伸出30片叶子，代表《世界人权宣言》的30条条款。加泰罗尼亚语铭文“70 ANYS DE LA DECLARACIÓ UNIVERSAL DELS DRETS HUMANS”（《世界人权宣言》发表70周年）环绕着整个设计，强化了这一纪念活动的意义。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Cultural Heritage
description_en: The design was created by a school student and depicts a variety of themes intrinsic to Maltese heritage including: an allusion to the prehistoric temples, which are the world’s oldest free-standing structures, a church dome and spire, which is a characteristic feature of the Maltese town and village skyline and a representation of a traditional Maltese boat carrying a Maltese flag. The name of the issuing country ‘Malta’ is at the top of the inner circle of the coin and the year ‘2018’ at the bottom. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币的设计出自一位学生之手，展现了马耳他文化遗产的诸多精髓，包括对史前神庙的隐喻（这些神庙是世界上最古老的独立式建筑）、教堂的圆顶和尖顶（这是马耳他城镇和乡村天际线的标志性特征），以及一艘悬挂着马耳他国旗的传统马耳他船。发行国“马耳他”的名称位于硬币内圈的顶部，年份“2018”位于底部。硬币的外圈则印有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Finnish sauna culture
description_en: The design shows a Finnish landscape with a typical Finnish lakeside sauna placed in the centre. The year of issuance ‘2018’ is placed at the centre bottom. The indication of the issuing country ‘FI’ is at the centre left and the mint mark at the centre right. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该硬币的设计展现了芬兰的风景，中心位置是一座典型的芬兰湖畔桑拿房。发行年份“2018”位于底部中心。发行国“FI”位于左侧中心，造币厂标记位于右侧中心。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 50th anniversary of the ESRO 2B satellite
description_en: The design shows the ESRO 2B satellite, the first successful satellite of the European Space Research Organization and launched in May 1968, circling around planet Earth. The ESRO 2B, also renamed as ‘IRIS’ (International Radiation Investigation Satellite) once in orbit, was concentrated on solar X-rays, cosmic radiation and Earth’s radiation belts. The mintmark of Utrecht (the Mercury’s wand) is located on the bottom together with the Belgian mint master mark, the coat of arms of the municipality Herzele, the country code BE and the initials LL referring to the designer of the coin, Mr Luc Luycx. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了欧洲空间研究组织 (ESRO) 的首颗成功卫星 ESRO 2B 绕地球运行的景象。ESRO 2B 于 1968 年 5 月发射升空，在入轨后更名为“IRIS”（国际辐射探测卫星），其主要任务是探测太阳 X 射线、宇宙辐射和地球辐射带。乌得勒支造币厂的标记（水星杖）位于硬币底部，旁边还有比利时造币厂的厂标、赫泽勒市的市徽、国家代码 BE 以及代表硬币设计师 Luc Luycx 先生的姓名首字母 LL。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的 12 颗星。

title: 50th Anniversary of the death of Padre Pio
description_en: The design features the right profile of a portrait of Padre Pio. At the top, from left to right, in semi-circle is the inscription of the issuing country ‘CITTÀ DEL VATICANO’. At the bottom is the inscription ‘Padre Pio’ and at its right the mint mark ‘R’. At the left hand of the design is the year ‘1968’ and at the right is the year of issuance ‘2018’. At the bottom left is the name of the artist ‘P.DANIELE’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以圣比约神父的右侧肖像为特色。顶部，从左至右呈半圆形排列着发行国“梵蒂冈城”（CITTÀ DEL VATICANO）的字样。底部是“圣比约神父”（Padre Pio）的字样，其右侧是造币厂标记“R”。设计左侧为年份“1968”，右侧为发行年份“2018”。左下角是艺术家姓名“P.DANIELE”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Kostis Palamas – 75 years in memoriam
description_en: The design features a portrait of the Greek poet Kostis Palamas (1859-1943). Inscribed along the inner edge at left is the wording ‘HELLENIC REPUBLIC’ and the name ‘KOSTIS PALAMAS’ (in Greek). Also inscribed is a palmette (the mintmark of the Greek Mint) and the year of issuance ‘2018’. Visible at the lower right is the monogram of the artist (George Stamatopoulos). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该硬币正面图案为希腊诗人科斯蒂斯·帕拉马斯（1859-1943）的肖像。左侧内缘刻有“希腊共和国”（HELLENIC REPUBLIC）字样和“科斯蒂斯·帕拉马斯”（KOSTIS PALAMAS）的希腊文名字。此外，还刻有希腊造币厂的棕榈叶纹章和发行年份“2018”。右下角可见艺术家（乔治·斯塔马托普洛斯）的姓名缩写。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 70 years since the union of the Dodecanese
description_en: The design features in the central part a rose, the canting badge of Rhodes, inspired from a coin minted by the ancient city of Rhodes, one of the most characteristic coins of the Dodecanese, with stylised waves fanning out from the centre. Inscribed along the inner edge is the wording ‘1948-2018 THE UNION OF THE DODECANESE WITH GREECE’ and ‘HELLENIC REPUBLIC’ (in Greek). Also visible at left is a palmette (the mintmark of the Greek mint) and, at right, the monogram of the artist (George Stamatopoulos). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以一朵玫瑰为中心，玫瑰是罗德岛的象征性徽章，其灵感源自古罗德岛铸造的一枚硬币，这枚硬币是十二群岛最具代表性的硬币之一，其图案为从中心向外扩散的波浪纹。内缘刻有“1948-2018 十二群岛与希腊的联盟”和“希腊共和国”（希腊语）。左侧可见棕榈叶纹（希腊造币厂的标记），右侧是艺术家（乔治·斯塔马托普洛斯）的姓名首字母缩写。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Zemgale
description_en: The design shows the coat of arms of the region of Zemgale. At the top, the name of the issuing country ‘LATVIJA’ and at the bottom the inscription ‘ZEMGALE’. At the right hand side, the year of issuance ‘2018’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该硬币的设计图案为泽姆加莱地区的徽章。顶部是发行国“拉脱维亚”（LATVIJA），底部是“泽姆加莱”（ZEMGALE）字样。右侧是发行年份“2018”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 175th anniversary of the death of the Grand Duke Guillaume Ist
description_en: The design shows on the right hand the effigy of His Royal Highness, the Grand Duke Henri, looking to the left and on the left hand the effigy of HRH the Grand Duke Guillaume Ist. Between both effigies are depicted vertically the year-dates ‘1772-1843’ as well as the name ‘Guillaume Ier’. At the bottom appears the text ‘LUXEMBOURG’ and the year-date ‘2018’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计右侧为亨利大公殿下的肖像，他面向左侧；左侧为纪尧姆一世大公殿下的肖像。两尊肖像之间垂直排列着年份“1772-1843”以及“纪尧姆一世”的字样。底部印有“卢森堡”字样和年份“2018”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 420th anniversary of the birth of Gian Lorenzo Bernini
description_en: the centre of the coin features a detail from Bernini’s sculpture ‘Bust of Costanza Bonarelli’, and the dates ‘1598-2018’; at the edge, on the left is the inscription ‘SAN MARINO’, on the right the inscription ‘BERNINI’, the letter ‘R’ identifying the Mint of Rome and the initials of the artist Annalisa Masini ‘A.M.’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币中心图案为贝尼尼雕塑作品《科斯坦扎·博纳雷利半身像》的局部细节，以及“1598-2018”字样；边缘左侧刻有“SAN MARINO”字样，右侧刻有“BERNINI”字样、代表罗马造币厂的字母“R”以及艺术家安娜丽莎·马西尼的姓名首字母“A.M.”；硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Unesco World Heritage Site — Temples of Mnajdra
description_en: The design features the Maltese prehistoric temples of Mnajdra, a Unesco World Heritage Site. Mnajdra is a prehistoric site consisting of three temples nestled around an oval forecourt. It is situated on the Southern coast of Malta, some 500 meters away from Hagar Qim. Mnajdra is best known for its astronomical alignments and the South temple seems to have been constructed to mark the sunrise on the equinox and the solstice. The Oldest parts of this complex date around 3 600-3 200 BC. At the top right of the design there are the inscriptions ‘MNAJDRA’, ‘TEMPLES’ and the years ‘3 600-2 500 BC’, one underneath the other. At the bottom left there is the name of the issuing country ‘MALTA’ and underneath there is the year of issuance ‘2018’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以马耳他史前神庙群姆纳伊德拉（Mnajdra）为主题，姆纳伊德拉是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。姆纳伊德拉是一处史前遗址，由三座神庙围绕着一个椭圆形前院而建，位于马耳他南部海岸，距离哈加尔基姆（Hagar Qim）约500米。姆纳伊德拉以其天文方位而闻名，南侧神庙似乎是为了纪念春分和秋分以及夏至的日出而建造的。该建筑群最古老的部分可追溯至公元前3600年至3200年左右。设计右上角刻有“MNAJDRA”、“TEMPLES”（姆纳伊德拉）、“3600-2500 BC”（公元前3600年至2500年）字样，上下排列。左下角是发行国“MALTA”（马耳他）的名称，下方是发行年份“2018”。硬币外圈印有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 250 years of the Ajuda Botanical Garden (‘Jardim Botânico da Ajuda’)
description_en: The design shows a very old Dracaena tree that is in the Ajuda Botanical Garden premises and is a symbol of the garden. The Ajuda Botanical Garden is a Technological Support Unit of the Agronomy University. It plays the role of an infrastructure for education and research but is also open to the public. It was the first botanical garden in Portugal projected to preserve, study and collect the most numerous possible species from the plant world. At the top of the design, from left to right, in semi-circle, there is the inscription ‘250 ANOS JARDIM BOTÂNICO DA AJUDA’. At the bottom, from left to right, in semi-circle, there is the inscription ‘PORTUGAL 2018’. Right underneath the image of the tree, at the left side, there are the initials of the artist ‘J. FAZENDA’ and at the right side the mintmark ‘INCM’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了一棵位于阿茹达植物园内的古老龙血树，它是该植物园的象征。阿茹达植物园是葡萄牙农学院的技术支持单位，既是教育和科研的基础设施，也对公众开放。它是葡萄牙首个旨在保护、研究和收集植物界尽可能多的物种的植物园。设计顶部，从左至右呈半圆形排列着“阿茹达植物园250周年”（250 ANOS JARDIM BOTÂNICO DA AJUDA）。底部，从左至右呈半圆形排列着“葡萄牙 2018”（PORTUGAL 2018）。树的图案下方，左侧是艺术家“J. FAZENDA”的姓名首字母，右侧是造币厂标记“INCM”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: François Joseph Bosio
description_en: The design shows Mr BOSIO and a statue as the background image. The inscription ‘MONACO’ is at the top of the image in semi-circle. At the bottom, in semi-circle as well, there are two inscriptions: ‘FRANÇOIS-JOSEPH BOSIO’ and underneath ‘1768 – SCULPTEUR – 2018’. At the left and right sides of these two inscriptions, there are the mintmark and the mint master mark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 设计以博西奥先生的肖像和一座雕像为背景。图像上方以半圆形排列着“摩纳哥”字样。下方同样以半圆形排列着两个铭文：“弗朗索瓦-约瑟夫·博西奥”和“1768 – 雕塑家 – 2018”。这两个铭文的左右两侧分别是造币厂标记和造币厂厂长标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 250 years of the Official Printing Works (‘Imprensa Nacional’)
description_en: The design displays the inscription ‘1768-2018 IMPRENSA NACIONAL DUZENTOS E CINQUENTA 250 ANOS PORTUGAL MMXVIII’ as if the letters and numbers were books displayed in a library. At the bottom of the inner ring there is the name of the artist ‘Eduardo Aires’ at the left side and the mintmark ‘INCM’ at the right side. The Official Printing Works are responsible with the publication of the Portuguese Official Journal containing all the legislative activity of the country, books of the highest cultural relevance, and other cultural activities. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以书籍的形式呈现“1768-2018 IMPRENSA NACIONAL DUZENTOS E CINQUENTA 250 ANOS PORTUGAL MMXVIII”字样。内环底部左侧是艺术家“Eduardo Aires”的名字，右侧是造币厂标记“INCM”。葡萄牙国家印刷厂负责出版葡萄牙官方公报，该公报涵盖国家所有立法活动、具有最高文化价值的书籍以及其他文化活动。硬币外环饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 50th anniversary of May 1968 events in Belgium
description_en: The design represents students with a pamphlet and flag in their hands and refers to student demonstrations that took place in Belgium in connection with the sociocultural changes of May 1968. It was an important national event that shaped Belgium’s national politics and influenced subsequent Government reforms, now 50 years ago. The mintmark of Utrecht (the Mercury’s wand) is located on the left together with the Belgian mint master mark (the coat of arms of the municipality Herzele). The year mark 2018 and the country code BE are located at the left as well, just like the initials LL of the designer of the coin, Mr Luc Luycx. An auditorium marks the back, which is a reference to students. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了手持传单和旗帜的学生，象征着1968年5月比利时学生因社会文化变革而发起的示威游行。这场重要的全国性事件塑造了比利时的国家政治，并影响了随后的政府改革，距今已过去50年。乌得勒支造币厂的标记（墨丘利魔杖）位于左侧，旁边是比利时造币厂的厂标（赫泽勒市的市徽）。年份2018和国家代码BE也位于左侧，与硬币设计师卢克·吕克斯先生的姓名首字母LL并列。硬币背面是一座礼堂，象征着学生。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Simone Veil
description_en: The design displays a portrait of Simone Veil, an icon in the combat for women’s rights. Simone Veil, born Jacob, left us in June 2017 at the age of 89. After surviving deportation to Auschwitz, she went on to become one of the most important actors in Europe’s building. She was the first elected president of the European Parliament from 1979 to 1982. She symbolizes the depenalization of abortion she fought for with the law bearing her name voted in 1975. In 2008, she is elected at the French Academy. Her deportation registration number appears on her collar. The background depicts the European Parliament on which her name, key dates, indication of the country ‘RF’, year of issuance ‘2018’ and the mintmarks are inscribed. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币的设计展现了西蒙娜·韦伊（Simone Veil）的肖像，她是女性权利斗争中的一位标志性人物。西蒙娜·韦伊，原名雅各布（Jacob），于2017年6月逝世，享年89岁。她曾被驱逐到奥斯维辛集中营，幸存下来后，成为欧洲建设中最重要的人物之一。她于1979年至1982年担任欧洲议会首任民选议长。她象征着她为之奋斗的堕胎合法化，1975年以她名字命名的法案获得通过。2008年，她当选为法兰西学院院士。她的衣领上印有她的驱逐登记号码。硬币背景描绘了欧洲议会大厦，上面刻有她的名字、重要日期、国家“RF”标识、发行年份“2018”以及造币厂标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: European Year of Cultural Heritage — The Laocoön group
description_en: The design features the Statue of Laocoön and His Sons, also called the Laocoön Group, a fundamental work of the world sculpture, foundational for the Vatican Museums. At the center bottom, the inscription of the issuing country ‘Città del VATICANO’. From left to right, in semi-circle, the inscription ‘ANNO EUROPEO DEL PATRIMONIO CULTURALE’. At the top right the year of issuance ‘2018’ and the mintmark ‘R’. At the bottom right the name of the artist ‘D. LONGO’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以拉奥孔及其子雕像（又称拉奥孔群像）为主题，这件世界雕塑杰作也是梵蒂冈博物馆的馆藏基石。底部中央刻有发行国“梵蒂冈城”（Città del VATICANO）。从左至右呈半圆形排列着“欧洲文化遗产年”（ANNO EUROPEO DEL PATRIMONIO CULTURALE）。右上角为发行年份“2018”和造币厂标记“R”。右下角为艺术家“D. LONGO”的名字。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: 500th anniversary of the birth of Tintoretto
description_en: The centre of the coin depicts a detail from Tintoretto’s painting ‘The Visitation’ (the embrace between the Virgin Mary and Elizabeth), and the dates ‘1518-2018’; at the edge: ‘SAN MARINO’ written above, and ‘Tintoretto’ below; on the left are the initials of the artist Luciana de Simoni ‘LDS’ and the letter ‘R’ identifying the Mint of Rome. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币中心图案取自丁托列托的画作《圣母访亲》（圣母玛利亚与伊丽莎白的拥抱），并镌刻有“1518-2018”字样；边缘上方刻有“SAN MARINO”（圣马力诺），下方刻有“Tintoretto”（丁托列托）；左侧是艺术家卢西亚娜·德·西蒙尼的姓名首字母“LDS”以及代表罗马造币厂的字母“R”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Finnish national landscape Koli
description_en: The design shows a drawing from the top of the Finnish national landscape Koli. The year of issuance ‘2018’ is placed at the center bottom. The indication of the issuing country ‘FI’ is at the center left and the mint mark at the center right. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该硬币的设计图案为芬兰国家景观科利山的俯视图。发行年份“2018”位于底部中央。发行国“FI”位于左侧中央，造币厂标记位于右侧中央。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Lithuanian Song and Dance celebration (inscribed on the Unesco Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity)
description_en: The design features stylised figures of people and birds, typical of one of the Lithuanian folk art genres — paper cuttings, symbolic of folk dance and song. The inscription of the issuing country ‘LIETUVA’ is at the center bottom, the year of issuance ‘2018’ is at the left hand side and the mark of the Lithuanian Mint is at the right hand side. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该硬币的设计以风格化的人物和鸟类图案为特色，这是立陶宛民间艺术流派之一——剪纸艺术的典型特征，象征着民间歌舞。发行国“立陶宛”（LIETUVA）的字样位于底部中央，发行年份“2018”位于左侧，立陶宛造币厂的标志位于右侧。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Slovenia World Day of Bees
description_en: In the middle of the inner ring of the coin is the image of honeycomb in a form of a globe, which shows the eastern hemisphere. Around the honeycomb on the left upper side is the inscription ‘SVETOVNI DAN ČEBEL’, and on the lower right side the inscription ‘SLOVENIJA 2018’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内环中央是蜂巢状的地球图案，代表东半球。蜂巢图案左上方环绕着“SVETOVNI DAN ČEBEL”字样，右下方环绕着“SLOVENIJA 2018”字样。硬币外环饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 60th Anniversary of the establishment of the Italian Ministry of Health
description_en: The design shows an allegorical representation of Health with some symbols of the activities of the Ministry: Environment, Research, Nutrition and Medicine. On the left the logo ‘RI’, acronym of the Italian Republic; above the mintmark of the Mint of Rome ‘R’; at the base of the female figure the initials of the author Silvia Petrassi. From left to right, in semi-circle, the inscription ‘MINISTERO DELLA SALUTE’ and the dates ‘1958-2018’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计以寓言形式展现了健康，并融入了环境、研究、营养和医学部的部分活动符号。左侧是意大利共和国的缩写“RI”标志；上方是罗马造币厂的标记“R”；女性人物底部是设计师西尔维娅·佩特拉西（Silvia Petrassi）的姓名首字母。从左至右，呈半圆形排列的是“MINISTERO DELLA SALUTE”（意大利卫生部）字样和“1958-2018”的年份。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 50th anniversary of King FELIPE VI
description_en: The design reproduces King Felipe VI’s coat of arms. On the left hand side, in semi-circle, is the word ‘ESPAÑA’ and below the year of issuance 2018. At the bottom right, in semi-circle, is the inscription ‘50 ANIVERSARIO DE S.M. FELIPE VI’. The mint mark is represented at the top right. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计再现了费利佩六世国王的国徽。左侧半圆形区域内刻有“ESPAÑA”（西班牙）字样，下方为发行年份2018。右下角半圆形区域内刻有“50 ANIVERSARIO DE S.M. FELIPE VI”（费利佩六世国王登基50周年）。造币厂标记位于右上角。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: UNESCO's World Cultural and Natural Heritage Sites - Santiago
description_en: The City of Santiago de Compostela was declared World Cultural Heritage by UNESCO in 1985, considering its urban beauty and monumental integrity added to the deep echoes of its spiritual and cultural significance of the Middle Ages: the Camino de Santiago Pilgrimage. The Camino de Santiago (The Way of St. James) is a large network of ancient pilgrim routes stretching across Europe and coming together at the tomb of St. James in Santiago de Compostela in north-west Spain. The design reproduces the sculpture of Santiago as a central figure in the canvas of the Puerta Santa of Santiago de Compostela Cathedral. On the left hand side, in semi-circle, is the word “ESPAÑA”, at the bottom left the year of issuance “2018” and underneath the mint mark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh:
1985年，圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉市被联合国教科文组织列为世界文化遗产，其城市之美和历史遗迹的完整性，以及中世纪圣地亚哥朝圣之路所蕴含的深厚精神和文化意义，都使其名垂青史。

圣地亚哥朝圣之路（圣雅各之路）是一条庞大的古老朝圣路线网络，横跨欧洲，最终汇聚于西班牙西北部圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉的圣雅各墓。

该硬币的设计以圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉大教堂圣门（Puerta Santa）的壁画为中心，再现了圣地亚哥的雕像。左侧半圆形区域内印有“ESPAÑA”（西班牙）字样，左下角为发行年份“2018”，下方为造币厂标记。

硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 25th anniversary of the Andorran Constitution
description_en: The design depicts the ‘Monument to the Men and Women of Andorra who launched the Constitution’, which stands in the square of the Consell General (Andorra’s Parliament). This monument shows the silhouettes of a man and a woman and commemorates the will expressed by the Andorran citizenry, in the referendum held on 14 March 1993, to become a constitutional state, democratic and social, as expressed in article 1 of the Constitution. To the right of the monument there is the map of Andorra with the Latin inscription ‘VIRTVS VNITA FORTIOR’ (virtue united is stronger) inside, which is the state motto of the Principality of Andorra. Surrounding the design there are the inscriptions ‘25è ANIVERSARI DE LA CONSTITUCIÓ 1993-2018’ (25th anniversary of the Constitution 1993-2018) and the name of the country ‘ANDORRA’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了“安道尔宪法缔造者纪念碑”，它矗立在安道尔议会广场。这座纪念碑展现了一男一女的剪影，纪念安道尔公民在1993年3月14日举行的全民公投中表达的意愿，即建立一个宪政、民主和社会的国度，正如宪法第一条所阐述的那样。纪念碑右侧是安道尔地图，地图内刻有拉丁文“VIRTVS VNITA FORTIOR”（美德团结更强大），这是安道尔公国的国训。设计周围环绕着“25è ANIVERSARI DE LA CONSTITUCIÓ 1993-2018”（宪法颁布25周年 1993-2018）的字样以及国名“ANDORRA”（安道尔）。硬币外圈印有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania jointly issued a commemorative euro coin with a common design in 2018, celebrating the establishment of the States of Estonia and Latvia and the re-establishment of the State of Lithuania
description_en: The three Baltic States are symbolically represented as a braid. They are united by their history: a common past, present and future. A stylised numeral representing the 100th anniversary, and the heraldic signs of all three States, are featured as well. At the left side is the name of the issuing country ‘LIETUVA’ and the mint mark and at the right side is the year of issuance ‘2018’ and the mark of the designer ‘JP’. The design was selected by public voting in all three Baltic countries. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 波罗的海三国以辫子的形式象征性地呈现。它们因共同的历史而紧密相连——拥有共同的过去、现在和未来。硬币上还饰有代表百年纪念的程式化数字以及三国的纹章。左侧是发行国“立陶宛”（LIETUVA）的名称和造币厂标记，右侧是发行年份“2018”和设计师“JP”的标记。该设计由波罗的海三国公众投票选出。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania jointly issued a commemorative euro coin with a common design in 2018, celebrating the establishment of the States of Estonia and Latvia and the re-establishment of the State of Lithuania
description_en: The three Baltic States are symbolically represented as a braid. They are united by their history: a common past, present and future. A stylized numeral representing the 100th anniversary, and the heraldic signs of all three States, are featured as well. At the left side is the name of the issuing country ‘LATVIJA’ and at the right side is the year of issuance ‘2018’. The design was selected by public voting in all three Baltic countries. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 波罗的海三国以辫子的形式象征性地呈现。它们因共同的历史而紧密相连——拥有共同的过去、现在和未来。硬币上还饰有代表百年纪念的程式化数字以及三国的纹章。左侧是发行国“拉脱维亚”（LATVIJA）的名称，右侧是发行年份“2018”。该设计由波罗的海三国公众投票选出。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania jointly issued a commemorative euro coin with a common design in 2018, celebrating the establishment of the States of Estonia and Latvia and the re-establishment of the State of Lithuania.
description_en: The three Baltic States are symbolically represented as a braid. They are united by their history: a common past, present and future. A stylised numeral representing the 100th anniversary, and the heraldic signs of all three States, are featured as well. At the left side is the name of the issuing country ‘EESTI’ and at the right side is the year of issuance ‘2018’. The design was selected by public voting in all three Baltic countries. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 波罗的海三国以辫子的形式象征性地呈现。它们因共同的历史而紧密相连——拥有共同的过去、现在和未来。硬币上还饰有代表百年纪念的程式化数字以及三国的纹章。左侧是发行国“爱沙尼亚”（EESTI），右侧是发行年份“2018”。该设计由波罗的海三国公众投票选出。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The centennial of the independence of Estonia
description_en: The design depicts simultaneously the numbers 18 and 100, which symbolize the time when Estonia became an independent country and furthermore reflect the past hundred years. At the bottom right is the text ‘SADA AASTAT EESTI VABARIIKI’ and next to it the name of the country ‘EESTI’ and the year of issuance ‘2018’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计同时展现了数字18和100，象征着爱沙尼亚成为独立国家的时间，也代表着过去一百年的历史。右下角是“SADA AASTAT EESTI VABARIIKI”（爱沙尼亚独立国家），旁边是国名“EESTI”（爱沙尼亚）和发行年份“2018”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 100th birthday anniversary of the great German statesman and Chancellor Helmut Schmidt (1918-2015)
description_en: The design portrays Helmut Schmidt in a characteristic pose as he engages in dialogue with his interlocutor. In semi-circle at the top right the inscription ‘HELMUT SCHMIDT’ and at the right side the years ‘1918-2015’. The mint mark of the respective mint appears underneath the years. At the left side is the code of the issuing country ‘D’ and underneath is the year of issuance ‘2018’. At the bottom there are the initials of the artist. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了赫尔穆特·施密特与对话者交谈的标志性姿态。右上角半圆形区域内刻有“HELMUT SCHMIDT”字样，右侧为年份“1918-2015”。年份下方是相应造币厂的标记。左侧是发行国代码“D”，下方是发行年份“2018”。底部是艺术家姓名的首字母缩写。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Remembrance cornflower (Bleuet de France)
description_en: For 100 years, the cornflower (Bleuet de France) has been the flower of remembrance and solidarity in France. It started as a means of helping injured veterans of the First World War, but before long had been adopted by the whole French nation as a symbol of gratitude for the sacrifices the soldiers had made to defend their country and their ideals. Today, as in the past, the cornflower still provides moral and financial support to veterans and victims of wars past and present and to victims of terrorism. It also helps pass on to young people standards and values such as respect, peace and tolerance. This flower of remembrance honours all those who fought and are still fighting for our freedom today. The design features the cornflower in the centre of the coin. It is surrounded by the words ‘Le Bleuet de France, fleur de mémoire et de solidarité’ (Bleuet of France, flower of remembrance and solidarity). The dates ‘1918-2018’ as well as the letters RF for République Française (French Republic) and the mint marks are also included in the design. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh:
一百年来，矢车菊（法国蓝花）一直是法国纪念和团结的象征。最初，它是为了帮助第一次世界大战中受伤的老兵而设立的，但很快便被整个法国人民所接受，成为对士兵为保卫国家和理想所作出的牺牲表示感激的象征。

今天，矢车菊依然像过去一样，为退伍军人、战争受害者（包括过去和现在的战争受害者）以及恐怖主义受害者提供精神和经济支持。

它还有助于向年轻人传递尊重、和平与宽容等价值观。这种纪念之花向所有曾经和现在仍在为我们的自由而战的人们致敬。

硬币的设计以矢车菊为中心，周围环绕着“Le Bleuet de France, fleur de mémoire et de solidarité”（法国蓝花，纪念和团结之花）的字样。硬币设计中包含“1918-2018”字样、代表法兰西共和国的字母“RF”以及造币厂标记。

硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 70th Anniversary of the Coming into Force of the Italian Constitution
description_en: Enrico De Nicola, provisional Head of State, signs the act of promulgation of the Constitution of the Italian Republic on December 27, 1947; on his right, the Head of Government Alcide De Gasperi, on the left, Umberto Terracini, President of the Italian Constituent Assembly. Above, the inscription ‘COSTITUZIONE’ and the monogram of the Italian Republic ‘RI’; in exergue, the inscription ‘CON SICURA COSCIENZA’, ‘R’, the mintmark of the Mint of Rome, and the dates ‘1948 • 2018’, respectively year of the coming into force of the Italian Constitution and year of the issue of the coin. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 1947年12月27日，临时国家元首恩里科·德·尼古拉签署了《意大利共和国宪法》颁布令；在他右侧是政府首脑阿尔奇德·德·加斯佩里，左侧是意大利制宪会议主席翁贝托·特拉奇尼。上方铭文为“COSTITUZIONE”（宪法）和意大利共和国的缩写“RI”；下方铭文为“CON SICURA COSCIENZA”（知情同意）、“R”、罗马造币厂的造币标记以及“1948 • 2018”字样，分别代表意大利宪法生效年份和硬币发行年份。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 25th anniversary of the establishment of the Slovak Republic
description_en: The design symbolises Slovakia’s entry into the European Union and the euro area by showing a stylised portal arching over both a map of Slovakia and a euro symbol surrounded by the European Union stars, some covered by the map. The Slovak coat of arms appears on the left of the design. At the lower left side, in semi-circle is the name of the issuing country ‘SLOVENSKÁ REPUBLIKA’. The date of the country’s establishment ‘1.1.1993’ and the year of issuance ‘2018’ appear, one above the other, below the right side of the map. Between the map and the date are the mint mark of the Kremnica Mint (Mincovňa Kremnica), consisting of the initials ‘MK’ placed between two dies, and the stylised letters ‘PK’, the initials of the designer, Pavel Károly. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计象征着斯洛伐克加入欧盟和欧元区，图案为一个程式化的拱门，拱门下方是斯洛伐克地图和欧元符号，周围环绕着欧盟星徽，部分星徽被地图遮盖。斯洛伐克国徽位于图案左侧。左下角半圆形区域内是发行国名称“斯洛伐克共和国”（SLOVENSKÁ REPUBLIKA）。地图右下方上下排列着国家成立日期“1993年1月1日”和发行年份“2018”。地图和日期之间是克雷姆尼察造币厂（Mincovňa Kremnica）的造币厂标记，由两个模具之间的字母“MK”和设计师帕维尔·卡罗利（Pavel Károly）的姓名首字母“PK”组成。硬币外圈饰有欧盟12颗星。

title: The 150th anniversary of the Luxembourg Constitution
description_en: The design shows on the left hand the effigy of His Royal Highness, the Grand-Duke Henri, looking to the right. At the right hand of the design are depicted the year-dates ‘1868-2018’ as well as the text ‘150 ans’. Below the effigy of the Grand-Duke appear the text ‘Constitution du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg’ and a lateral cut view of an open booklet. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币左侧是亨利大公殿下面向右侧的肖像。右侧标有年份“1868-2018”以及“150 ans”（150周年）字样。大公肖像下方是“卢森堡大公宪法”字样以及一本打开的小册子的侧视图。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Berlin (‘Federal States’ (Bundesländer) series)
description_en: The design shows the main building of the Charlottenburg Palace from the side of the Cour d' Honneur. The inner part also features the name ‘BERLIN’ and the mint mark of the respective mint (‘A’, ‘D’, ‘F’, ‘G’ or ‘J’) at the bottom, the issuing country's country code ‘D’ right at the top, the year ‘2018’ left at the top and the engraver's mark left at the bottom. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了从荣誉庭院侧面看到的夏洛滕堡宫主楼。内侧底部刻有“柏林”字样和相应造币厂的标记（“A”、“D”、“F”、“G”或“J”），顶部右侧为发行国的国家代码“D”，顶部左侧为年份“2018”，底部左侧为雕刻师标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 100 years of the Austrian Republic
description_en: The design depicts the statue of Pallas Athena in front of the Greek-style building of the Austrian Parliament in Vienna. The goddess of wisdom serves as a symbol of the Austrian parliamentarism and stands for knowledge, reason and strategic talent. At the left side is the year ‘2018’ and underneath the text ‘100 JAHRE’ (100 YEARS). The text ‘REPUBLIK ÖSTERREICH’ (AUSTRIAN REPUBLIC) is inscribed at the bottom right in semi-circle. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了位于维也纳的奥地利议会大厦（一座希腊风格的建筑）前的帕拉斯·雅典娜雕像。这位智慧女神象征着奥地利的议会制度，代表着知识、理性以及战略才能。左侧是年份“2018”，下方是“100 JAHRE”（百年）。右下角以半圆形刻有“REPUBLIK ÖSTERREICH”（奥地利共和国）字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 600 years of the Council of the Land
description_en: The design commemorates the 600th anniversary of the creation of the Consell de la Terra (Council of the Land). It was a representative body created in 1419, predecessor of the Consell General (General Council), the parliament of Andorra. The design depicts the upper part of the entry portal of Casa de la Vall (the parliament’s old seat), with the coat of arms of the country and a fragment of a window above it. Two compact groups of human faces on both sides of the design, as if they were stones of the building, mean the cohesion of Andorrans as a social community united in history, institutions and values. The inscription ‘600 ANYS DEL CONSELL DE LA TERRA’ (600 years of the Council of the Land) at the top, and the name of the issuing country ‘ANDORRA’ and both year dates ‘1419’ and ‘2019’ in the middle of the number ‘600’ below complete the design. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh:
该设计旨在纪念安道尔土地委员会（Consell de la Terra）成立600周年。土地委员会成立于1419年，是安道尔议会（Consell General）的前身。设计图案描绘了卡萨德拉瓦尔（Casa de la Vall，议会旧址）入口大门的上半部分，饰有安道尔国徽，国徽上方是一扇残缺的窗户。设计两侧各有一组紧凑的人脸，如同建筑的石块，象征着安道尔人民作为一个社会共同体的凝聚力，这种凝聚力源于共同的历史、制度和价值观。

顶部铭文“600 ANYS DEL CONSELL DE LA TERRA”（土地委员会成立600周年），下方数字“600”中间标注了发行国“安道尔”（ANDORRA）以及年份“1419”和“2019”，共同构成了完整的设计。硬币外圈印有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: The centenary of the University of Tartu
description_en: The coin will mark the centenary of the University of Tartu as being established as the first Estonian language university. It was founded in 1632 by Swedish King Gustav II Adolf and is one of the oldest universities in northern and eastern Europe. In 1919 it became the first Estonian language university. The design depicts a motif of the main building of the university. It also bears the inscriptions ‘RAHVUSÜLIKOOL 100’ (National University 100) and ‘UNIVERSITAS TARTUENSIS’, the year ‘1632’, the issuing country ‘EESTI’ and the year of issuance ‘2019’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 这枚纪念币旨在纪念塔尔图大学建校一百周年，该大学是爱沙尼亚第一所语言大学。塔尔图大学由瑞典国王古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫于1632年创立，是北欧和东欧最古老的大学之一。1919年，它成为爱沙尼亚第一所语言大学。纪念币的设计图案为大学主楼的图案，并镌刻有“RAHVUSÜLIKOOL 100”（国立大学100周年）、“UNIVERSITAS TARTUENSIS”（塔尔图大学）、年份“1632”、发行国“EESTI”（爱沙尼亚）和发行年份“2019”等字样。纪念币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: The 100th anniversary of the foundation of the University of Ljubljana
description_en: The University of Ljubljana’s logo is the core of the design. On the left side the University’s façade above the solid square of its logo is replaced with the inscription ‘100 LET UNIVERZE V LJUBLJANI’. The design’s background is textured in order to achieve a larger impact of the inscription with the solid square. On the lower part of the right side is the inscription ‘SLOVENIJA 2019’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 卢布尔雅那大学的校徽是设计的核心。左侧，校徽上方的大学建筑立面被替换为“100 LET UNIVERZE V LJUBLJANI”（卢布尔雅那大学百年校庆）字样。设计背景采用纹理效果，以增强实心方块和文字的视觉冲击力。右侧下方是“SLOVENIJA 2019”（斯洛文尼亚 2019）字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Sutartinės (Lithuanian multipart songs — inscribed on the Unesco Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity)
description_en: The design features linear motifs, symbolising polyphonic melodies of the unique Lithuanian heritage — folk songs sutartinės. The lines are widening and narrowing again, spinning into a swirl decorated with various miniature geometric and nature figures. The inscription of the issuing country ‘LIETUVA’, as well as the inscription ‘SUTARTINĖS’ (Lithuanian multipart songs) and the year of issuance ‘2019’ are depicted in semicircle. The mark of the Lithuanian Mint is featured as well. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计以线性图案为特色，象征着立陶宛独特的传统民歌——苏塔尔蒂内斯（sutartinės）的多声部旋律。线条时而加宽，时而收窄，最终形成漩涡状，并饰以各种微型几何图形和自然图案。发行国“LIETUVA”（立陶宛）字样、“SUTARTINĖS”（立陶宛多声部民歌）以及发行年份“2019”均以半圆形呈现。立陶宛造币厂的标志也包含在内。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Samogitia (Lithuanian Ethnographic Regions)
description_en: The design features a bear standing on its hind legs, with a chain collar on the neck. It has been depicted on the coat of arms of Samogitia since the 16th century. The bear is situated against a shield topped with a crown, which is held by an armoured soldier (a symbol of courage, sacrifice and patriotism) and a goddess with an anchor (a symbol of hope). Below is a Latin inscription ‘PATRIA UNA’ (one fatherland). The design is surrounded by the inscriptions ‘LIETUVA’ (Lithuania) and ‘ŽEMAITIJA’ (Samogitia), the year of issuance ‘2019’ and the mintmark of the Lithuanian Mint. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计图案为一只后腿站立的熊，颈部戴着链环。自16世纪以来，这只熊的形象就出现在萨莫吉希亚的徽章上。熊的头部置于一面盾牌前，盾牌上方饰有王冠，王冠由一位身披盔甲的士兵（象征勇气、牺牲和爱国主义）和一位手持锚的女神（象征希望）共同守护。下方是拉丁文铭文“PATRIA UNA”（同一个祖国）。图案周围环绕着“LIETUVA”（立陶宛）和“ŽEMAITIJA”（萨莫吉希亚）字样、发行年份“2019”以及立陶宛造币厂的标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: 600 years of the discovery of the Madeira Archipelago, by the Portuguese navigators Bartolomeu Perestrelo and Tristão Vaz
description_en: The event, known as the first Portuguese territorial discovery, marked a historic milestone in the consolidation of Portugal as a maritime power and gave rise to the Portuguese Age of Discoveries (1418-1522). The design bears the Madeira Archipelago and the island of Porto Santo. In semicircle are the inscriptions ‘600 anos do Descobrimento da Madeira e do Porto Santo’ and ‘PORTUGAL 2019’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 这一事件被称为葡萄牙的第一次领土发现，标志着葡萄牙巩固海上强国的历史性里程碑，并开启了葡萄牙大航海时代（1418-1522）。图案上有马德拉群岛和圣港岛。半圆形刻有“600 anos do Descobrimento da Madeira e do Porto Santo”和“PORTUGAL 2019”的铭文。硬币的外圈刻有欧洲国旗的 12 颗星。

title: 500 years of the first circumnavigation organised and led by the Portuguese explorer and navigator Fernão De Magalhães
description_en: The Spanish expedition to the East Indies began in 1519 and ended in 1522, resulting in the first circumnavigation of the Earth. The design bears the effigy of Fernão de Magalhães. At the right side, in semicircle, is the inscription ‘CIRCUM NAVEGAÇÃO’ (circumnavigation) and underneath the inscription ‘1519 FERNÃO DE MAGALHÃES’. At the left side, in semicircle, is the year of issuance ‘2019’ and the name of the issuing country ‘PORTUGAL’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 西班牙远征东印度群岛始于1519年，结束于1522年，完成了人类历史上首次环球航行。硬币正面图案为费尔南·德·麦加良斯的肖像。右侧半圆形区域内刻有“CIRCUM NAVEGAÇÃO”（环球航行）字样，下方刻有“1519 FERNÃO DE MAGALHÃES”（1519 费尔南·德·麦加良斯）。左侧半圆形区域内刻有发行年份“2019”和发行国“葡萄牙”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Nature and Environment
description_en: The design was created by a school student and bears a fruit tree and a stylised representation of the sun. At the bottom left is the name of the issuing country ‘MALTA’ and underneath the year of issuance ‘2019’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 这枚硬币的设计出自一位学生之手，图案为一棵果树和一个风格化的太阳。左下角是发行国“马耳他”的名称，下方是发行年份“2019”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: Sistine Chapel — End of the restoration 1994-2019
description_en: The design features the Last Judgment in the Sistine Chapel. At the left, in semi-circle is the inscription of the issuing country ‘CITTÀ DEL VATICANO’. At the right, in semi-circle, are the inscriptions ‘CAPPELLA SISTINA — FINE DEI RESTAURI’ and ‘1994-2019’. At the right side is the mintmark ‘R’ and at the bottom the name of the artist ‘D. LONGO’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计以西斯廷教堂的《最后的审判》为主题。左侧半圆形区域内刻有发行国梵蒂冈城（CITTÀ DEL VATICANO）字样。右侧半圆形区域内刻有西斯廷教堂（CAPPELLA SISTINA — FINE DEI RESTAURI）和“1994-2019”字样。右侧为造币厂标记“R”，底部为艺术家“D. LONGO”的名字。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: 30 years of the fall of the Berlin Wall
description_en: Thirty years ago, the Berlin Wall fell. Beyond the impact on German society, it was an event with global consequences. On November 9th, 1989, this occasion marks the end of the cold war and announces an appeasement after several decades of international tensions. At the European level, it is the first step towards the reunification of one of the leading countries of the European Union. This major change was after materialised by the Moscow Treaty of which France was a signatory. The European Union welcomed then 16 million new citizens in just one year; almost the structural and economic effect of welcoming a new country! The design represents the Berlin Wall, opened in its centre, letting the doves (allegories of the international appeasement), and the jubilant crowd pass. In the background, the Brandenburg Gate, Berlin’s symbol par excellence, is represented. The mention ‘30 ans de la chute du Mur de Berlin/30 Jahre Mauerfall’ is inscribed on one side of the wall. At the bottom of the design is the year of issuance ‘2019’ and at its right the indication of the issuing country ‘RF’ (standing for République française). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh:
三十年前，柏林墙倒塌。这不仅对德国社会产生了巨大影响，更是一件具有全球意义的事件。1989年11月9日，这一天标志着冷战的结束，也宣告了数十年国际紧张局势的终结。在欧洲层面，这是迈向欧盟主要成员国之一——德国统一的第一步。这一重大变革随后通过《莫斯科条约》得以实现，法国也是该条约的签署国之一。欧盟在短短一年内就迎来了1600万新公民，这几乎相当于一个新国家在结构和经济上带来的改变！

设计图描绘了柏林墙从中央打开，鸽子（象征着国际和解）和欢呼雀跃的人群从中穿过。背景中是柏林的标志性建筑——勃兰登堡门。墙的一侧刻有“柏林墙倒塌30周年/30 Jahre Mauerfall”的字样。设计底部是发行年份“2019”，右侧是发行国“RF”（即法兰西共和国）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 30th anniversary of the fall of the Berlin wall
description_en: Thirty years ago, the Berlin Wall fell. Beyond the impact on German society, it was an event with global consequences. On 9 November 1989, this occasion marks the end of the cold war and announces an appeasement after several decades of international tensions. At the European level, it is the first step towards the reunification of one of the leading countries of the European Union. This major change was later materialised by the Moscow Treaty of which France was a signatory. The European Union welcomed then 16 million new citizens in just one year; almost the structural and economic effect of welcoming a new country! The design represents the Berlin Wall, opened in its centre, letting the doves (allegories of the international appeasement), and the jubilant crowd pass. In the background, the Brandenburg Gate, Berlin’s symbol par excellence, is represented. The mention ‘30 Jahre Mauerfall’ (30 years of the fall of the Berlin Wall) is inscribed on one side of the wall. At the bottom of the design is the year of issuance ‘2019’ and at its right the indication of the issuing country ‘D’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 三十年前，柏林墙倒塌。这不仅对德国社会产生了巨大影响，更是一件具有全球意义的事件。1989年11月9日，这一天标志着冷战的结束，也宣告了数十年国际紧张局势的缓和。在欧洲层面，这是迈向欧盟主要成员国之一——德国统一的第一步。这一重大变革最终通过《莫斯科条约》得以实现，法国也是该条约的签署国之一。欧盟在短短一年内就迎来了1600万新公民，其结构和经济影响几乎相当于一个新国家的诞生！设计图描绘了柏林墙从中央打开，鸽子（象征着国际缓和）和欢呼的人群从中穿过。背景中是柏林的标志性建筑——勃兰登堡门。墙的一侧刻有“柏林墙倒塌30周年”的字样。设计底部是发行年份“2019”，右侧是发行国“D”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: The Constitution Act of Finland
description_en: The design shows three circular fields that are joined together at the centre. The three fields represent the trias politica, separation of powers into three different branches: a legislative, an executive, and a judiciary power. The year of issuance ‘2019’ is placed centre left. The indication of the issuing country ‘FI’ and the mint mark are placed bottom right. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计由三个圆形区域组成，中心相连。这三个区域代表意大利的三权分立，即立法权、行政权和司法权。发行年份“2019”位于左侧中央。发行国“FI”和造币厂标记位于右下角。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: The 100th anniversary of the universal suffrage
description_en: The design shows on the left hand the effigy of His Royal Highness, the Grand Duke Henri, and on the right hand a ballot box where a ballot paper is being inserted by a hand. At the bottom is the name of the issuing country ‘LUXEMBOURG’. At the top, in semi-circle form is the inscription ‘Centenaire du suffrage universel’ (Centenary of the universal franchise) and underneath the inscription ‘1919 - 2019’, the latter being the year of issuance. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该硬币的设计图案左侧是亨利大公殿下的肖像，右侧是一个投票箱，一只手正将选票放入其中。底部是发行国“卢森堡”的名称。顶部呈半圆形铭文“Centenaire du suffrage universel”（普选百年纪念），下方铭文为“1919-2019”，后者为发行年份。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: The rising sun
description_en: The coin is dedicated to the history of the Coat of arms of Latvia and features the motif of a rising sun. This motif was originally part of the design proposal for the symbol of the autonomous Latvia, created by artist Ansis Cīrulis in 1917. Later on this motif emerged as one of the basic elements of the Coat of arms of Latvia. The motif of a rising sun has also been used by artist Ansis Cīrulis before, in the design of the Latvian riflemen’s badge and his other artworks. After the foundation of the Republic of Latvia in 1918 variations of the motif of a rising sun appeared in all design proposals for the Coat of arms of the new State. The Coat of arms of Latvia was officially adopted in 1921. The design shows the motif of the rising sun, with stylised letters B and L (an abbreviation from the words ‘Brīvā Latvija’ (Free Latvia)) in the centre. It also bears an inscription ‘UZLECOŠĀ SAULE’ (The rising sun), the name of the issuing country ‘LATVIJA’ and the year of issuance ‘2019’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 这枚硬币旨在纪念拉脱维亚国徽的历史，其图案为冉冉升起的太阳。这一图案最初是艺术家安西斯·西鲁利斯 (Ansis Cīrulis) 于 1917 年为拉脱维亚自治区设计的国徽设计方案的一部分。后来，这一图案成为拉脱维亚国徽的基本元素之一。此前，安西斯·西鲁利斯也曾在拉脱维亚步枪兵徽章和其他艺术作品中使用过冉冉升起的太阳图案。1918 年拉脱维亚共和国成立后，在所有为新国家设计的国徽方案中都出现了不同版本的冉冉升起的太阳图案。拉脱维亚国徽于 1921 年正式启用。国徽图案为冉冉升起的太阳，中心是风格化的字母 B 和 L（取自“Brīvā Latvija”（自由拉脱维亚）的缩写）。硬币上还刻有“UZLECOŠĀ SAULE”（旭日）字样、发行国名称“拉脱维亚”和发行年份“2019”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: 550th anniversary of the death of Filippo Lippi
description_en: The centre of the coin features the Madonna and Child, a detail from Filippo Lippi’s ‘Madonna and Child with Two Angels’; above are the inscriptions ‘SAN MARINO’ and ‘FILIPPO LIPPI’ and on the left are the year ‘1469’ and the letter ‘R’ identifying the Mint of Rome. On the bottom left are the initials of the artist Maria Angela Cassol ‘M.A.C.’, and in the centre the year ‘2019’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 硬币中央图案为圣母子像，取自菲利波·利皮（Filippo Lippi）的画作《圣母子与两位天使》（Madonna and Child with Two Angels）；上方刻有“SAN MARINO”和“FILIPPO LIPPI”字样；左侧为年份“1469”和代表罗马造币厂的字母“R”；左下方为艺术家玛丽亚·安吉拉·卡索尔（Maria Angela Cassol）的姓名首字母“M.A.C.”；中央为年份“2019”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Unesco World Heritage Site – pre-historic temples of Ta’ Haġrat
description_en: The design features Ta’ Haġrat, a prehistoric temple located in Mġarr, a small village in the northwest of Malta. The temple consists of two structures the largest of which dates to around 3 600-3 200 BC. This temple has a monumental doorway, which is its most distinctive characteristic. The inscription ‘TA’HAĠRAT TEMPLES 3600-3000 BC’ appears at the top of the design. At the bottom are the name of the issuing country ‘MALTA’ and the year of issuance ‘2019’. The coin's outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计以塔哈格拉特神庙为主题，这是一座位于马耳他西北部小村庄姆贾尔的史前神庙。神庙由两座建筑组成，其中较大的一座可追溯至公元前3600年至3200年左右。这座神庙最显著的特征是其宏伟的入口。设计顶部刻有“塔哈格拉特神庙 公元前3600-3000年”字样。底部是发行国“马耳他”和发行年份“2019”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Song Festival’s 150-year anniversary
description_en: The design is inspired by the Song Celebration procession, which moves like the waves on the sea with cheers of pride and joy and a panoply of national dress. The design unites music, national costumes, and the various sites of the great and powerful Song Celebration of the nation by the sea. The design also features the first notes of the Estonian national anthem and, at the bottom, the words ‘Laulupidu 150’ (Song Celebration 150). At the top is the year of issuance ‘2019’ and underneath the name of the issuing country ‘EESTI’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计灵感源自歌唱庆典游行，游行队伍如同海浪般涌动，伴随着骄傲与喜悦的欢呼声和各式各样的民族服饰。设计融合了音乐、民族服饰以及盛大而震撼的歌唱庆典的各个地点。设计中还包含爱沙尼亚国歌的开头几个音符，底部刻有“Laulupidu 150”（歌唱庆典150周年）字样。顶部是发行年份“2019”，下方是发行国名称“EESTI”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: Andreas Kalvos — 150 years in memoriam
description_en: Born in Zante, Andreas Kalvos (1792-1869) is one the most important modern Greek poets. Combining a solid neo-classicist education with the high ideals of Romanticism and archaicising with demotic Greek, he expressed both the revolutionary ideas of his time and his personal vision. The national side of the coin features a portrait of Andreas Kalvos. Inscribed along the inner edge at the left is the name ‘ANDREAS KALVOS 1792-1869’, along with the minting year and a palmette (mintmark of the Greek Mint); inscribed along the inner edge at the right is the wording ‘HELLENIC REPUBLIC’. Also visible at the right is the monogram of the artist (George Stamatopoulos). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 安德烈亚斯·卡尔沃斯（1792-1869）出生于扎金索斯岛，是希腊最重要的现代诗人之一。他融合了扎实的新古典主义教育、浪漫主义的崇高理想以及古希腊语的通俗化风格，既表达了时代的革命思想，也展现了他独特的个人视角。这枚硬币的正面是安德烈亚斯·卡尔沃斯的肖像。左侧内缘刻有“ANDREAS KALVOS 1792-1869”字样、铸造年份以及希腊造币厂的棕榈叶纹章；右侧内缘刻有“HELLENIC REPUBLIC”（希腊共和国）字样。右侧还可以看到艺术家（乔治·斯塔马托普洛斯）的姓名缩写。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Centenary of the birth of Manolis Andronicos
description_en: Manolis Andronicos (1919-1992) was one of Greece’s greatest archaeologists. His discovery of the royal tombs at Vergina in 1977 brought to light exquisite finds that attest to the splendour of ancient Macedonian civilisation. The design features a portrait of Manolis Andronicos. Inscribed along the inner edge at left is the name ‘MANOLIS ANDRONICOS 1919-1992’, along with the minting year and a palmette (mintmark of the Greek Mint); inscribed along the inner edge at right is the wording ‘HELLENIC REPUBLIC’. Also visible at the right is the monogram of the artist (George Stamatopoulos). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 马诺利斯·安德罗尼科斯（1919-1992）是希腊最伟大的考古学家之一。1977年，他在韦尔吉纳发现了皇家陵墓，出土了大量精美文物，展现了古马其顿文明的辉煌。这枚硬币正面是马诺利斯·安德罗尼科斯的肖像。左侧内缘刻有“MANOLIS ANDRONICOS 1919-1992”字样，以及铸造年份和希腊造币厂的棕榈叶纹章；右侧内缘刻有“HELLENIC REPUBLIC”（希腊共和国）字样。右侧还可以看到艺术家（乔治·斯塔马托普洛斯）的姓名缩写。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 200th anniversary of the accession to the throne of Prince Honoré V
description_en: The design shows the effigy of Prince Honoré V. At the left is the inscription ‘HONORÉ V’ and at the right the name of the issuing country ‘MONACO’. At the bottom, in semi-circle, is the inscription ‘1819 — Avènement — 2019’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了奥诺雷五世亲王的肖像。左侧刻有“HONORÉ V”字样，右侧刻有发行国名称“MONACO”。底部半圆形区域刻有“1819 — Avènement — 2019”字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 60th anniversary of Asterix
description_en: For 60 years, Asterix has been a true icon of the French culture. Created in 1959 by scenarist René Goscinny and cartoonist Albert Uderzo, this character embodies the Frenchman with his smartness and sharpness through the Gallic identity. Apart from its artistic line, depicting contemporary society with humour has brought Asterix a great international fame for many years. Since its inception, it has been translated into all the languages of the European Union meeting a huge success. The reputation of Asterix is for example as strong in Germany as in France. It has also been very well established in the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Spain, Portugal, Italy and Scandinavia for many years. Beyond the French icon, Asterix has become a true figure of the European 9th art. The design represents Asterix in profile wearing his famous winged helmet. He is surrounded by laurels and Roman inscriptions referring to his 60 years. At the top is the inscription ‘ASTÉRIX’ and underneath the indication of the issuing country ‘RF’ (standing for République française). The year of issuance ‘2019’ is inscribed at the bottom, together with the French mintmark and mintmaster mark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 六十年来，阿斯特里克斯一直是法国文化的真正象征。这个角色由编剧勒内·戈西尼和漫画家阿尔伯特·乌德佐于1959年创作，以其机智和敏锐的法国人特质，以及高卢人的身份认同，完美地诠释了法国人的形象。除了其艺术风格外，阿斯特里克斯以幽默的方式描绘当代社会，多年来享誉国际。自诞生以来，它已被翻译成欧盟所有语言，并取得了巨大的成功。例如，阿斯特里克斯在德国的声誉与在法国一样高。多年来，它在英国、荷兰、西班牙、葡萄牙、意大利和斯堪的纳维亚半岛也拥有极高的人气。除了作为法国的标志性人物之外，阿斯特里克斯也成为了欧洲第九艺术的代表人物。这幅设计描绘了阿斯特里克斯的侧面像，他头戴标志性的带翼头盔，周围环绕着月桂花环和罗马铭文，象征着他六十年的创作历程。顶部刻有“ASTÉRIX”字样，下方标明发行国“RF”（即法兰西共和国）。底部刻有发行年份“2019”，以及法国造币厂标记和造币厂厂长标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 100th anniversary of the death of Milan Rastislav Štefánik
description_en: The design features a portrait of Milan Rastislav Štefánik, one of the most important figures in Slovak history. To the left of the portrait are the dates of Štefánik’s birth ‘1880’ and death ‘1919’, one above the other. At the left side of the inner part of the coin, in semi-circle, are the name ‘MILAN RASTISLAV ŠTEFÁNIK’ and the name of the issuing country ‘SLOVENSKO’. The year of issuance ‘2019’ is between the portrait and the right side. Below the year are the stylised letters ‘PV’, the initials of the designer, Peter Valach, and below them is the mint mark of the Kremnica Mint (Mincovňa Kremnica), consisting of the letters ‘MK’ placed between two dies. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该硬币的设计以斯洛伐克历史上最重要的人物之一米兰·拉斯蒂斯拉夫·斯特凡尼克的肖像为特色。肖像左侧是斯特凡尼克的出生年份“1880”和逝世年份“1919”，上下排列。硬币内侧左侧呈半圆形，刻有“米兰·拉斯蒂斯拉夫·斯特凡尼克”的名字和发行国“斯洛伐克”的名称。发行年份“2019”位于肖像和右侧之间。年份下方是风格化的字母“PV”，这是设计师彼得·瓦拉赫的姓名首字母缩写，再往下是克雷姆尼察造币厂（Mincovňa Kremnica）的造币厂标记，由两个模具之间的字母“MK”组成。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 500th anniversary of the death of Leonardo da Vinci
description_en: The centre of the coin bears an angel painted by Leonardo da Vinci in ‘The Baptism of Christ’; at the edge, on the left is the inscription ‘SAN MARINO’, on the right the inscription ‘1519 Leonardo 2019’; on the left are the initials of the artist Uliana Pernazza ‘UP’ and on the bottom right, the letter ‘R’ identifying the Mint of Rome. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币中央图案为达·芬奇名作《基督受洗》中的天使像；边缘左侧刻有“SAN MARINO”（圣马力诺），右侧刻有“1519 Leonardo 2019”（1519 达·芬奇 2019）；左侧是艺术家乌利亚纳·佩尔纳扎的姓名首字母“UP”，右下角是代表罗马造币厂的字母“R”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Ski World Cup Finals 2019
description_en: The 2019 Ski World Cup Finals were held in the Principality of Andorra from 11 to 17 March 2019. With this event, the Principality of Andorra hosted one of the most important alpine skiing competitions in the world. For the Principality of Andorra, it was the most prestigious winter sport event that has ever been held in the country, and a turning point in the country’s trajectory as a sport destination. The design of the coin shows in the foreground a skier sliding down a slope. In the background, four curved lines, from the official logo of these Ski World Cup Finals, represent the slopes where the competition took place. Some snowflakes complete the design together with the inscription ‘FINALS DE LA COPA DEL MÓN D’ESQUÍ ANDORRA 2019’ (Andorra 2019 Ski World Cup Finals). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 2019年高山滑雪世界杯总决赛于2019年3月11日至17日在安道尔公国举行。安道尔公国承办了这项世界最重要的滑雪赛事之一。对于安道尔公国而言，这是该国举办过的最负盛名的冬季运动盛事，也是该国作为体育旅游目的地发展历程中的一个转折点。硬币的设计前景展现了一名滑雪者从雪坡上滑下的场景。背景中，源自本届高山滑雪世界杯总决赛官方标志的四条曲线代表了比赛举办的雪道。一些雪花点缀其间，并镌刻着“FINALS DE LA COPA DEL MÓN D’ESQUÍ ANDORRA 2019”（2019年安道尔高山滑雪世界杯总决赛）字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 90th anniversary of the foundation of the Vatican City State
description_en: The design features a portrait of Pope Pius XI (Sovereign of the State in 1929) and the Lateran in Rome. At the top, from left to right, in semi-circle is the inscription of the issuing country ‘STATO DELLA CITTÀ DEL VATICANO’. At the bottom are the years ‘1929’ and ‘2019’ and underneath the name of the artist ‘FUSCO’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该硬币的设计图案为教宗庇护十一世（1929年在位）的肖像和罗马拉特兰大殿。顶部，从左至右呈半圆形排列着发行国“梵蒂冈城国”（STATO DELLA CITTÀ DEL VATICANO）的字样。底部标有年份“1929”和“2019”，下方是艺术家“FUSCO”的名字。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: Unesco’s World Cultural and Natural Heritage Sites — the old town of Avila and its churches outside the walls
description_en: The city of Avila has preserved the austerity and purity of the mediaeval style, surrounded by the most complete walls of Spain. The design reproduces at the centre a detail of the Avila wall. At the top side circular ascending the word ‘ESPAÑA’, the year of issuance ‘2019’ and the mint mark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 阿维拉城保留了中世纪风格的质朴与纯粹，四周环绕着西班牙保存最完好的城墙。硬币中央图案再现了阿维拉城墙的局部细节。顶部环绕着“ESPAÑA”（西班牙）字样、发行年份“2019”和造币厂标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 100 years since the establishment of the Dáil Éireann (Irish Parliament)
description_en: The design bears the first sitting of Dáil Éireann in the Round Room. The Governance of the Irish nation began on the 21st of January and the sitting was conducted entirely in the Irish language to mark the symbolic nature of the meeting. The large Round Room of the Mansion House arcs above the vast congregation of the nation’s first elected Dáil. The words ‘An Chéad Dáil’, at the centre of the design, together with the year ‘1919’ at the top, are inscribed in a traditional uncial font. At the bottom are inscribed the name of the country and the year of issuance ‘ÉIRE 2019’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了爱尔兰议会（Dáil Éireann）在圆形会议室召开的首次会议。爱尔兰国家治理于1月21日正式启动，会议全程使用爱尔兰语进行，以彰显其象征意义。议会大厦（Mansion House）宽敞的圆形会议室俯瞰着爱尔兰首届民选议会的庞大会场。设计中心以传统的安色尔字体镌刻着“An Chéad Dáil”（议会）字样，顶部是年份“1919”。底部镌刻着国名和发行年份“ÉIRE 2019”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 70th anniversary of the Bundesrat’s founding
description_en: The design shows a highly detailed and finely sculpted rendering of the Bundesrat building. The upper half of the coin’s inner section includes the mint mark of the respective mint (‘A’, ‘D’, ‘F’, ‘G’ or ‘J’), the artist’s initials and the year ‘2019’. The lower half of the coin’s inner section contains the inscription ‘BUNDESRAT’ and Germany’s issuing country code ‘D’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了德国联邦参议院大楼精细的雕刻细节。硬币内圈上半部分包含相应造币厂的标记（“A”、“D”、“F”、“G”或“J”）、艺术家姓名首字母以及年份“2019”。硬币内圈下半部分刻有“BUNDESRAT”（德国联邦参议院）字样和德国发行国代码“D”。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 500th anniversary of the death of Leonardo da Vinci
description_en: The design shows a detail of the painting ‘Dama con l'ermellino’ (Lady with an Ermine) by Leonardo da Vinci (National Museum in Krakow). On the left, the inscription ‘LEONARDO’, the initials of the author Maria Angela Cassol ‘MAC’ and the logo ‘RI’ acronym of the Italian Republic; on the right, ‘R’, mintmark of the Mint of Rome and the dates ‘1519-2019’, respectively the year of Leonardo’s death and the year of the coin issuance. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 该设计展现了列奥纳多·达·芬奇的画作《抱银鼠的女子》（现藏于克拉科夫国家博物馆）的局部细节。左侧刻有“LEONARDO”字样、作者玛丽亚·安吉拉·卡索尔的姓名首字母“MAC”以及意大利共和国的标志“RI”；右侧刻有“R”字样、罗马造币厂的造币标记以及“1519-2019”字样，分别代表列奥纳多的逝世年份和该硬币的发行年份。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 100th anniversary of the accession to the throne of Grand Duchess Charlotte
description_en: The design shows on the left hand the effigy of His Royal Highness, the Grand Duke Henri, and on the right hand the effigy of the Grand Duchess Charlotte. At the bottom is the name of the issuing country ‘LUXEMBOURG’ and underneath the year of issuance ‘2019’. At the top, in semi-circle around the effigies is the inscription ‘Centenaire de l’accession au trône de la Grande-Duchesse Charlotte’ (Centenary of the accession to the throne of Grand Duchess Charlotte). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币左侧为亨利大公殿下的肖像，右侧为夏洛特大公夫人的肖像。底部是发行国“卢森堡”的名称，再下方是发行年份“2019”。顶部，围绕肖像的半圆形铭文为“夏洛特大公夫人登基一百周年”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The 450th anniversary of the death of Pieter Bruegel the Elder
description_en: The inner part of the piece bears the portrait of the famous Belgian artist Pieter Bruegel the Elder, together with a painting on an easel. Above this, you can find the name P. BRUEGEL, the years 1569, with a subtle obelisk referring to the year of death, and 2019, the year of issuance. As the Royal Dutch Mint will strike the coins, the mintmark of Utrecht, a mercury staff is located on the left together with the Belgian mint director mintmark, the coat of arms of the municipality Herzele, the country code BE. The initials LL referring to the designer of the coin, Mr Luc Luycx, are located on the right. Finally, around the edge of the inner part small dots form a circle. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 硬币内圈是比利时著名艺术家老彼得·勃鲁盖尔的肖像，旁边是一幅画架上的画作。肖像上方是“P. BRUEGEL”字样、年份“1569”（一个代表勃鲁盖尔逝世年份的精致方尖碑）以及发行年份“2019”。由于这枚硬币由荷兰皇家造币厂铸造，因此左侧印有乌得勒支造币厂的标志——水星权杖，以及比利时造币厂厂长标志、赫泽勒市的市徽和国家代码“BE”。右侧是硬币设计师卢克·吕克斯先生的姓名缩写“LL”。最后，内圈边缘环绕着一圈小圆点。硬币外圈则印有欧盟的12颗星。

title: 25th anniversary of the European Monetary Institute (EMI)
description_en: The inner part of the piece bears the portrait Alexandre Lamfalussy, the first president of the EMI, on the right with his name below. On the left-hand side, the abbreviation EMI stands central with the year 1994 above, referring to date of the establishment of the Institute and the designation of Lamfalussy as its first president. Below ‘EMI’, several coins are depicted falling on each other with the inscription €, ‘ECU’ and ‘BEF’ from top to bottom. Given the fact that this is a Belgian issuance, we have chosen for ‘BEF’, the abbreviation of our former national currency. The purpose of this representation is to symbolise the transition of the national currencies to an European single currency, the euro as the EMI’s main focus was on establishing the European System of Central Banks, including the ECB and the new currency On the upper part of the left side of the coin is an inscription ‘European Monetary Institute’. As the Royal Dutch Mint will strike the coins, the mintmark of Utrecht, a mercury staff is located on the left with the Belgian mint director mintmark, the coat of arms of the municipality Herzele.
