The country code BE and the year mark 2019 are located on the bottom. The initials LL referring to the designer of the coin, Mr Luc Luycx, are inscribed on the right. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European Union.
description_zh: 这枚硬币内侧右侧是欧洲货币研究所（EMI）首任主席亚历山大·拉姆法卢西（Alexandre Lamfalussy）的肖像，下方是他的名字。左侧中央是EMI的缩写，上方是1994年，代表该研究所的成立年份以及拉姆法卢西被任命为首任主席的年份。EMI下方描绘了几枚硬币相互碰撞的图案，从上到下依次是€、ECU和BEF。鉴于这是一枚比利时发行的硬币，我们选择了BEF作为货币单位，它是比利时旧货币的缩写。这种设计旨在象征各国货币向欧洲单一货币——欧元的过渡，因为EMI的主要工作是建立欧洲中央银行体系，包括欧洲央行（ECB）和新货币。硬币左侧上方刻有“欧洲货币研究所”（European Monetary Institute）字样。由于这枚硬币将由荷兰皇家造币厂铸造，因此左侧是乌得勒支的造币厂标记——水星权杖，右侧是比利时造币厂厂长标记——赫泽勒市的市徽。国家代码“BE”和年份“2019”位于底部。右侧刻有硬币设计师卢克·吕克斯先生的姓名缩写“LL”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟的12颗星。

title: The birth of Prince Charles
description_en: The design depicts at the centre the representation of Prince Charles as well as the effigies of his parents, Their Royal Highnesses the Hereditary Grand Duke Guillaume and the Hereditary Grand Duchess Stephanie. Below these effigies, the text ‘S.A.R. de Prënz Charles’ (His Royal Highness the Prince Charles) is followed by the date of birth ‘10 May 2020’. At the left, the word ‘LËTZEBUERG’ as the designation of the issuing country is depicted vertically. The monogram (letter ‘H’ with a crown) is a representation of the Grand Duke Henri. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计中心图案为查尔斯王子的肖像，以及他的父母——世袭大公纪尧姆殿下和世袭大公夫人斯蒂芬妮的肖像。肖像下方是“S.A.R. de Prënz Charles”（查尔斯王子殿下）字样，其后是出生日期“2020年5月10日”。左侧垂直刻有发行国“莱茨堡”（LËTZEBUERG）字样。字母“H”（带皇冠）的图案代表亨利大公。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: 730th anniversary of the University of Coimbra
description_en: The design depicts the tower of University of Coimbra and a visual composition of triangles representing the roofs of the university of Coimbra, the highest is of the Joanina Library within the lettering ‘UNIVERSIDADE DE COIMBRA 730 ANOS PORTUGAL 2020’ (English – UNIVERSITY OF COIMBRA 730 YEARS PORTUGAL 2020). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了科英布拉大学的塔楼和代表科英布拉大学屋顶的三角形视觉组合，最高的是乔阿尼娜图书馆，上面写着“UNIVERSIDADE DE COIMBRA 730 ANOS PORTUGAL 2020”（英语 – UNIVERSITY OF COIMBRA 730 YEARS PORTUGAL 2020）。硬币的外圈刻有欧洲国旗的 12 颗星。

title: 20th anniversary of Slovakia’s accession to the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
description_en: The upper right half of the national side design depicts a representation of the concept of digital humanism: printed circuits in the shape of a human brain, in the centre of which is a circle representing a microprocessor. The Slovak coat of arms is placed next to the lower right edge. Inscribed inside a square outline that partly overlaps the main image are the words ‘20. VÝROČIE’ and ‘VSTUP SR DO OECD’ (the 20th anniversary of Slovakia’s accession to the OECD). Below the square is the name of the issuing country ‘SLOVENSKO’ and the year of issuance ‘2020’, one above the other. Between the square and the left edge of the design is the mint mark of the Kremnica Mint (Mincovňa Kremnica), consisting of the letters ‘MK’ placed between two dies. Below the mint mark are the stylised letters ‘PV’ referring to the designer Peter Valach. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 国徽图案的右上半部分描绘了数字人文主义的概念，以人脑形状的电路图呈现，中心是一个代表微处理器的圆圈。斯洛伐克国徽位于右下角。一个部分覆盖主图案的方形框内刻有“20. VÝROČIE”（斯洛伐克加入经合组织20周年）和“VSTUP SR DO OECD”（斯洛伐克加入经合组织20周年）。方形框下方是发行国名称“SLOVENSKO”（斯洛伐克）和发行年份“2020”（2020），上下排列。方形框与图案左边缘之间是克雷姆尼察造币厂（Mincovňa Kremnica）的造币厂标记，由两个模具之间的字母“MK”组成。造币厂标记下方是风格化的字母“PV”，代表设计师彼得·瓦拉赫（Peter Valach）。硬币外圈印有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: The 30th anniversary of the Cyprus Institute of Neurology and genetics
description_en: The design depicts a ‘neuron with its synapses’ in reference to the activities performed by the Cyprus Institute of Neurology and Genetics, which celebrates 30 years of existence. The Cyprus Institute of Neurology and Genetics receives international recognition and plays an active and essential role as a national, regional and international centre of excellence for the provision opf high quality services, innovative reasearch and postgraduate education. The iossuing country’s name ‘KYΠΡΟΣ - KIBRIS’ and the phrase ‘ΙΝΣΤΙTOYΤΟ ΝΕΥΡΟΛΟΓΊΑΣ & ΓΕΝΕΤΙKHΣ KYΠΡΟY 1990-2020’ (i.e. Cyprus Institute of Neurology and Genetics 1990-2020) are inscribed in circle around the design. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了一个“带有突触的神经元”，象征着塞浦路斯神经病学与遗传学研究所的各项活动，该研究所今年正值成立30周年。塞浦路斯神经病学与遗传学研究所享誉国际，作为国家、地区和国际卓越中心，在提供高质量服务、开展创新研究和研究生教育方面发挥着积极而重要的作用。发行国名称“KYΠΡΟΣ - KIBRIS”和“ΙΝΣΤΙTOYΤΟ ΝΕΥΡΟΛΟΓΊΑΣ & ΓΕΝΕΤΙKHΣ KYΠΡΟY 1990-2020”（即塞浦路斯神经病学与遗传学研究所 1990-2020）环绕在图案周围。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: UNESCO Cultural Heritage - Kryžių Kalnas (the Hill of Crosses)
description_en: The design depicts the Hill of Crosses: fragments of wooden and forged crosses, symbolising Lithuanian cross-crafting and folk culture. Cross-crafting and cross-symbolism in Lithuania are included in the UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity. The inscriptions featured are: Lithuania’s name ‘LIETUVA’, the year of issue ‘2020’ on the top, ‘KRYŽIŲ KALNAS’ (the Hill of Crosses) and the mark of the Lithuanian Mint at the bottom. The design is realised by Rytas Jonas Belevičius. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了十字架山，山上散落着木制和锻造十字架的碎片，象征着立陶宛的十字架制作工艺和民间文化。立陶宛的十字架制作工艺和十字架象征意义已被列入联合国教科文组织人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录。硬币顶部刻有立陶宛国名“LIETUVA”和发行年份“2020”，底部刻有“KRYŽIŲ KALNAS”（十字架山）和立陶宛造币厂的标志。该设计由Rytas Jonas Belevičius完成。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: Väinö Linna 100 years
description_en: The coin celebrates the well-known late Finnish writer Väinö Linna. This year marks the centenary of his birth in 1920. The design reflects Linna’s work in a textile mill and depicts, in addition to his face, letters as weaved fabric and threads that run through his books. The inscription VÄINÖ LINNA is at the left side. At the bottom are the inscriptions of the year of issuance ‘2020’, of the issuing country ‘FI’ and the mintmark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 这枚硬币是为了纪念芬兰著名作家瓦伊诺·林纳而发行的。今年是他诞辰一百周年（1920年）。硬币的设计展现了林纳在纺织厂的工作场景，除了他的肖像外，还描绘了织成织物的字母和贯穿他作品的线迹。硬币左侧刻有“VÄINÖ LINNA”（瓦伊诺·林纳）字样。底部刻有发行年份“2020”、发行国“FI”和造币厂标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Children’s games
description_en: The design depicts a melange of traditional games popular with Maltese children. These include marbles, spinning tops and traditional kite-making and flying. Depicted is also a Maltese version of hop-scotch which is known locally as ‘passju’. Three bees flying in a circle allude to a popular chant sung by Maltese children during play. Included in the design is the name of the issuing country, ‘Malta’, and the year of issue, ‘2020’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了马耳他儿童喜爱的各种传统游戏，包括弹珠、陀螺、制作和放飞传统风筝。图案中还描绘了马耳他版的跳房子游戏，当地人称之为“passju”。三只蜜蜂围成一圈飞舞，象征着马耳他儿童玩耍时常唱的一首童谣。设计中还包含了发行国“马耳他”和发行年份“2020”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: The 50th anniversary of Willy Brandt’s Kniefall von Warschau
description_en: The design shows Brandt, who was the chancellor of Germany at that time, keeling before the Monument to the Ghetto Heroes in Warsaw in a gesture of humility. Yhe Warsaw Ghetto Uprising of 1943 is evoked by the composition’s powerful imagery. Traced in extremely fine relief, the design pictures compelling symbols: a seven-branched menorah, the ghetto victims, as well as the genuflection. The inner part of the coin also features the artist’s initials (top), the mint mark of the respective mint (‘A’, ‘D’, ‘F’, ‘G’ or ‘J’), the year, ‘2020’ (centre left), Germany’s issuing country code, ‘D’ (bottom right), and the lettering ‘50 JAHRE KNIEFALL VON WARSCHAU’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 这枚硬币的设计展现了时任德国总理勃兰特在华沙犹太区英雄纪念碑前跪地致敬的场景。其强烈的视觉冲击力唤起了人们对1943年华沙犹太区起义的记忆。图案采用极其精细的浮雕工艺，描绘了引人注目的象征符号：七枝烛台、犹太区受害者以及跪拜的姿势。硬币内圈还刻有艺术家姓名首字母（顶部）、造币厂标记（“A”、“D”、“F”、“G”或“J”）、年份“2020”（左侧中部）、德国发行国代码“D”（右下角）以及“华沙犹太区起义五十周年纪念”（50 JAHRE KNIEFALL VON WARSCHAU）字样。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟旗帜的十二颗星。

title: Medical Research
description_en: The design shows the figuration of the human in union, represented by a face inscribed in a sphere. It faces the infinitely small, represented by fragments of DNA inscribed in a circle. By its oblique axis, this allegory represents the research and its intelligence dominating the infinitely small, studying it and triumphing over the diseases. The indication of the issuing country ‘RF’ is located at the top right while the mintmark and the year of issuance ‘2020’ are located at the bottom left. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计展现了人类与自然和谐共处的形象，以球体中内嵌的人脸为代表。它面向无限微小的事物，以圆形内嵌的DNA片段为代表。通过其倾斜的轴线，这一寓言象征着研究及其智慧凌驾于无限微小之上，对其进行探索并最终战胜疾病。发行国“RF”位于右上角，而造币厂标记和发行年份“2020”则位于左下角。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: 500th Anniversary of the death of Raphael Sanzio
description_en: The design features a portrait of Raphael and two angels. At the right, in semi-circle, is the inscription ‘RAFFAELLO SANZIO’. Above the image of the two angels are the years ‘1520’ and ‘2020’ and underneath it is the name of the issuing country ‘CITTA’ DEL VATICANO’. At the bottom is the mintmark ‘R’ and the artist’s name ‘D. LONGO’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计以拉斐尔的肖像和两位天使为特色。右侧半圆形区域内刻有“RAFFAELLO SANZIO”字样。两位天使图像上方是年份“1520”和“2020”，下方是发行国名称“CITTA DEL VATICANO”。底部是造币厂标记“R”和艺术家姓名“D. LONGO”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: 250th anniversary of the death of Giambattista Tiepolo
description_en: The left part of the coin features the bust of an angel, a detail from Tiepolo’s painting ‘Angel Succouring Hagar’, which hangs in the Scuola Grande di San Rocco, Venice, and the initials of the designer Claudia Momoni ‘C.M.’. Above is the inscription ‘TIEPOLO’ and the letter ‘R’ identifying the Mint of Rome; on the right are the dates 1770 and 2020 and the inscription ‘San Marino’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 硬币左侧图案为天使半身像，取材自提埃波罗的画作《天使救助夏甲》（现藏于威尼斯圣罗科大会堂），以及设计师克劳迪娅·莫莫尼的姓名首字母“C.M.”，上方刻有“TIEPOLO”字样和代表罗马造币厂的字母“R”；右侧刻有1770年和2020年的年份以及“圣马力诺”字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Universities and society – University of Turku 100 years
description_en: The grid-like design represents the interaction between universities and the society. At the top of the design, there is the year of issuance ‘2020’, at the right side the mintmark and underneath the mintmark is the indication of the issuing country ‘FI’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 网格状设计象征着大学与社会之间的互动。设计顶部为发行年份“2020”，右侧为造币厂标记，标记下方为发行国“FI”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: 50 years of Universal Female Suffrage
description_en: The design of the coin shows a female face inside a wrapper of endless moving lines. These lines are formed by female names in Catalan language close together, making it difficult to read them individually, as a tribute to solidarity of women in the fight for their rights. The inscriptions ‘50 ANYS DEL SUFRAGI UNIVERSAL FEMENÍ’ (50 years of Universal Female Suffrage) and ‘ANDORRA 1970 - 2020’ complete the design. These inscriptions are also incorporated into the movement of the lines in a way, in order to give more importance to the anniversary that is being commemorated. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 这枚硬币的设计展现了一张女性面孔，周围环绕着无穷无尽的动态线条。这些线条由紧密排列的加泰罗尼亚语女性名字组成，难以单独辨认，以此致敬女性在争取自身权利的斗争中所展现的团结精神。硬币上还镌刻着“50 ANYS DEL SUFRAGI UNIVERSAL FEMENÍ”（女性普选50周年）和“ANDORRA 1970 - 2020”的字样。这些铭文也巧妙地融入到线条的动态之中，进一步凸显了此次纪念活动的意义。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: The 500th anniversary of the birth of Adam Bohorič
description_en: The design has at its core a multilingual slogan from the cover of Bohorič’s Latin – Slovenian grammar titled “Proste zimske urice”. The slogan in Slovenian, written in bohoričica (the type of writing named after Adam Bohorič), which is easily recognizable due to the use of a typical letter f, is positioned in the lower half of the coin’s core. Behind is the Slovenian slogan in Latin – presenting Bohorič’s contribution to the international academic sphere. At the top of the design, in semi-circle, is the inscription ‘ADAM BOHORIČ1520 / SLOVENIJA 2020’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计的核心是博霍里奇拉丁语-斯洛文尼亚语语法书封面上的多语种标语“Proste zimske urice”。标语以斯洛文尼亚语书写，采用博霍里奇体（bohoričica，一种以亚当·博霍里奇命名的字体），这种字体因其独特的字母“f”而易于识别，标语位于硬币核心的下半部分。其后是拉丁语的斯洛文尼亚语标语，展现了博霍里奇对国际学术界的贡献。设计顶部呈半圆形，镌刻着“ADAM BOHORIČ1520 / SLOVENIJA 2020”字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Latgalian ceramics
description_en: The coin is dedicated to the Latgalian pottery. The traditional pottery established itself for substantial periods of time in two districts, Latgale and Kurzeme, but only in Latgale it has survived throughout the times and passed over to the next generations. The Latgalian pottery is included also in the Latvian Culture Canon. The design depicts a characteristic piece of Latgalian ceramics – a clay candelabrum. It bears an inscription ‘LATGALES KERAMIKA’ (Latgalian ceramics), the country name ‘LATVIJA’ as well as the year of issuance ‘2020’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 这枚硬币旨在纪念拉特加利亚陶器。这种传统陶器曾在拉特加莱和库尔泽梅两个地区长期发展，但只有拉特加莱的陶器得以保存至今，并代代相传。拉特加利亚陶器也被列入拉脱维亚文化名录。硬币图案描绘了一件典型的拉特加利亚陶瓷——陶土烛台。上面刻有“LATGALES KERAMIKA”（拉特加利亚陶瓷）字样、国名“LATVIJA”（拉脱维亚）以及发行年份“2020”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: Charles de Gaulle
description_en: The design represents two profiles of Charles de Gaulle at two different times. The profile in the background shows Charles de Gaulle in army general is uniform during the call to arms of the 18th June 1940 or during the liberation of Paris. The profile in the foreground represents Charles de Gaulle during his second presidential term of office. Finally, the mention RF is semi-integrated in a Lorraine cross, symbol of free France chosen by General de Gaulle in 1940. His dates of birth and death as well as the year date are also inscribed in the Lorraine cross. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计展现了戴高乐将军在不同时期的两张侧面像。背景中的侧面像描绘了戴高乐身着陆军将领制服，在1940年6月18日号召民众拿起武器或参与解放巴黎的场景。前景中的侧面像则展现了戴高乐在其第二个总统任期内的风采。此外，法国国旗（RF）的字样半融入洛林十字之中，洛林十字是戴高乐将军于1940年选定的自由法国的象征。戴高乐将军的出生日期、逝世日期以及发行年份也镌刻在洛林十字之中。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: The 27th Ibero-American Summit in Andorra
description_en: The 27th Ibero-American Summit of Heads of State and Government will be held in the Principality of Andorra in 2020. Andorra, the newest and smallest member of the Ibero-American Conference, will host this meeting of the highest political level, which comprises 19 Latin American countries together with Spain, Portugal and Andorra, in order to work towards common goals such as Sustainable Development. The design of the coin shows a tree made up by human silhouettes and tine wheels. The human silhouettes symbolize the integration of society, culture and education for the realization of a sustainable future. The tine wheels symbolize the synergy of movement between the ideas and proposals of participants to this Summit. Next to the tree, there is the logo of this 27th Summit. On its upper side, three triangles represent the colours of the Andorran flag. On its lower side, six triangles represent Andorra’s opening towards Sustainable Development Goals. Around the design, there is the inscription ‘XXVII CIMERA IBEROAMERICANA ANDORRA 2020’ (27th Ibero-American Summit Andorra 2020). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 第27届伊比利亚美洲国家元首和政府首脑峰会将于2020年在安道尔公国举行。安道尔是伊比利亚美洲会议最新也是最小的成员国，将主办此次最高级别的政治会议。此次峰会由19个拉丁美洲国家以及西班牙、葡萄牙和安道尔共同举办，旨在为实现可持续发展等共同目标而努力。纪念币的设计图案为一棵由人形轮廓和齿状齿轮组成的树。人形轮廓象征着社会、文化和教育的融合，以实现可持续的未来。齿状齿轮象征着与会者在本次峰会上提出的各种理念和建议之间的协同作用。树旁是第27届峰会的会徽。会徽上方的三个三角形代表安道尔国旗的颜色。下方的六个三角形代表安道尔对可持续发展目标的开放态度。图案周围刻有“XXVII CIMERA IBEROAMERICANA ANDORRA 2020”（2020年第27届伊比利亚美洲峰会，安道尔）字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: The 300th anniversary of the birth of Prince Honoré III
description_en: The design shows the effigy of Prince Honoré III. At the left is the inscription ‘HONORÉ III’ and at the right the name of the issuing country ‘MONACO’. At the bottom, in semi-circle, is the inscription ‘1720 – Naissance – 2020’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计展现了奥诺雷三世亲王的肖像。左侧是“HONORÉ III”字样，右侧是发行国“MONACO”的名称。底部半圆形区域刻有“1720 – Naissance – 2020”字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: 150th anniversary of the birth of Maria Montessori
description_en: A portrait of Maria Montessori in a geometric composition with some of didactic elements drawn from her educational system. In the right field, ‘RI’, acronym of the Italian Republic; on the left, ‘R’ ,identifying the Mint of Rome; on the right, ‘LDS’, initials of the designer Luciana De Simoni; at the top and bottom, the dates ‘1870’ e ‘2020’, the year of birth of the Italian pedagogue and that of coin’s issue, respectively; around the portrait, the inscription ‘MARIA MONTESSORI’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 这枚硬币以几何图案构图呈现玛丽亚·蒙特梭利的肖像，并融入了她教育体系中的一些教学元素。右侧为“RI”，代表意大利共和国；左侧为“R”，代表罗马造币厂；右侧为“LDS”，是设计师卢西亚娜·德·西蒙尼的姓名首字母；顶部和底部分别标有“1870”和“2020”，分别代表这位意大利教育家的出生年份和硬币发行年份；肖像周围环绕着“MARIA MONTESSORI”字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: 100 years since the union of Thrace with Greece
description_en: The design replicates an ancient coin of the Thracian city of Abdera, featuring a griffin. Inscribed along the inner edge are the words ‘100 YEARS SINCE THE UNION OF THRACE WITH GREECE’ and ‘HELLENIC REPUBLIC’, as well as the year of issuance ‘2020’ and a palmette (the mintmark of the Greek mint). Also visible at left is the monogram of the artist (George Stamatopoulos). The region of Thrace, located in the northeastern corner of the country, was united with Greece after the end of World War I. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计复刻了色雷斯城邦阿布德拉的一枚古币，币面上绘有狮鹫图案。内缘镌刻有“色雷斯与希腊合并一百周年”、“希腊共和国”字样，以及发行年份“2020”和棕榈叶纹（希腊造币厂的标记）。左侧还可见艺术家（乔治·斯塔马托普洛斯）的姓名首字母缩写。色雷斯地区位于希腊东北角，一战结束后并入希腊。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: Jan van Eyck
description_en: The inner part of the piece depicts the portrait of the famous Flemish artist Jan van Eyck, together with his signature and a painter’s palette that also contains the initials LL, referring to the designer of the coin, Mr Luc Luycx and two paintbrushes. Above this, you can find the name J. van Eyck. As the Royal Dutch Mint will strike the coins, the mintmark of Utrecht, a mercury staff is located on the bottom together with the Belgian mint director mintmark, the coat of arms of the municipality Herzele. The country code BE and the year mark 2020 is located on the right. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 硬币内圈描绘了著名佛兰德斯艺术家扬·凡·艾克（Jan van Eyck）的肖像，以及他的签名和调色板图案。调色板上还印有字母“LL”，代表硬币的设计者卢克·吕克斯（Luc Luycx）先生，旁边还有两支画笔。上方是扬·凡·艾克的名字。由于这枚硬币由荷兰皇家造币厂铸造，因此底部印有乌得勒支造币厂的标志——水银杖，以及比利时造币厂的标志——赫泽勒市的市徽。国家代码“BE”和年份“2020”位于右侧。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: 75th anniversary of the United Nations
description_en: The design depicts the UN logo. At the top is the year of issuance ‘2020’, the name of the issuing country ‘PORTUGAL’ and the inscription ‘UN 75 YEARS’. Under the words ‘UN’ and ‘YEARS’ is their translation in Portuguese ‘ONU’ and ‘ANOS’. At the left side is the name of the mint ‘CASA DA MOEDA’ and at the right side is the engraver’s name ‘ANDRÉ LETRIA’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计图案为联合国徽标。顶部为发行年份“2020”、发行国“葡萄牙”以及“联合国成立75周年”字样。“联合国”和“周年”下方分别标注了葡萄牙语翻译“ONU”和“ANOS”。左侧为造币厂名称“CASA DA MOEDA”，右侧为雕刻师姓名“ANDRÉ LETRIA”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Unesco World Heritage Site – pre-historic temples of Skorba
description_en: The design features Skorba, a prehistoric temple located near the hamlet of Zebbiegh, in the northwest of Malta. The complex consists of two temples built side by side. These were built on a much older settlement remains of which were discovered outside the temple complex. Skorba lacks the monumentality of the other temples on the Maltese islands. Nevertheless, the site is of utmost importance having enabled archaeologists to set Malta’s prehistoric cultural sequence and establish that the islands were first inhabited at around 5 000 BC. The inscription ‘SKORBA TEMPLES 3600-2500 BC’ appears at the top of the design. At the bottom are the name of the issuing country ‘MALTA’ and the year of issuance ‘2020’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计以斯科巴神庙为主题，这是一座位于马耳他西北部泽比格村附近的史前神庙。该建筑群由两座并排建造的神庙组成。它们建于一个更为古老的聚落遗址之上，该遗址在神庙建筑群外被发现。斯科巴神庙不像马耳他群岛上的其他神庙那样宏伟壮观。然而，该遗址极其重要，它使考古学家能够确定马耳他的史前文化序列，并确定这些岛屿最早有人居住的时间约为公元前5000年。硬币顶部刻有“斯科巴神庙 公元前3600-2500年”字样。底部是发行国“马耳他”和发行年份“2020”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: 100th Anniversary of the Birth of Pope John Paul II
description_en: The design features Pope John Paul II, the home where He was born and the Basilica near His home in Wadowice, Poland. At the top left, in semi-circle is the inscription ‘PAPA GIOVANNI PAOLO II’. At the right are the years ‘1920 2020’, and the mintmark ‘R’. At the bottom, in semi-circle, is the name of the issuing country ‘CITTA’ DEL VATICANO’. Under the image of the Basilica are the artist’s name ‘G. TITOTTO’ and the engraver’s initials ‘M.A.C. INC’ (Maria Angela Cassol, engraver). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计以教宗若望保禄二世的肖像、他的出生地以及位于波兰瓦多维采的故居附近的圣殿为主题。左上角半圆形区域内刻有“PAPA GIOVANNI PAOLO II”（教宗若望保禄二世）字样。右侧为年份“1920-2020”以及造币厂标记“R”。底部半圆形区域内刻有发行国名称“CITTA DEL VATICANO”（梵蒂冈城）。圣殿图案下方是艺术家姓名“G. TITOTTO”和雕刻师姓名缩写“M.A.C. INC”（雕刻师：Maria Angela Cassol）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: 500th anniversary of the death of Raphael
description_en: The design reproduces the profile of the Virgin Mary, which is part of the Madonna di Casa Santi fresco, the first masterpiece by a very young Raphael painted in the family home in Urbino, which now houses the prestigious Accademia Raffaello. The fresco depicts the Virgin Mary holding the infant Jesus on her lap and is imbued with the delicacy of the intimacy between mother and son, a recurring theme in Raphael’s artistic works. In the top right of the coin, there is the name of the issuing country ‘SAN MARINO’ and the years ‘1520’ and ‘2020’. At the bottom is the inscription ‘RAFFAELLO’, on the right the initials of the designer Annalisa Masini ‘AM’, and on the left the letter ‘R’, indicating the Mint of Rome. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计再现了圣母玛利亚的侧面像，这幅侧面像出自《圣家圣母》（Madonna di Casa Santi）壁画，是年轻的拉斐尔在其位于乌尔比诺的家中创作的第一幅杰作，如今这里已成为著名的拉斐尔学院。壁画描绘了圣母玛利亚怀抱婴孩耶稣的场景，充满了母子间细腻的情感，这也是拉斐尔艺术作品中反复出现的主题。硬币右上角刻有发行国“圣马力诺”（SAN MARINO）以及年份“1520”和“2020”。底部刻有“拉斐尔”（RAFFAELLO）字样，右侧是设计师安娜丽莎·马西尼（Annalisa Masini）的姓名首字母“AM”，左侧是字母“R”，代表罗马造币厂。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Aukštaitija (from the series Lithuanian Etnographic Regions)
description_en: The design features a coat of arms with an armour-clad knight holding a sword in his right hand. The coat of arms is held by two angels, simbolically exalting and protecting Aukštaitija – one of the most important regions of Lithuania and the cradle of its statehood. Below is a Latin inscription PATRIAM TUAM MUNDUM EXISTIMA (CONSIDER YOUR HOMELAND TO BE THE WHOLE WORLD). The design is surrounded by inscriptions: ‘LIETUVA’ (the name of the issuing country), ‘AUKŠTAITIJA’, the year of issuance ‘2020’ and the mintmark of the Lithuanian Mint. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计以纹章为特色，纹章上是一位身披盔甲的骑士，右手持剑。纹章由两位天使托举，象征性地颂扬和守护着奥克什泰蒂亚——立陶宛最重要的地区之一，也是立陶宛建国的摇篮。纹章下方是拉丁文铭文“PATRIAM TUAM MUNDUM EXISTIMA”（将你的祖国视为整个世界）。图案周围环绕着“LIETUVA”（发行国名称）、“AUKŠTAITIJA”（奥克什泰蒂亚）、发行年份“2020”以及立陶宛造币厂的标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: The bicentenary of the discovery of Antarctica
description_en: The discovery is linked to Estonia because one of the first men to see Antarctica in 1820 was Fabian Gottlieb von Bellingshausen, a Baltic German seafarer born in Saaremaa, who documented the discovery. The design depicts a motif of a sailing ship. It also bear the inscriptions ‘Fabian Gottlieb von Bellingshausen’ and ‘ANTARKTIKA 200’, the country name ‘EESTI’ and the year of issuance ‘2020’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 这项发现与爱沙尼亚息息相关，因为1820年最早发现南极洲的人之一是法比安·戈特利布·冯·别林斯高晋，这位出生于萨雷马岛的波罗的海德裔航海家记录了这一发现。硬币的设计图案为一艘帆船，并刻有“法比安·戈特利布·冯·别林斯高晋”、“南极洲200”字样、国名“爱沙尼亚”以及发行年份“2020”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: UNESCO’s World Cultural and Natural Heritage Sites – Aragón and the Aragonese Mudejar architecture
description_en: The design shows the image of the tower of El Salvador de Teruel. On the left side in capital letters is the word ‘ESPAÑA’ and on the right side the mintmark and underneath it the year of issuance 2020. At the top in the central part, in a circular sense and in capital letters the legend ‘ARQUITECTURA MUDEJAR DE ARAGÓN’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计展现了特鲁埃尔萨尔瓦多塔的图案。左侧以大写字母书写着“ESPAÑA”（西班牙），右侧是造币厂标记，下方是发行年份2020。顶部中央以圆形大写字母镌刻着“ARQUITECTURA MUDEJAR DE ARAGÓN”（阿拉贡穆德哈尔建筑）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Brandenburg (the Bundesländer series)
description_en: The design shows the Sanssouci Palace. The upper half of the coin’s inner section includes the mint mark of the respective mint (‘A’, ‘D’, ‘F’, ‘G’ or ‘J’), the artist’s initials and the year ‘2020’. The lower half of the coin’s inner section contains the inscription ‘BRANDENBURG’ and Germany’s issuing country code ‘D’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计图案为无忧宫。硬币内圈上半部分包含相应造币厂的标记（“A”、“D”、“F”、“G”或“J”）、艺术家姓名首字母以及年份“2020”。硬币内圈下半部分刻有“勃兰登堡”字样和德国发行国代码“D”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: International Year of Plant Health 2020 (IYPH 2020)
description_en: The inner part of the piece depicts the official logo of the IYPH 2020 that symbolises leaves and the text ‘International year of plant health’. The leaves represent healthy plants as the source of the oxygen we breathe, the food we eat and all life on earth. This positive image of leaves protected from deadly pests and diseases forms a circle, which represents the world and underlines how plant health and protection is a global issue. Plant health is the key to ending hunger, reducing poverty, protecting the environment and boosting economic development. As the Royal Dutch Mint will strike the coins, the mintmark of Utrecht, a mercury staff is located on the right. The Belgian mint director mintmark, the coat of arms of the municipality Herzele is located on the left. The country code BE and the year mark 2020 are located on the bottom. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 硬币内圈图案为2020年国际植物健康年（IYPH 2020）的官方标志，象征着树叶，并印有“国际植物健康年”字样。树叶代表健康的植物，它们是我们呼吸的氧气、我们食用的食物以及地球上所有生命的源泉。这幅树叶免受致命病虫害侵袭的积极画面构成了一个圆圈，代表着世界，强调了植物健康和保护是一个全球性问题。植物健康是消除饥饿、减少贫困、保护环境和促进经济发展的关键。由于这枚硬币将由荷兰皇家造币厂铸造，因此乌得勒支的造币厂标记——一根水银柱——位于硬币右侧。比利时造币厂的厂标——赫泽勒市的市徽——位于硬币左侧。国家代码BE和年份2020位于硬币底部。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: The centenary of the Tartu Peace Treaty
description_en: The treaty was signed between Estonia and Soviet Russia on 2 February 1920, and it fixed the Eastern border of Estonia, bringing an end to the War of Independence. The design depicts a tree with branches disguising the words TARTU RAHU (Tartu Peace Treaty). It also bears the country name ‘EESTI’ and the date of issue ‘2 February 2020’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该条约于1920年2月2日由爱沙尼亚和苏俄签署，确定了爱沙尼亚的东部边界，结束了独立战争。硬币图案为一棵树，树枝间巧妙地隐藏着“TARTU RAHU”（塔尔图和约）字样。此外，硬币上还刻有国名“EESTI”和发行日期“2020年2月2日”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: The 80th Anniversary of Foundation of ‘Corpo Nazionale dei Vigili del Fuoco’ (National Fire Department)
description_en: The design shows, in the center, the logo of the National Fire Department. On the left, ‘RI’, acronym of the Italian Republic; on the right, the year of the coin’s issue ‘2020’; ‘R’, identifying the Mint of Rome; below, ‘LDS’, initials of the designer Luciana De Simoni; above, arch-shaped inscription ‘CORPO NAZIONALE DEI VIGILI DEL FUOCO’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计中心图案为国家消防局的标志。左侧为“RI”，即意大利共和国的缩写；右侧为硬币发行年份“2020”；“R”代表罗马造币厂；下方为设计师卢西亚娜·德·西蒙尼（Luciana De Simoni）的姓名首字母“LDS”；上方为弧形铭文“CORPO NAZIONALE DEI VIGILI DEL FUOCO”（意大利国家消防队）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: The 200th anniversary of the birth of Prince Henri
description_en: The design shows on the right hand the effigy of His Royal Highness, the Grand Duke Henri, and on the left hand the effigy of Prince Henri. At the bottom is the name of the issuing country ‘LUXEMBOURG’ and the year-date ‘2020’. At the left, in semi-circle form, is the inscription ‘Prince Henri d’Orange-Nassau’ and underneath his effigy is the inscription ‘1820 – 1879’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 硬币正面右侧为亨利大公殿下的肖像，左侧为亨利王子的肖像。底部为发行国“卢森堡”和年份“2020”。左侧半圆形区域刻有“奥兰治-拿骚的亨利王子”字样，其肖像下方刻有“1820-1879”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: 2 500 years since the Battle of Thermopylae
description_en: The design depicts an ancient Greek helmet. Inscribed along the inner edge are the words ‘2500 YEARS SINCE THE BATTLE OF THERMOPYLAE’ and ‘HELLENIC REPUBLIC’. Also inscribed in the background are the year of issuance ‘2020’ and a palmette (the mintmark of the Greek mint). Visible down and right of the helmet is the monogram of the artist (George Stamatopoulos). Although ending in defeat for the Greeks, the Battle of Thermopylae remains a timeless symbol of heroic resistance. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了一顶古希腊头盔。内缘镌刻着“温泉关战役2500周年”和“希腊共和国”字样。背景中还镌刻着发行年份“2020”和棕榈叶纹（希腊造币厂的标志）。头盔右下方可见艺术家（乔治·斯塔马托普洛斯）的姓名缩写。尽管希腊最终战败，温泉关战役仍是英勇抵抗的永恒象征。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: Taking care of our seniors
description_en: The subject of the coin ‘CUIDEM LA NOSTRA GENT GRAN’ (taking care of our seniors) is symbolized by the image of the hand of a young person holding another hand that shows all the signs of aging, with a stethoscope below them. The name of the issuing country ‘ANDORRA’ encircling several reproductions of the SARSCoV-2 virus represents the State’s commitment to preventing its spread and caring for its citizens. The design also shows the date of issue ‘2021’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 这枚名为“CUIDEM LA NOSTRA GENT GRAN”（关爱长者）的硬币，其图案为一只年轻人的手握着另一只饱经风霜的手，下方配有听诊器。发行国“安道尔”（ANDORRA）的名称环绕着多个SARS-CoV-2病毒图案，象征着安道尔致力于防止病毒传播并关爱其公民。硬币上还标有发行年份“2021”。外圈则饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: Our Lady of Meritxell
description_en: The foreground of the design depicts the reproduction of the Romanesque carving of Our Lady of Meritxell (patron saint of the Principality of Andorra), which dates back from the 11th and 12th centuries. The background of the design shows a partial reproduction of the basilica sanctuary where it is located, a graphic element symbolizing a flower, the name of the issuing country ‘ANDORRA’ and the years ‘1921-2021’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该硬币正面图案为罗马式风格的梅里切尔圣母像（安道尔公国的守护圣人），其历史可追溯至11至12世纪。背面图案为硬币所在圣殿的部分复制品、象征花朵的图形元素、发行国“安道尔”的名称以及年份“1921-2021”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: The 100th anniversary of the birth of Alexander Dubček
description_en: The design depicts a left-profile portrait of Alexander Dubček, a leading Slovak politician whose attempt to introduce liberal reforms in Czechoslovakia in 1968 became known as the Prague Spring. Inscribed along the left edge of the coin’s inner circle is the name of the issuing country ‘SLOVENSKO’. Overlying the lower part of the portrait is the name ‘Alexander Dubček’, first name above surname, and below it are the dates of his birth ‘1921’ and death ‘1992’, one above the other. At the right edge is the year of issuance ‘2021’, and below it is the mint mark of the Kremnica Mint (Mincovňa Kremnica), consisting of the letters ‘MK’ placed between two dies. Next to the bottom right edge are the stylised initials ‘BR’, referring to the national side’s designer Branislav Ronai. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该硬币的设计图案为斯洛伐克著名政治家亚历山大·杜布切克的左侧肖像，他于1968年在捷克斯洛伐克推行自由主义改革，史称“布拉格之春”。硬币内圈左侧刻有发行国“斯洛伐克”（SLOVENSKO）。肖像下方是“亚历山大·杜布切克”（Alexander Dubček）的名字，名字在上，姓氏在下，名字下方是他的出生年份“1921”和逝世年份“1992”，上下排列。右侧边缘是发行年份“2021”，下方是克雷姆尼察造币厂（Mincovňa Kremnica）的造币厂标记，由两个模具之间的字母“MK”组成。右下角边缘是风格化的首字母缩写“BR”，代表该硬币的设计者布拉尼斯拉夫·罗奈（Branislav Ronai）。硬币外圈印有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: The 100-year autonomy of Åland
description_en: The theme of the coin is the archipelago landscape composed of embossed forms. The lower half of the design has a seaway with nautical signs, the bow of a boat and a hand holding a compass. The horizontal midline of the design has a sea horizon. The upper half of the design has sky and clouds. At the bottom, in semi-circle, is the inscription ‘AUTONOMY OF THE ÅLAND ISLANDS FOR 100 YEARS’ in Finnish. At the top, in semi-circle, is the inscription ‘AUTONOMY OF THE ÅLAND ISLANDS FOR 100 YEARS’ in Swedish. At the centre there are two diamond shaped highlights between the texts, one at the left and the other at the right. Above the diamonds, at the right side is the inscription ‘2021 FI’ and at the left side the mintmark of the Mint of Finland. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 这枚硬币的主题是群岛景观，由浮雕图案构成。图案下半部分描绘了一条航海航道，上面有航海标志、船头和一只握着罗盘的手。图案的水平中线是海平面。图案上半部分是天空和云朵。底部半圆形区域内，用芬兰语镌刻着“奥兰群岛自治100周年”。顶部半圆形区域内，用瑞典语镌刻着“奥兰群岛自治100周年”。在文字之间，中心位置有两个菱形图案，分别位于左右两侧。菱形图案上方，右侧是“2021 FI”字样，左侧是芬兰造币厂的标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: The 500th anniversary of the appearance of the ordinance of the second period of coin issuance during the reign of Charles V
description_en: The national side of the coin depicts in the inner part of the piece the portrait of the Charles V, together with the text Carolus V. At the left you can find the 500 year old golden Carolus guilder, issued after the ordinance of the second period of coin issuance during the reign of Charles V. As the Royal Dutch Mint will strike the coins, the mintmark of Utrecht, a mercury staff is located on the bottom together with the Belgian mint director mintmark, the coat of arms of the municipality Herzele. It also contains the initials LL, referring to the designer of the coin, Mr. Luc Luycx. The country code BE and the year mark 2021 are located on the left. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 硬币正面内侧刻有查理五世的肖像，以及“Carolus V”字样。左侧是500年前的卡罗勒斯金币，该金币是根据查理五世统治时期第二阶段的铸币法令发行的。由于该硬币由荷兰皇家造币厂铸造，因此底部刻有乌得勒支造币厂的标记——水银杖，以及比利时造币厂的标记——赫泽勒市的市徽。此外，硬币上还刻有“LL”字样，代表硬币设计师卢克·吕克斯先生。国家代码“BE”和年份“2021”位于左侧。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: The Estonian national animal – the wolf
description_en: The design depicts the silhouette of the wolf and a forest. Close to the edge of the inner ring the country name ‘EESTI’ at the left, the year of issuance ‘2021’ at the right and the text ‘CANIS LUPUS’ (the wolf in Latin) at the top are depicted.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了狼和森林的轮廓。靠近内环边缘的左侧是国名“EESTI”，右侧是发行年份“2021”，顶部是拉丁文“CANIS LUPUS”（狼）。

title: Maltese prehistoric temples of Tarxien (of the series UNESCO World Heritage Site)
description_en: The design depicts a detail of the prehistoric structure. At the top is the inscription ‘TARXIEN TEMPLES 3600-2500 BC’. At the bottom is the name of the issuing country ‘MALTA’ and underneath it is the year of issuance ‘2021’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: The 700th anniversary of the death of Dante Alighieri
description_en: The design features a portrait of Dante and Palazzo Vecchio in Florence. At the top right, in semi-circle, is the name of the issuing country ‘CITTÀ DEL VATICANO’. At the bottom is the inscription ‘Dante’ and underneath are the years ‘1321-2021’ and the name of the artist ‘P. DANIELE’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该硬币的设计以但丁的肖像和佛罗伦萨的旧宫为特色。右上角半圆形区域内是发行国名称“梵蒂冈城”（CITTÀ DEL VATICANO）。底部是“但丁”字样，再往下是年份“1321-2021”和艺术家姓名“P. DANIELE”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: The 200th anniversary of the establishment of Provincial Museum for Carniola, the first museum in Slovenia
description_en: The design was inspired by the belts from Vače Situla – one of the finest artefacts of situla art. These belts are a graphical symbol for layering history that the museum keeps for future generations. The design displays layers of the museum’s history with different names through its 200-year long history. The names are displayed in belts as they would have been if written on Vače Situla. The design includes the name of the country ‘SLOVENIJA’ and the year of issuance ‘2021’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计灵感源自瓦切·西图拉（Vače Situla）的腰带——西图拉艺术的杰作之一。这些腰带象征着博物馆为后世保存的历史层叠。设计以腰带的形式展现了博物馆200年历史的不同阶段，每个阶段都包含不同的名称。这些名称如同瓦切·西图拉上的文字一般，被呈现在腰带上。设计中还包含了国家名称“斯洛文尼亚”（SLOVENIJA）和发行年份“2021”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Olympic Games Paris 2024
description_en: The design represents Marianne, national figure and icon of French numismatics, running in an ‘old’ way in reference to the Olympic Games of the Ancient Era. Its silhouette blends with the Eiffel Tower, a key element of Parisian heritage, to form a common axis with the Iron Lady. In the background, an athletics track in which the emblem of Paris 2024 is inserted on the left side, is depicted. The year date, the mention RF and the mintmarks are inserted under the arch of the tower. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了法国国家人物、钱币收藏界的标志性人物玛丽安娜，她以“古老”的姿态奔跑，象征着古代奥林匹克运动会。她的轮廓与巴黎的标志性建筑埃菲尔铁塔融为一体，共同构成一条轴线。背景中描绘了一条田径跑道，左侧镶嵌着巴黎2024奥运会的会徽。年份、RF字样和造币厂标记位于铁塔拱门下方。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Finno-Ugric peoples
description_en: The national side of the coin depicts a design based on the cave drawings of Lake Äänisjärv. The symbols for the hunter, the elk, the water bird and the sun form the symbolic circle of life for the Finno-Ugric peoples. The central figure is a water bird, as they are represented in the art and folklore of all Finno-Ugric peoples. On the top right, in semi-circle, are the name of the country ‘EESTI’ followed by the year ‘2021’. At the bottom left is the inscription ‘FENNOUGRIA’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 硬币正面图案取材于艾尼斯湖（Äänisjärv）的洞穴壁画。猎人、麋鹿、水鸟和太阳的象征符号构成了芬兰-乌戈尔语族生命轮回的象征。中心图案是一只水鸟，这在所有芬兰-乌戈尔语族的艺术和民间传说中都有体现。右上角呈半圆形排列着国名“EESTI”，其后是年份“2021”。左下角刻有“FENNOUGRIA”（芬兰-乌戈尔语）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: The 550th anniversary of the birth of Albrecht Dürer
description_en: The design depicts the Virgin Mary with Baby Jesus, detail of the painting ‘Madonna with Child’ by Albrecht Dürer, kept in the Uffizi Galleries (Florence). At the left is the inscription ‘SAN MARINO’ and the mintmark ‘R’. At the top right is the monogram ‘AD’ with the initials of Albrecht Dürer and at the right is the inscription ‘DÜRER’. At the bottom are the initials of the author Valerio De Seta, ‘VdS’, and the dates ‘1471-2021’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 这枚硬币的设计图案是圣母玛利亚怀抱圣婴耶稣，取材自阿尔布雷希特·丢勒的画作《圣母子像》（现藏于佛罗伦萨乌菲齐美术馆）。左侧刻有“SAN MARINO”（圣马力诺）字样和造币厂标记“R”。右上角是阿尔布雷希特·丢勒的姓名首字母缩写“AD”的缩写，右侧刻有“DÜRER”（丢勒）字样。底部是作者瓦莱里奥·德·塞塔的姓名首字母缩写“VdS”以及年份“1471-2021”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: 10th anniversary of the marriage of Prince Albert II and Princess Charlene
description_en: The design shows the profile portraits of Prince Albert II and Princess Charlene. At the top, the name of the issuing country ‘MONACO’ appears. At the bottom, appears in a semi-circle the inscription ‘2011 MARIAGE PRINCIER 2021’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 硬币正面图案为阿尔贝二世亲王和夏琳王妃的侧面肖像。顶部印有发行国“摩纳哥”字样。底部半圆形铭文为“2011 MARIAGE PRINCIER 2021”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Dzūkija (from the series ‘Lithuanian Ethnographic Regions’)
description_en: The design features a coat of arms with an armoured-clad soldier holding a halberd in his right hand and leaning with his left arm against a silver Baltic shield. The coat of arms placed on a beam is held by two lynxes. Below hangs a ribbon with a Latin inscription EX GENTE BELICOSISSIMA POPULUS LABORIOSUS (HARD-WORKING PEOPLE FROM A FIERCE TRIBE). The composition is surrounded by inscriptions LIETUVA (LITHUANIA) and DZŪKIJA, the year of issue (2021) and the mintmark of the Lithuanian Mint. The design is realised by Rolandas Rimkūnas. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计以盾徽为主体，图案中一位身着盔甲的士兵右手持戟，左臂倚靠在银色的波罗的海盾牌上。盾徽置于横梁之上，由两只猞猁托举。下方垂挂着一条绶带，上面刻有拉丁文铭文“EX GENTE BELICOSISSIMA POPULUS LABORIOSUS”（来自勇猛部落的勤劳人民）。图案周围环绕着“LIETUVA”（立陶宛）和“DZŪKIJA”（祖基亚）字样、发行年份（2021）以及立陶宛造币厂的标记。该设计由罗兰达斯·里姆库纳斯（Rolandas Rimkūnas）完成。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: The 450th anniversary of the birth of Caravaggio
description_en: The design features a boy with a basket of fruits, painted by Caravaggio. At the top, in semicircle, is the name of the issuing country ‘CITTA’ DEL VATICANO’. At the left is the mintmark ‘R’. At the bottom is the inscription ‘CARAVAGGIO’ and underneath are the years ‘1571-2021’. At the bottom right are the initials of the artist Chiara Principe, ‘CP’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 这枚硬币的设计图案是一位手提水果篮的男孩，由卡拉瓦乔绘制。顶部半圆形区域内是发行国名称“梵蒂冈城”（CITTA DEL VATICANO）。左侧是造币厂标记“R”。底部刻有“CARAVAGGIO”字样，下方是年份“1571-2021”。右下角是艺术家基娅拉·普林西佩（Chiara Principe）的姓名首字母“CP”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Heroes of the pandemic
description_en: The design is created by Maria Anna Frisone and depicts two medical professional bracing themselves up to face the unknown. It is meant to extoll the services of these selfless individuals who have been on the forefront of the fight against the COVID-19 pandemic. At the top, in semi-circle, is the inscription ‘HEROES OF THE PANDEMIC’. At the bottom, in semi-circle, is the inscription ‘MALTA – 2021’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 这枚硬币由玛丽亚·安娜·弗里索内设计，描绘了两位医护人员挺身而出，准备迎接未知挑战的场景。其旨在颂扬这些奋战在抗击新冠疫情一线的无私奉献者。硬币顶部半圆形铭文为“抗疫英雄”（HEROES OF THE PANDEMIC），底部半圆形铭文为“马耳他 – 2021”（MALTA – 2021）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: The 100th anniversary of the constitution of the Belgium-Luxembourg Economic Union (BLEU)
description_en: The national side of the coin features the effigy of the Belgian King Philip I and that of Grand Duke Henri of Luxembourg. In addition, both countries are depicted, with the mention of the Economic Union, and the years 1921 and 2021. As the Royal Dutch Mint will strike the coins, the mintmark of Utrecht, a mercury staff is located on the bottom together with the Belgian mint director mintmark, the coat of arms of the municipality Herzele. It also contains the initials LL, referring to the designer of the coin, Mr. Luc Luycx. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 硬币正面正面是比利时国王菲利普一世和卢森堡大公亨利的肖像。此外，硬币上还描绘了比利时和卢森堡两国，并提及了经济联盟以及1921年和2021年。由于硬币由荷兰皇家造币厂铸造，因此底部刻有乌得勒支造币厂的标记——水银杖，以及比利时造币厂的标记——赫泽勒市的市徽。硬币上还刻有“LL”字样，代表硬币设计师卢克·吕克斯先生。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: Portugal’s participation in the 2020 Tokyo Olympics
description_en: A stylised representation from the author of the symbol of the National Olympic Committee of Portugal, surrounded by the words ‘Portugal nos Jogos Olímpicos de Tóquio’20 2021’
description_zh: 葡萄牙国家奥委会标志作者的风格化表达，周围写着“Portugal nos Jogos Olímpicos de Tóquio”20 2021”

title: Journalism and Open Communication Supporting the Finnish Democracy
description_en: The figures depicted in the inner part of the coin can be interpreted as stylized human figures made up from and entwined in a ribbon-like net. The outer sides of the inner part of the coin bear the lettering ‘JOURNALISMI JOURNALISTIK’. The bottom of the inner part bears the lettering ‘2021 FI’ preceded by the Finnish mint mark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 硬币内圈图案可解读为由丝带状网状物缠绕而成的程式化人形。内圈外侧刻有“JOURNALISMI JOURNALISTIK”（新闻工作者）字样。内圈底部刻有“2021 FI”字样，其前为芬兰造币厂标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: UNESCO’s Man and the Biosphere Programme - Žuvintas Biosphere Reserve
description_en: The design depicts the characteristic surroundings of Žuvintas Biosphere Reserve, which belongs to the World Network of Biosphere Reserves of UNESCO’s Man and the Biosphere Programme: remote islands of a unique bird lake and Lithuania’s largest wetland as well as its distinctive animals. In the foreground there is a great bittern reaching for a fire-bellied toad floating in the water. In rushes depicted on the right there is an aquatic warbler, above – a flock of common cranes and a mute swan, symbolising the establishment of the Reserve. The design is surrounded by inscriptions LIETUVA (LITHUANIA), ŽUVINTAS, UNESCO, the year of issue (2021) and the mintmark of the Lithuanian Mint. The design is realised by Eglė Ratkutė and Ernestas Žemaitis. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了祖文塔斯生物圈保护区的典型环境，该保护区隶属于联合国教科文组织“人与生物圈计划”的世界生物圈保护区网络。设计展现了独特的鸟类湖泊、立陶宛最大的湿地及其特有的动物，以及一些偏远岛屿。前景中，一只大麻鹬正伸手去抓水中漂浮的火腹蟾蜍。右侧的芦苇丛中栖息着一只水莺，上方则是一群普通鹤和一只疣鼻天鹅，象征着保护区的建立。设计周围环绕着“LIETUVA”（立陶宛）、“ŽUVINTAS”（祖文塔斯）、“UNESCO”（联合国教科文组织）、发行年份（2021）以及立陶宛造币厂的标记。该设计由埃格莱·拉特库特和埃内斯塔斯·泽迈蒂斯共同完成。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: 200 years since the Greek Revolution
description_en: The design features the Greek flag at the centre, encircled by laurel branches. Inscribed along the inner edge are the wordings ‘1821 – 2021 200 YEARS SINCE THE GREEK REVOLUTION’ and ‘HELLENIC REPUBLIC’. Visible, at the bottom, between two laurel branches, are a palmette (the minmark of the Greek Mint) and the signature of the artist (George Stamatopoulos). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该硬币中央为希腊国旗，周围环绕着月桂枝。内缘镌刻着“1821-2021 希腊革命200周年”和“希腊共和国”字样。底部两枝月桂枝之间可见棕榈叶纹（希腊造币厂的标志）和艺术家（乔治·斯塔马托普洛斯）的签名。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: The 100th anniversary of Latvia’s international recognition de iure
description_en: It was on 26 January 1921 when Latvian diplomats had succeeded in accomplishing a momentous task – the world’s great powers recognized Latvia de iure. Although Latvia declared its independence on 18 November 1918, only after a confused period of fighting, the new nation was recognized in 1920. The design depicts an artistic inscription ‘100 Latvija de iure 2021’ thus also featuring the country name (LATVIJA) as well as the year of issue (2021). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 1921年1月26日，拉脱维亚外交官完成了一项意义重大的任务——世界列强正式承认拉脱维亚的法律地位。尽管拉脱维亚早在1918年11月18日就宣布独立，但直到1920年，这个新生国家才在经历了一段混乱的战乱时期后获得官方承认。这枚硬币的设计以艺术化的铭文“100 Latvija de iure 2021”呈现，同时包含了国名（拉脱维亚）和发行年份（2021）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: The 450th anniversary of the birth of Caravaggio
description_en: The design depicts the penitent Magdalene, detail of the homonymous work by Caravaggio, kept at the Doria Pamphilj Gallery in Rome. At the top left is the inscription ‘SAN MARINO’, and underneath are the dates ‘1571-2021’. At the left are the initials of the author Silvia Petrassi, ‘SP’. At the top right are the inscription ‘CARAVAGGIO’ and the mintmark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 这枚硬币的设计描绘了忏悔的抹大拉的玛利亚，取材于卡拉瓦乔的同名画作，该画作现藏于罗马的多利亚·潘菲利美术馆。左上方刻有“SAN MARINO”（圣马力诺）字样，下方是“1571-2021”的年份。左侧是作者西尔维娅·佩特拉西的姓名首字母“SP”。右上角刻有“CARAVAGGIO”（卡拉瓦乔）字样和造币厂标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: UNICEF
description_en: The design shows an allegory of the work of ‘UNICEF’ where the hands are a key element. One after the other they support the globe and are the link between the different areas of the Earth. The mention of the 75th anniversary as well as the laurels crown the ensemble accompanied by the acronym RF. On the upper rim, the name ‘UNICEF’ is inserted along with the relevant dates as well as the UNICEF motto ‘For each child’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计以寓言的形式展现了“联合国儿童基金会”的工作，其中双手是关键元素。它们依次支撑着地球，象征着连接地球各个区域。75周年纪念字样和月桂花环为整个图案锦上添花，旁边还有联合国儿童基金会的缩写“RF”。硬币上缘刻有“UNICEF”字样、相关日期以及联合国儿童基金会的格言“为了每一个孩子”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: UNESCO - Toledo
description_en: The design depicts a view of the Puerta de Sol and a detail of the ‘La Sinagoga del Tránsito’, both buildings built in the fourteenth century in Mudejar style. On the left hand and in capital letters the word ‘ESPAÑA’ and the year of minting ‘2021’. At the top on the right hand the mintmark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了太阳门广场（Puerta de Sol）和“拉桑戈加德尔特兰西托”（La Sinagoga del Tránsito）的细节，这两座建筑均建于十四世纪，采用穆德哈尔风格。左侧以大写字母标有“ESPAÑA”（西班牙）字样和铸造年份“2021”。右上角是造币厂标记。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的十二颗星。

title: The 40th anniversary of the marriage of Grand Duke Henri
description_en: The design depicts the effigies of the Grand Duke Henri and the Grand Duchess Maria Teresa. Below the effigies, two wedding rings are preceded by the wedding date ‘14. FEBRUAR 1981’ and followed by the year-date ‘2021’. The word ‘LETZEBUERG’ designating the issuing country is depicted below. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了亨利大公和玛丽亚·特蕾莎大公夫人的肖像。肖像下方是两枚结婚戒指，戒指前是结婚日期“1981年2月14日”，后是年份“2021”。下方是发行国“莱茨堡”（LETZEBUERG）的字样。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Bundesländer series – Saxony-Anhalt
description_en: The design shows the Magdeburg Cathedral, the first Gothic-style cathedral to be constructed on German soil. The inner part also features the name ‘SACHSEN-ANHALT’ and the issuing country’s country code ‘D’ at the bottom, the mint mark of the respective mint (‘A’, ‘D’, ‘F’, ‘G’ or ‘J’) as well as the the year ‘2021’ on the left and the engraver’s mark on the right. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 硬币图案为马格德堡大教堂，这是德国境内建造的第一座哥特式大教堂。内圈底部刻有“萨克森-安哈尔特”字样和发行国国家代码“D”，左侧为相应造币厂的标记（“A”、“D”、“F”、“G”或“J”）以及年份“2021”，右侧为雕刻师标记。硬币外圈环绕着欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: 150th Anniversary of the institution of Rome Capital of Italy
description_en: The design depicts a detail of the Dea Roma, a sculpture by Angelo Zanelli inserted in the center of the Altare della Patria, a large votive altar dedicated to the Italian nation set in the Vittoriano complex in Rome. Above, the legend ‘ROMA CAPITALE’; on the right, the dates ‘•1871•2021•’, the year of the proclamation of Rome as the Capital of Italy and that of the coin’s issue respectively; on the left, ‘RI’, acronym of the Italian Republic, and ‘R’, identifying the Mint of Rome; in exergue, ‘UP’, initials of the designer Uliana Pernazza. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了罗马女神像（Dea Roma）的局部细节，这尊由安杰洛·扎内利（Angelo Zanelli）创作的雕塑镶嵌在罗马维托里亚诺纪念堂（Vittoriano Complex）内的祖国祭坛（Altare della Patria）中央，这是一座献给意大利的大型还愿祭坛。上方是“罗马首都”（ROMA CAPITALE）字样；右侧是“•1871•2021•”字样，分别代表罗马被宣布为意大利首都的年份和该硬币的发行年份；左侧是“RI”，即意大利共和国的缩写，以及代表罗马造币厂的“R”；下方是“UP”，即设计师乌利亚娜·佩尔纳扎（Uliana Pernazza）的姓名首字母缩写。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Healthcare professionals
description_en: The design depicts in the centre, a man and a woman in medical clothing with masks, a stethoscope and a medical folder representing doctors and nurses working on the front line in the fight against COVID-19. Above, the word ‘GRAZIE’ followed, on the right, by a heart symbol; on the left, a reproduction of the medical cross; in the centre, ‘RI’, acronym of the Italian Republic; on the right, ‘R’, identifying the Mint of Rome; below, on the left, ‘CM’, initials of the designer Claudia Momoni; in exergue, the year of the coin’s issue ‘2021’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计中心图案为一男一女，身着医护服，佩戴口罩，手持听诊器和医疗文件夹，象征奋战在抗击新冠肺炎疫情一线的医护人员。上方为“GRAZIE”（感谢）字样，右侧为心形图案；左侧为医疗十字架图案；中心为“RI”，即意大利共和国的缩写；右侧为“R”，代表罗马造币厂；下方左侧为“CM”，即设计师克劳迪娅·莫莫尼（Claudia Momoni）的姓名首字母；下方为发行年份“2021”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: The 100th anniversary of the Grand Duke Jean
description_en: The design depicts on the left hand side the effigy of the Grand Duke Jean and on the right hand side the effigy of the Grand Duke Henri. Close to each effigy, the respective name of the Grand Duke is specified, as well as the year of birth ‘1921’ of the Grand Duke Jean. Below the effigies, an outline of Luxembourg city is represented. At the left, the text ‘GROUSSHERZOGE VU LËTZEBUERG’ designating also the issuing country is depicted in circular form. The year-date ‘2021’ is shown at the bottom right. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计左侧为让大公的肖像，右侧为亨利大公的肖像。每位大公的肖像旁都标明了他们的名字，以及让大公的出生年份“1921”。肖像下方是卢森堡市的轮廓。左侧以圆形图案呈现“GROUSSHERZOGE VU LËTZEBUERG”（卢森堡大公）字样，同时标明发行国。右下角标有年份“2021”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Portuguese Presidency of the Council of the European Union
description_en: The design depicts the representation of the link between the capital of Portugal and the others European capitals and thereby draw a map, within the lettering ‘PRESIDÊNCIA DO CONSELHO DA UNIÃO EUROPEIA PORTUGAL 2021’ (English – PRESIDENCY OF THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION PORTUGAL 2021). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了葡萄牙首都与其他欧洲国家首都之间的联系，从而在“PRESIDÊNCIA DO CONSELHO DA UNIÃO EUROPEIA PORTUGAL 2021”（英文 – PRESIDENCY OF THE COOCCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION PORTUGAL 2021）字样内绘制了一幅地图。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: The legend of Charlemagne
description_en: Legend has it that Emperor Charlemagne was the founder of Andorra in the year 805 and that he granted its inhabitants their own legal status. The design of the coin represents this legend deeply rooted in the history and culture of Andorra and shows, in its background, a landscape with mountains and a river, representing the rich scenery of our country, with the name of the issuing country ‘ANDORRA’. The foreground of the design depicts a partial reproduction of the well-known portrait of Emperor Charlemagne by the artist Albrecht Dürer and the year of issue ‘2022’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: 10 years of the entry into force of the Monetary Agreement between Andorra and the European Union
description_en: The different shapes and sizes of the puzzle pieces depicted in the lower part of the design symbolize the Principality of Andorra and the countries belonging to the European Union. In the upper part of the design, the stars encircling the symbol of the common European currency represent that they are all part of the euro universe. Next to them, the name of the issuing country ‘ANDORRA’ and the years of the commemoration ‘2012’ and ‘2022’ are featured. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: Lithuanian Ethnographic Regions - Suvalkija
description_en: The design depicts a Taurus on the escutcheon, while the escutcheon is decorated on both sides with silver oak branches with acorns. The branches are joined at the bottom with a silver ribbon bearing the inscription ‘VIENYBĖ TEŽYDI’ (UNITY MAY BLOSSOM). Oak branches symbolize the rich history of the region that goes back to the pagan times of the Lithuanian state. In the past, Taurus was the most widespread animal in this region. The composition is surrounded by the inscription ‘LIETUVA’ (LITHUANIA) and the year of issuance ‘2022’ on the top, and the inscription ‘SUVALKIJA’ and the mintmark of the Lithuanian Mint at the bottom. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: Ukraine and Freedom
description_en: The design depicts the silhouette of a woman holding a bird in her hand, with an ear of wheat. At the top left is the text ‘SLAVA UKRAINI’. At the bottom left are the name of the issuing country ‘EESTI’ and the year of issuance ‘2022’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: Climate research in Finland
description_en: The theme of the coin is a stylized beard lichen, with its root like structure embossed in the centre of the inner part of the coin. The outer sides of the inner part of the coin bear the lettering ‘CLIMATE RESEARCH’ in Finnish on the left-hand side and ‘CLIMATE RESEARCH’ in Swedish on the right-hand side. The bottom of the inner part of the coin bears the lettering ‘2022 FI’. The top of the inner part of the coin bears the mintmark of the Mint of Finland. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: The 22nd anniversary of the United Nations Security Council Resolution 1325 on Women, Peace and Security
description_en: The design shows three female faces. From the top left to the bottom left are the inscriptions ‘WOMEN’, ‘PEACE’, ‘SECURITY’, the year of issuance ‘2022’ and the name of the issuing country ‘MALTA’. At the centre, underneath the faces, are the inscriptions ‘UNSCR’ and ‘1325’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: 530th anniversary of the disappearance of Piero della Francesca
description_en: In the centre is the profile of Federico da Montefeltro, detail of the painting ‘Diptych of the Dukes of Urbino’ by Piero della Francesca, kept in the Galleries of the Uffizi (Florence). At the left side in semi-circle is the inscription ‘SAN MARINO’. At the right side in semi-circle is the inscription ‘PIERO DELLA FRANCESCA’, the years 1492 e 2022, the letter R, identifying the Mint of Rome and the initials of author Claudia Momoni, ‘C.M.’ The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: Bicentenary of the death of Antonio Canova
description_en: The goddess Hebe is depicted in the centre of the inner ring, taken from the work of Antonio Canova, conserved at the Art gallery of the Civic Museum of San Domenico in Forlì. Around are the inscriptions ‘CANOVA’ and ‘SAN MARINO’. At the left is the year ‘1822’ and the initials of the author Antonio Vecchio, and at the right the year of issuance ‘2022’ and the letter R, identifying the Mint of Rome. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: The 300th anniversary of the construction of continental Europe’s first atmospheric steam engine for draining mines
description_en: The design depicts an atmospheric steam engine for draining water from mines, the one constructed in the mining town of Nová Baňa in 1722 as the first of its kind in continental Europe. It was designed and built by English engineer Isaac Potter, whose facsimile signature is inscribed sideways, on two lines, in the lower left part of the design. On the right side of the engine, again written sideways, are the name of the issuing country ‘SLOVENSKO’ and, to its right, the years ‘1722’ and ‘2022’ separated by a medial dot. Next to the left edge of the coin’s inner section, positioned one above the other, are the mint mark of the Kremnica Mint (Mincovňa Kremnica), consisting of the letters ‘MK’ placed between two dies, and the stylised initials of the national side designer, Peter Valach. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: 100th anniversary of the death of Prince Albert I
description_en: The design shows the portrait of Prince Albert I. At the left is the name of the issuing country ‘MONACO’ and at the right is the year of issuance ‘2022’. At the bottom is the inscription ALBERT Ier” followed by the years ‘1848-1922’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: Olympic Games 2024
description_en: One hundred years after the 1924 Olympic Games, France is once again hosting the Summer Games, which will take place in Paris in 2024, an event with international echo whose intensity gradually builds in the years leading up to the event. On the occasion of the countdown to the Olympic Games, Monnaie de Paris wishes to celebrate the road to the Games. It therefore plans to issue each year 2022, 2023 and 2024 a commemorative two-euro coin with an original face celebrating the Games, through the heritage of France and Paris. The design represents the genius, a national figure and icon of French numismatics. It is depicted practicing discus throwing in an ‘ancient’ way in reference to the Olympic Games of the Antique era. His silhouette blends with the one of the Arc de Triomphe, a key element of Parisian heritage. It forms a common axis with this emblematic monument of victory. In the background, an athletics track in which the emblem of Paris 2024 is inserted on the right side, is represented. The year date, the mention RF and the mintmarks are inserted under the arch and around the foot of the Arc. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: The 25th anniversary of the death of Mother Teresa of Calcutta
description_en: The design features a portrait of Mother Teresa with a child. At the top, in semi-circle, is the inscription ‘MADRE TERESA DI CALCUTTA’ and at the bottom is the name of the issuing country ‘CITTÀ DEL VATICANO’. At the right of the portrait is the mintmark ‘R’ and underneath it are the years ‘1997’ and ‘2022’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: 200 years from the first Greek Constitution
description_en: The design features the temple of Asclepius at Epidaurus with the statue of the god at centre. The theme replicates the reverse of a commemorative medal on the First National Assembly held by the revolted Greeks at Epidaurus, which was awarded to the Assembly members during the reign of king Otho. Inscribed along the inner edge is the wording ‘HELLENIC REPUBLIC’ and ‘THE FIRST GREEK CONSTITUTION’, as well as the years ‘1822’ and ‘2022’, a palmette (the mintmark of the Greek mint) and the monogram of the artist (George Stamatopoulos). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: 35 years of the Erasmus programme
description_en: The design is a mix of two major elements of the Erasmus programme: the original intellectual inspiration, Erasmus himself, and the allegory of its influence over Europe. The first one is symbolised by one of the most known depiction of Erasmus. The second one is symbolised by a beam of links going across the coin from a beacon to another, representing the numerous intellectual and human exchanges between the European students. As a reference to Europe, some of these links form other stars, born from the synergy between the countries. The figure 35, for 35th anniversary comes out from the stars in a contemporary graphical style. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: 100 years of basketball in Lithuania
description_en: The design shows the contour of the map of Lithuania arranged as a basketball court in the centre, which signifies that basketball has been played in Lithuania already for 100 years. The coin also features the inscriptions ‘LIETUVA’ (Lithuania), ‘1922-2022’ and the logo of the Lithuanian mint, its manufacturer, arranged in a semi-circle around the centre. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: 100 years of Finland's National Ballet
description_en: The design depicts the powerful and free movements of a dancer covered in a light flowing textile that accentuates the beauty and fluidity of the dancer's pose. It also bears the year of issuance ‘2022’ and at the top the indication of the issuing country ‘FI’ and the mintmark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: The healthcare sector in recognition of the exceptional commitment during the Covid-19 pandemic
description_en: The design depicts in the inner part of the coin the health personnel. At the left you can find the inscription ‘Danke – Merci – Dank u’ together with various pictograms referring to healthcare sector. From top to bottom, a cross, a stethoscope, a heart, a syringe, a wheelchair and a chemical mixture are shown. At the far right are the initials of the designer Luc Luycx located. As the Royal Dutch Mint will strike the coins, the mintmark of Utrecht, a mercury staff is located on the bottom together with the Belgian mint master mark, the coat of arms of the municipality Herzele, the country code BE and the year mark 2022. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: UNESCO: Ħal Saflieni Hypogeum
description_en: The design shows a detail of the prehistoric site. At the top left is the name of the issuing country ‘MALTA’ and underneath the year of issuance ‘2022’. At the bottom is the inscription ‘ĦAL – SAFLIENI HYPOGEUM’ and underneath the inscription ‘4 000 – 2 500 BC’. At the bottom right are the initials of the creator of the design Noel Galea Bason ‘NGB’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: The centenary of Latvijas Banka – financial literacy
description_en: Financial literacy is the important ability to understand and effectively use various financial skills, including personal financial management, budgeting, and investing. Financial literacy is the foundation of our relationship with money, and it is a lifelong journey of learning. The design shows a tree, symbolizing the importance of financial literacy and the knowledge about it. At the bottom is the year of issuance ‘2022’ and underneath the name of the issuing country ‘LATVIJA’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: The 10th anniversary of the marriage of the Hereditary Grand Duke Guillaume and the Hereditary Grand Duchesse Stéphanie
description_en: The design depicts the effigies of the Hereditary Grand Duke Guillaume and the Hereditary Grand Duchesse Stéphanie. Close to the effigies, the respective names are depicted in semi-circular form. Two wedding rings appear at the left of the year-date 2022. At the bottom of the design, the word ‘LËTZEBUERG’ designating the issuing country is depicted, as well as the wedding date ‘20.Oktober 2012’. The monogram (letter ‘H’ with a crown) is a representation of the Grand Duke Henri. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: The 150th anniversary of the founding of the Society of Estonian Literati
description_en: The design depicts the pages of a book and the tip of a quill pen. At the top, in semi-circle are the inscription ‘EESTI KIRJAMEESTE SELTS’ and the year of issuance ‘2022’. The inscription on the pages of the book reads ‘KUI ME EI SAA SUUREKS RAHVAARVULT, PEAME SAAMA SUUREKS VAIMULT’, meaning ‘If we cannot be a great nation in number, we must be great in spirit’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: The 5th centennary of the first circumnavigation of the Earth
description_en: The expedition began in Seville in 1519 and ended in 1522 after finishing the first circumnavigation of the Earth. The design depicts two images, one is the globe in the background and the other one is a portrait of Juan Sebastián Elcano. At the bottom of the portrait and in capital letters the legends ‘JUAN SEBASTIÁN ELCANO’ and ‘PRIMUS CIRCUMDEDISTI ME’ (First to circumnavigate me), and on the portrait shoulder is the initial and the end date of the circumnavigation (1519-1522). On the right hand side and in capital letters are the issuing country ‘ESPAÑA’ and the year of minting ‘2022’. On the left hand side is the mint mark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: UNESCO: Garajonay National Park
description_en: The Garajonay National Park is situated in the middle of the island of La Gomera.in the Canary Islands archipelago, was registered on the World Heritage Sites list for being an outstanding well-preserved example of laurisilva (Laurel forest), an exceptional ecosystem of the living remnant of the old rainforests and warm temperate forests that occupied much of Europe and North Africa during the Tertiary. The coin depicts a view of the ‘Roque de Agando’ and a detail of the ‘Laurisilva forest’. On the upper right hand and in capital letters are the word ‘ESPAÑA’ and the year of minting ‘2022’. At the top on the right hand side is the mint mark. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: The 100th anniversary of the crossing the South Atlantic Ocean by air, achieved in 1922 by Gago Coutinho and Sacadura Cabral
description_en: This crossing was achieved by using only internal means of navigation: a modified sextant and a course corrector. The design shows the representation of one of the three Fairey III biplanes that were used to accomplish the flight between Lisboa and Rio de Janeiro. The edge inscription reads ‘TRAVESSIA DO ATLÂNTICO SUL’ (English – CROSSING OF THE SOUTH ATLANTIC). Below the plane, the inscription ‘PORTUGAL 1922-2022’. The Mintmark will be ‘CASA DA MOEDA’, the Portuguese name of the Mint. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: The 125th anniversary of the birth of Pope Paul VI
description_en: The design features a portrait of the Pope. At the top left, in semi-circle, is the inscription ‘CITTÀ DEL VATICANO’ and at the top right is the inscription ‘PAPA PAOLO VI’. At the left of the portrait are the years ‘1897’ and ‘2022’ and underneath them is the mintmark ‘R’. At the bottom left is the name of the artist ‘D. LONGO’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: The 90th anniversary of President Jacques Chirac’s birth
description_en: President of the French Republic for two terms, Jacques Chirac was a major architect of the European construction. As such, he was President when the Euro was introduced in 2002, whose 20th anniversary we celebrate at the beginning of this year. The design shows a solemn profile of President Jacques Chirac looking towards the future. He is surrounded by several symbols representing his actions: a euro symbol, as sign of his involvement in the introduction of the Euro and his European spirit, and a French flag represented in heraldic colours, itself embellished with the RF as a reference to his presidency. His dates and name are inserted in the Euro’s logo. The mintmarks as well as the year date fit into the design. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 雅克·希拉克曾两度担任法兰西共和国总统，是欧洲一体化进程中的重要缔造者。正因如此，在他担任总统期间，欧元于2002年正式发行，而今年年初正是欧元诞生20周年纪念。硬币设计展现了希拉克总统庄严的侧脸，他目光坚定地展望未来。周围环绕着代表他诸多功绩的符号：欧元符号，象征着他对欧元发行的贡献以及他的欧洲精神；一面以法国国旗纹章色彩呈现的旗帜，旗帜上饰有“RF”字样，以纪念他的总统任期。他的生卒日期和姓名被巧妙地融入欧元标志中。造币厂标记和年份也巧妙地融入设计之中。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜上的12颗星。

title: The 30th Anniversary of the death of Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino
description_en: : The design depicts in the centre the portraits of the two Italian judges Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino, inspired by a picture of Tony Gentile. Above, the arc-shaped inscription ‘FALCONE – BORSELLINO’, underneath the dates ‘1992 2022’, with the acronym of the Italian Republic ‘RI’ in between; on the right, ‘R’, identifying the Mint of Rome; on the left, ‘VdS’, initials of the designer Valerio de Seta. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计中心图案为两位意大利法官乔瓦尼·法尔科内和保罗·博尔塞利诺的肖像，灵感源自托尼·詹蒂莱的一幅画作。上方是弧形铭文“FALCONE – BORSELLINO”，下方是年份“1992-2022”，中间是意大利共和国的缩写“RI”；右侧是“R”，代表罗马造币厂；左侧是“VdS”，即设计师瓦莱里奥·德·塞塔的姓名首字母。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: 170th Anniversary of the foundation of the Italian National Police
description_en: : The design depicts two officers of the ‘Polizia di Stato’ (Italian National Police Force), a woman and a man, standing out in the foreground, in front of a police car. Above, the arc-shaped inscription ‘POLIZIA DI STATO’; at the right ‘RI’, acronym of the Italian Republic; the inscription ‘R’, identifying the Mint of Rome, the initials ‘AM’ of the designer Annalisa Masini and the dates ‘1852 - 2022’, appear at the left, in the centre and at the right, respectively. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计描绘了两名意大利国家警察（Polizia di Stato）警官，一男一女，站在一辆警车前，位于前景。上方是弧形铭文“POLIZIA DI STATO”；右侧是“RI”，即意大利共和国的缩写；左侧、中间和右侧分别印有代表罗马造币厂的“R”、设计师安娜丽莎·马西尼（Annalisa Masini）的姓名首字母“AM”以及年份“1852-2022”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Bundeslander series – Thuringia
description_en: : The design shows Wartburg Castle, the first German castle to be listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The inner part also features the name ‘THÜRINGEN’ and the issuing country’s country code ‘D’ at the bottom, the mint mark of the respective mint (‘A’, ‘D’, ‘F’, ‘G’ or ‘J’) as well as the engraver’s mark on the right and the the year ‘2022’ on the left. The artist: Olaf Stoy (Rabenau). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该设计展现了瓦特堡城堡，它是德国第一座被列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录的城堡。硬币内侧底部刻有“图林根州”（THÜRINGEN）字样和发行国国家代码“D”，右侧是相应造币厂的标记（“A”、“D”、“F”、“G”或“J”），以及雕刻师标记，左侧是年份“2022”。艺术家为奥拉夫·斯托伊（拉贝瑙）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: The 50th Anniversary of the legal protection of the Luxembourg flag
description_en: : The design depicts at the left hand the effigy of the Grand Duke Henri and at the right hand the Luxembourg tricolor flag. The year ‘1972’ appears above the flag and the issuing year ‘2022’ is depicted below. At the bottom centre the name of the issuing country ‘LËTZEBUERG’ is represented. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 该硬币设计左侧为亨利大公的肖像，右侧为卢森堡三色国旗。国旗上方标有“1972”，下方标有发行年份“2022”。底部中央为发行国“LËTZEBUERG”（卢森堡）。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: The 150th anniversary of the birth of architect Jože Plečnik
description_en: The design shows a detail of the grand window of the National and University library’s reading room with a pillar in front of it. It is supplemented with a composition of letters A R H. P L E Č N I K. These letters are built into the window in exact order and can be metaphorically read as the architect’s signature, which is actually exhibited in his own work. The letters are inserted into deepened window openings and can be understood (in the language of architect Plečnik) as spatial architectural interventions, as emphases, inserted into façade or as geometrically designed objects. The whole composition displays an idea of space that reflects the wealth of the architect’s ideas. It is centred around the main pillar, which has a role to mark the coin’s space and set the ratio outside – inside or front – back, one of Plečnik’s common gestures when designing space. With that, the composition becomes a spatial miniature, space within space, multi-layered and mystical. At the bottom, the inscription “JOŽE PLEČNIK«. At the left, vertically, the year ‘1872’. At the right, vertically, the country of issuance ‘SLOVENIJA’ and underneath the year of issuance ‘2022’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.
description_zh: 这幅设计图展现了国家大学图书馆阅览室宏伟窗户的细节，窗户前矗立着一根柱子。窗户上还镶嵌着字母 A R H. P L E Č N I K。这些字母按顺序排列在窗户上，可以被视为建筑师的签名，而这实际上也体现在他的其他作品中。这些字母被嵌入到加深的窗户开口中，（用建筑师普列奇尼克的语言来说）可以理解为空间建筑干预、强调、立面装饰或几何设计元素。整个构图展现了一种空间理念，反映了建筑师丰富的思想。它以主柱为中心，主柱的作用在于界定硬币的空间范围，并设定内外或前后比例——这是普列奇尼克在空间设计中常用的手法之一。由此，整个构图成为一个空间微缩模型，一个空间中的空间，层次丰富，充满神秘感。底部刻有“JOŽE PLEČNIK”字样。左侧竖向刻有年份“1872”。右侧竖向刻有发行国“SLOVENIJA”，下方为发行年份“2022”。硬币外圈饰有欧盟旗帜的12颗星。

title: Summer solstice fire festivals in the Pyrenees
description_en: The summer solstice fire festivals were inscribed on UNESCO’s Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2015. They are traditional and popular festivities widely celebrated in Andorra each year. The design reproduces a human figure, named ‘fallaire’, wearing a traditional cape and tracing a circle of fire with the ‘falla’. This is the main element of the festival and consists of tree barks that, once lit, they are energetically whirled around creating large circles of fire. The graphic composition of lines in the background of the design represents the summer solstice together with the name of the issuing country ‘ANDORRA’ and the year ‘2023’. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: 30 years of the entry of the Principality of Andorra into the United Nations
description_en: The United Nations is represented by two symbolic elements: two laurel wreaths and a globe, which forms part of the number 30 that has been represented, with the inscription ANYS (years) and the year date 2023 below. In the upper part of the design there is the coat of arms of Andorra and the inscription ‘ANDORRA MEMBRE DE LES NACIONS UNIDES’ (Andorra member of the United Nations). The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: The 150th anniversary of the birth of Josip Plemelj (mathematician and astronomer)
description_en: The design displays parts of the equation that Josip Plemelj solved as a first person in the world. Numbers and symbols rotate on circumferences that depict planet rotation, movement in space, as well as composing individual unsolvable elements into whole. That way the design shows both fields of Josip Plemelj's work, i.e. mathematics and astronomy. The inscription ‘JOSIP PLEMELJ 1873’, the name of the issuing country ‘SLOVENIJA’ and the year of issuance ‘2023’ are integrated in the design. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: Peace
description_en: The coin is dedicated to Peace among nations and to friendly and mutually beneficial coexistence. The search for peace must sit on a collective effort towards a common purpose. In the current highly polarized geopolitical context, this coin is aimed to help remind of the urgence to protect the priceless asset that is peace. The design radially displays the word ‘PAZ’ (PEACE) in the 16 official idioms spoken in all 20 countries of the Euro Zone as of January 2023. The inscription at the top reads ‘PORTUGAL’, followed by the year of issuance ‘2023’ at the top right; at the top left is the name of the designer ‘José S. Teixeira’ and at the left the mintmark ‘CASA DA MOEDA’, the name of the Portuguese Mint. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: The 60th anniversary of the foundation of the Central Bank of Cyprus
description_en: The design depicts tools on a microchip symbolising the stability of the economy in the modern industrial and digital era secured by the Central Bank of Cyprus, which celebrates 60 years of existence. The issuing country's name ‘ΚYΠΡΟΣ KIBRIS’ and the dates ‘1963-2023’ are at the bottom. Additionally, the phrase ‘60 ΧΡOΝΙΑ ΑΠO ΤΗΝ IΔΡΥΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΚΕΝΤΡΙKHΣ ΤΡAΠΕΖΑΣ ΤΗΣ ΚYΠΡΟΥ’ (i.e. 60 years since the foundation of the Central Bank of Cyprus) is inscribed on the inner part of the national side of the coin. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: Social and health services
description_en: The design represents a stylized map of Finland. The left-hand side bears the lettering ‘WELL-BEING’ in Finnish and Swedish. The year of issuance ‘2023’ is slightly on the left-hand side in the middle of the coin. At the bottom is the indication of the issuing country ‘FI’. At the right hand-side is the mintmark of the Mint of Finland. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: 200th anniversary of the start of the horse-drawn express mail coach service between Vienna and Bratislava
description_en: The design’s symbolic depiction of the express mail coach service between Vienna and Bratislava features a horse-drawn coach in rapid motion and a centrally placed rectangular inset containing a post-horn. Inscribed below the image is the year ‘1823’, when the express mail service began operation, and below that date are the city names in Slovak, ‘VIEDEŇ’ and ‘BRATISLAVA’, one above the other. At the bottom of the coin’s inner circle is the year of issuance ‘2023’, separated from the text above by a horizontal line. The name of the issuing country ‘SLOVENSKO’ is inscribed along the upper edge of the design. To the right of the coach is the mint mark of the Kremnica Mint (Mincovňa Kremnica), consisting of the letters ‘MK’ placed between two dies. Just below the mark are the stylised initials ‘MP’, referring to the national side’s designer Mária Poldaufová. The coin’s outer ring bears the 12 stars of the European flag.

title: The 75th anniversary of the national suffrage for women in Belgium
description_en: The design depicts in the centre a box on a ballot paper, which is being coloured in by a pencil. The coloured box is overlapped by the Venus symbol (the gender symbol for woman/female). At the bottom left next to the central image is inscribed 75 JAAR ANS.
